We're looking for an experienced QA Engineer in Armenia to join the team and help make sure every release reaches players polished and stable.

raw.title: JD Edwards Technical Functional Solution Architect
raw.excerpt: ERP Suites is seeking Solution Architects to design and lead the technical solutions behind our client engagements.
raw.description:
ERP Suites is seeking Solution Architects to design and lead the technical solutions behind our client engagements.
In this technical role, you will be responsible for the architecture of JD Edwards solutions, how systems are configured, extended, integrated, and deployed, and for ensuring those designs are implemented correctly through delivery.
Success in this role requires strong technical and functional knowledge. You must understand the business processes and the technology behind them so you can create, review, explain, and defend effective solutions.
Solution Architects at ERP Suites own the solution lifecycle from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, proposal development, technical design oversight, implementation guidance, and post-project review.

Key Responsibilities
Solution Architecture & Design

  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client business processes, objectives, challenges, and technical requirements.
  • Translate business needs into scalable, practical solution architectures and functional designs.
  • Design integrated solutions across enterprise platforms, including JD Edwards, Salesforce, AI technologies, and related business applications.
  • Evaluate solution alternatives by considering business value, implementation complexity, risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce solution architecture documents, workflow diagrams, technical specifications, and implementation roadmaps.
Client Engagement & Presales
  • Serve as a trusted advisor during presales engagements, helping clients identify the best solution for their business needs.
  • Facilitate discovery workshops and requirements sessions with executives, business users, and technical stakeholders.
  • Present solution recommendations with clear business and technical justification.
  • Support proposal development, project estimation, and implementation planning.
  • Set realistic expectations regarding project scope, timelines, costs, and delivery approach.
Delivery Leadership
  • Maintain architectural ownership throughout project delivery to ensure solutions are implemented as designed.
  • Collaborate with project managers, consultants, developers, and client teams to resolve design questions and implementation challenges.
  • Identify risks, technical constraints, and scope changes early, recommending practical solutions when adjustments are needed.
  • Review implementation progress to ensure alignment with architectural standards and client objectives.
  • Participate in post-implementation reviews and continuously improve delivery methodologies and best practices.
About You
You enjoy solving business problems just as much as technical ones. You're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and quickly understand how technology can improve business operations.
You communicate effectively with both executives and technical teams, translating complex concepts into language that builds confidence and trust. You take ownership of your work, make informed decisions, and remain engaged throughout delivery to ensure your solutions achieve the intended outcomes.
You thrive in consulting environments where every client presents a unique challenge and where your ability to think strategically, collaborate effectively, and adapt quickly makes a meaningful impact.
Qualifications:
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more JD Edwards functional areas, including supply chain, distribution, finance, or accounting.
  • Working knowledge of JD Edwards technical architecture.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and solution designs that development teams can use to build and implement solutions.
  • Experience leading discovery sessions and gathering requirements from business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to estimate implementation effort, identify technical risks, and recommend practical delivery approaches.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into effective system designs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences and influence decisions through collaboration.
*JD Edwards is the foundation of our practice and remains our preferred experience. However, we will consider candidates with comparable technical solution architecture experience in another ERP platform: such as Oracle ERP Cloud, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, or NetSuite.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Consulting or professional services experience supporting multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Experience across both presales solution architecture and post-sales implementation.
  • Experience with JD Edwards Orchestrator, AIS, or automation and low-code extension frameworks.
  • Experience with JD Edwards upgrades, code-current programs, retrofit strategy, or cloud migrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and enterprise application infrastructure, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Experience architecting solutions that combine JD Edwards with adjacent platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle ERP Cloud, or reporting and analytics tools.
  • Experience applying AI technologies, automation platforms, or modern integration frameworks within an enterprise environment.
  • Certifications in Oracle, JD Edwards, cloud platforms, or enterprise architecture. ERP Suites supports professional development and will contribute toward relevant certifications for the right candidate.
Why ERP Suites

At ERP Suites, Solution Architects do more than design systems—they help shape client strategy and influence business outcomes. As a boutique consulting firm specializing in JD Edwards and enterprise technology solutions, we empower our architects to take ownership from initial discovery through successful delivery.
You'll work directly with clients, collaborate with experienced consultants and technical experts, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact across a wide variety of industries and technologies. If you're looking for a role where your expertise influences both business decisions and technical execution, ERP Suites offers an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a difference.
ERP Suites is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.


Company:

At ERP Suites, our focus is on helping our customers realize IT’s potential. Our comprehensive ERP solutions enable them to streamline and scale their IT products and processes. And this leads directly to improved efficiency and increased margins. We are a proud Oracle Gold Partner and champion of proactive JD Edwards management and custom product enhancements.
ERP Suites provides technical consulting, cloud services, managed services, and digital transformation solutions for some of America’s top companies. We build secure connections, improve performance, automate workloads and give them mobility. In other words, we help them stay on top.
We deliver multi-functional value through cloud services, digital transformation, ERP consulting services, ERP managed services, and software development.

Core Values:
  • Make Customers Successful
  • Be An Advisor
  • Be a teacher
  • Be a Coach
  • Have Fun
  • Do the Right Things for the ERP Suites Family
  • Adapt Quickly to Changing Roles and Environments

This is Where IT Change Starts.
  • With questions.
  • With problems that need to be solved.
  • With business needs, both immediate and long term.
  • Because technology and its impact on business isn’t getting any simpler.
  • That’s why we exist.
  • To answer the tough questions.
  • To find a solution to every problem—no matter the size or scope.
  • And to help companies not just identify IT’s potential, but realize IT

raw.title: AI Solution Engineering Senior Manager - CG&S
raw.excerpt: Who we are:Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet.
raw.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An AI Solution Engineering leader who is ready to lead teams that build reliable, production AI products for customer service. You lead engineering teams, including Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who integrate foundation models, RAG pipelines, agents, data services, and application components into products that customers and service employees use every day.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams will be embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You set the standard for how your team work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee AI product engineering programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across leads and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as resolution, average handle time, customer satisfaction, and adoption.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Lead delivery of production AI applications for service: conversational AI agents across voice and digital channels, human agent-assist copilots, knowledge assistants, interaction summarization and quality automation, and analytics agents that let leaders ask questions of their service data in plain language.
  • Hold your FDEs to production-grade standards: tested Python and TypeScript services, eval suites that catch regressions, observability, and clear cost, latency, and safety tradeoffs, so solutions run reliably after handoff.
  • Set engineering standards for how AI components work together, including RAG design, prompt and context engineering, evals and guardrails, model selection, and when fine-tuning is worth the investment.
  • Originate use cases with clients, prioritizing by measurable value and shaping engagements that ladder to a real product, not a proof of concept.
  • Turn conversation designs, customer experience journeys, and prototypes into production code, co-creating from early concepts and feeding back what data and model behavior reveal so the experience keeps improving.
  • Ensure what ships is secure, monitored, and responsible, partnering with specialists in MLOps, AI security, and responsible AI.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships, proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, and crafting proposals that win work our teams are proud to ship.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on the service AI products that matter most to clients, such as agentic customer service and analytics agents, advancing Song Service as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.
  • Strengthen relationships with AI and service platform partners to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow FDEs and the engineers around them, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across use case discovery & prioritization, story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify delivery patterns, eval suites, and reusable components, and feed field learnings back into our offerings to make delivery repeatable.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders. Experience should include:
    • A hands-on background moving AI products into production (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails).
    • Working fluency with the FDE technical stack, including LLM APIs across frontier and open-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral), agentic frameworks and MCP, RAG pipelines and vector databases, Python and TypeScript, REST and GraphQL integration, and model and prompt evals, so you can inspire and challenge your teams' technical designs.
  • Delivery experience on at least one enterprise agent platform in production, such as Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure, Google Gemini, or Databricks Mosaic.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.

Bonus points if you have:

  • A product-led mindset that connects AI and data work to product strategy and the design-to-product pipeline.
  • Experience leading delivery of conversational AI in production, such as virtual agents, voice bots, agent-assist copilots, and knowledge assistants, spanning conversation design, dialog and intent management, and LLM-based agents across voice and digital channels.
  • Experience embedding AI into contact center and CRM platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect, and into the workflows service agents use every day.
  • Experience with conversation intelligence, such as speech and interaction analytics, sentiment, and automated quality assurance, turning service conversations into insight at the enterprise level.
  • A track record of leading business development by shaping proposals, scoping programs, and presenting to clients in a way that builds confidence and closes deals.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to hold difficult conversations with senior client stakeholders, guiding them to outcomes that strengthen the relationship while setting expectations that protect our delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and influence cross-functional decision making.
  • Experience with conversational AI and agent platforms such as Google Customer Engagement Suite, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Salesforce Agentforce, or ServiceNow AI Agents.
  • A full-stack engineering background in web, mobile, or API development.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams spanning design, advisory, and technology, turning research insights and design recommendations into engineered solutions.
  • Experience working in management consulting or a professional services environment.
  • You contribute to external thought leadership, such as publishing POVs, speaking at events, or representing the practice in the broader AI community.

raw.description:
About Talixo

Talixo is the world's leading operator of pre-booked transfers, working with the biggest brands in travel. We partner with fleets in 1,100+ cities and 130+ countries worldwide to provide travellers with reliable, high-quality rides, making their journeys easier and more enjoyable, from door to door. Since 2012, we've been helping travel brands create more connected journeys, and we're looking for people willing to go the extra mile.
Operating across two key locations: Krakow and Berlin, our cohesive teams - IT, Operations, Fleet, Pricing, Sales, Finance and HR - drive technological innovation, operational excellence, and organizational development. With a shared focus on refining processes and enhancing technology while spearheading strategic growth initiatives, we seamlessly contribute to our collective success.

About

We’re looking for a proactive and strategic
Account Managerto drive growth and strengthen relationships with Talixo’s highest-potential Tier-1 partners. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, relationship management, and commercial execution, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment.

Experience in the travel or mobility industry is a strong plus, as the role involves collaborating closely with commercial, product, and tech stakeholders to unlock new revenue opportunities and ensure best-in-class partner satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Own & Grow Our Top Global Partners

  • Act as thestrategic commercial owner for Talixo’s most valuable Tier-1 partners,ensuring commercial performance, satisfaction, and long-term alignment.
  • Build and nurture strong, multi-level relationships with partner stakeholders(from operational leads to senior executives) across Commercial, Product, Tech, and Operations.
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews(QBRs), performance deep-dives, and annual joint business planning sessions that translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
  • Become the partner’s trusted advisor, understanding their business model, priorities, and KPIs, and proactively proposing tailored solutions that drive mutual growth.
  • Be the internal voice of the partner, influencing cross-functional roadmaps around pricing, tech integrations, service enhancements, and scalability.
  • Develop and maintain a clear account plan for each key partner, outlining revenue targets, growth levers, and key actions to hit performance goals.
  • Manage commercial negotiations and renewals, ensuring sustainable, win–win agreements that align with Talixo’s strategic objectives.

Activate Growth

  • Audit all active Tier-1 partners to identify underperforming, inactive, or “silent” accounts, using performance analytics to pinpoint friction points and opportunities.
  • Prioritise quick wins to immediately re-energise partner performance, while building mid- and long-term activation strategies.
  • Partner with Pricing, Tech, and Fleet teams to launch new cities or products based on partner needs and market potential.
  • Build and execute data-backed activation playbooks, defining which actions drive impact and scaling successful tactics globally.
  • Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities, helping partners expand their footprint within the Talixo ecosystem.

Drive Strategy & Innovation

  • Partner with Product and Tech teams to introduce API or integration enhancements that boost conversion, automation, and reliability.
  • Translate data into actionable insights by identifying trends, forecasting demand, and informing pricing or product decisions.
  • Feed market intelligence and competitive insights into Talixo’s commercial strategy, helping shape new features, services, or geographic expansions.

Make It Scalable

  • Maintain CRM discipline by keeping partner records, performance data, and activity logs accurate, current, and actionable.
  • Identify inefficiencies and process gaps, proposing automation, tools, or templates that streamline account management workflows.
  • Collaborate on the creation of internal playbooks, frameworks, and best practices to ensure consistency and scalability across markets.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop dashboards and internal tools that enhance visibility, forecasting, and reporting accuracy.
  • Contribute to training and onboarding initiatives for new team members, sharing knowledge and building collective expertise.
  • Participate in global account strategy sessions, helping refine Talixo’s approach to commercial excellence and partner success.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years of experience in account management, partner management, or business development, ideally within a B2B, travel, mobility, or tech-driven environment.You have experience managing large, multi-country accounts with complex commercial and operational setups.
  • Aproven record of growing and retaining key global accounts, including setting strategic goals, delivering joint business plans, and executing measurable growth initiatives. You’re comfortable navigating both executive-level partnerships and day-to-day operational collaboration.
  • Strong commercial acumen. You understand how pricing, margin, and partner economics work, and you can build business cases, negotiate terms, and drive mutually profitable outcomes.
  • A data-driven mindset with advanced analytical and problem-solving skills. You can interpret performance dashboards, use data to diagnose bottlenecks, and build actionable insights that improve conversion and ROI.
    CRM expertise (Salesforce preferred) and comfort using digital tools to manage pipelines, document opportunities, and monitor performance. You’re disciplined about process and data integrity.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills to be able to work effectively with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Operations to align priorities and deliver integrated solutions for partners.
  • Strong negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently pitch, influence, and close agreements at both regional and global levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage multiple high-impact projects simultaneously. You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and have a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Experience in travel tech, ground transportation, or mobility services is a significant plus. You understand industry trends, supply dynamics, and what drives traveler and partner value.
  • High cultural intelligence and adaptability. You are comfortable engaging with international teams and clients across different regions, time zones, and working styles.
  • Tech fluency. You are comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, and platform functionality with technical counterparts, even if you’re not writing code yourself.
  • Fluent English and Italian communication skills (written and verbal) are essential; additional languages such as German, Spanish, or French are highly desirable.

What we offer:

  • Private health insurance.
  • Monthly sales commission
  • Flexible working hours (Monday - Friday, local time), remote.
  • Vouchers for Talixo rides.

raw.description:
OutcomesAI is a healthcare technology company building an AI-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
Our solution combines AI voice agents and licensed nurses to handle patient communication, symptom triage, remote monitoring, and post-acute care — reducing administrative burden and enabling clinicians to focus on direct patient care.

Our core product suite includes:

● Glia Voice Agents – multimodal conversational agents capable of answering patient calls, triaging symptoms using evidence-based protocols (e.g., Schmitt-Thompson), scheduling visits, and delivering education and follow-ups.
● Glia Productivity Agents – AI copilots for nurses that automate charting, scribing, and clinical decision support by integrating directly into EHR systems such as Epic and Athena.
● AI-Enabled Nursing Services – a hybrid care delivery model where AI and licensed nurses work together to deliver virtual triage, remote patient monitoring, and specialty patient support programs (e.g., oncology, dementia, dialysis).
Our AI infrastructure leverages multimodal foundation models — incorporating speech recognition (ASR), natural language understanding, and text-to-speech (TTS) — fine-tuned for healthcare environments to ensure safety, empathy, and clinical accuracy. All models operate within a HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2–certified framework. OutcomesAI partners with leading health systems and virtual care organizations to deploy and validate these capabilities at scale. Our goal is to create the world’s first AI + nurse hybrid workforce, improving access, safety, and efficiency across the continuum of care.
The Role

This is not a traditional, script-reading outbound role. At OutcomesAI, the Business Development Representative sits at the intersection of pipeline generation, demand generation, and brand enablement.

You will be responsible for sourcing high-value enterprise pipeline through direct outbound outreach (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) while simultaneously creating marketing collateral, customer stories, and event promotions needed to effectively hit new pipeline targets.

Key Responsibilities

    Outbound Sales & Pipeline Generation

  • Schedule qualified introductory and discovery calls for the sales team.
    • Collateral & Content Development
  • Partner with leadership and technical teams to produce compelling sales enablement assets: product one-pagers and case studies.

  • Drive targeted attendance through outbound invitation campaigns, organic social posts, and email marketing.
  • Run end-to-end pre- and post-event follow-up cadences to convert webinar/trade show attendees into qualified sales pipeline.
    • Brand Presence & Social Selling
  • Build and maintain a vibrant top-of-funnel presence on LinkedIn, positioning OutcomesAI as a thought leader in real-world AI implementation.
  • Monitor relevant industry discussions, communities, and competitor movements to identify emerging prospecting triggers.

What You Bring

    What You Bring

    Experience: 3–5 years of experience in B2B sales development (SDR/BDR), product marketing, growth marketing, or a hybrid GTM role—ideally within B2B SaaS, data/analytics, or artificial intelligence. Healthcare experience is a plus.

    Cold Calling Confidence: Demonstrated comfort picking up the phone, navigating gatekeepers, holding consultative peer-to-peer conversations with senior executives, and handling objections gracefully.

    Content & Storytelling Chops: Exceptional business writing and narrative skills. Ability to write clean, persuasive copy for cold outreach and case studies

    Tech Stack Familiarity: Hands-on experience with modern sales and marketing platforms:

    CRM: HubSpot or Salesforce

    Prospecting & Cadence: Zoominfo, LinkedIn, etc

    Builder Mindset: High agency, intellectual curiosity about applied AI, and comfort working in an evolving, high-growth environment where processes are actively being established.

What We Offer

    Direct Impact: Significant visibility with founding leadership and the opportunity to directly shape our GTM playbook.

    Career Trajectory: Cream rises to the top. In a high-growth startup, excellent performance, proven competency and work can provide upward mobility

    Competitive Package: Base salary plus uncapped commission

About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We combine an optimised operating system with orchestration, management, automation, and protection to deliver mainframe-like efficiency, performance, reliability, versatility, and security—while reducing overall cost and complexity.

Our Virtuozzo Infrastructure System (V/IS) brings together compute, storage, and networking to support traditional applications, cloud-native workloads, and AI services. We help organisations modernise their infrastructure, make better use of their hardware, and bring new cloud- and GPU-powered services to market on their own infrastructure and under their own brand.

Our technology serves more than 100,000 companies in over 100 countries. With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue to contribute to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

The Role

Our team develops the V/IS and we are looking for Engineers to join our team. As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building new features, optimizing performance, and ensuring reliability in production environments. You will collaborate across the full stack of the product, from UI and REST APIs to cluster lifecycle management, virtualization, monitoring, and seamless product updates.

Preferred Knowledge

The New Jersey Innovation Authority

The New Jersey Innovation Authority (NJIA) is looking for diverse and experienced team members to deploy world-class innovative and digital services that solve pressing public interest challenges for the people of New Jersey. Our work spans numerous issue and policy areas, and is focused on making an impact in the lives of the New Jerseyans that we serve. Our work has decreased the amount of time it takes to apply for Unemployment Insurance, made it easier to start, operate, and grow a business in the Garden State, and connected millions of New Jerseyans to government programs, services, and benefits.
Our team members wear many hats, contributing to both the execution of core projects and the evolution of NJIA. We use data and modern research, design, and development methods to inform our decision making, and we collaborate with stakeholders within and outside of government to understand and solve challenges. To learn more about NJIA read our impact report and visit our About Us page.

The Executive Director serves as a key strategic thought-partner, adviser, and operational collaborator to the New Jersey State Chief Innovation Officer, and as the chief executive of New Jersey Innovation Authority’s (NJIA) fiscally-sponsored partner project, InnovateNJ. Core responsibilities include oversight of InnovateNJ’s personnel, budget, finance, procurement, compliance, and day-to-day operations, while also playing a central role in the strategic support of NJIA’s work. The executive director will operate with significant autonomy, yet in close coordination with the Chief Innovation Officer and NJIA’s senior staff, and work closely with team members across the organization.

As a part of the team, your responsibilities may include:

Organizational Outcomes and Alignment: Supporting and driving organizational planning, advancement, outcomes and achievement

  • In close collaboration with the Chief Innovation Officer, work with initiative, project, and functional leads to set, communicate, measure, and reach organizational objectives and impact, and drive the implementation of approaches and tactics that ensure programmatic collaboration and coordination across programs, products, and practice areas.
  • Identify, obtain, and, oversee the management of InnovateNJ’s financial resources to ensure that adequate funding is available to advance the organization’s core mission, projects, and outcomes, and that funding is expended effectively, efficiently, and in alignment with all applicable rules, regulations, and policies.
  • Oversee and manage the design, implementation, and administration of InnovateNJ policies, processes, and activities that contribute to the continued advancement and evolution of the organization.
  • Coordinate with NJIA’s leadership to ensure internal communication and information flows so that the right information is reaching the right team members at the right time.
  • Represent InnovateNJ, as needed, with key organizational stakeholders across State government and externally.

Partner Project Governance: Serving as Project Director and primary liaison with InnovateNJ’s fiscal sponsor

  • Maintain effective coordination and communication between the InnovateNJ project and its fiscal sponsor, the National Center for Civic Innovation, to ensure seamless operations and compliance.
  • Ensure all program financial activities are conducted through the fiscal sponsor in full compliance with tax-exempt requirements, with proper documentation, approvals, and controls in place for expenditures and contractual commitments.
  • Establish and maintain a compliant workforce that adheres to fiscal sponsor personnel policies, ethical standards, and conflict of interest requirements, with appropriate approvals and documentation for all hiring decisions.
  • Secure and maintain positive donor relationships through compliant contribution processing, timely acknowledgments, and accurate reporting that meets both IRS and donor requirements.
  • Ensure ongoing alignment between InnovateNJ activities and fiscal sponsor policies, procedures, and mission requirements, obtaining necessary approvals for any programmatic changes.

Compliance and Regulatory Affairs: Navigating government, regulatory, and compliance processes and procedures to advance the organization’s mission and work

  • Ensure that all InnovateNJ activities are executed in a compliant manner, consistent with applicable laws, rules, regulations, and funding agreements.
  • Provide programmatic support to project teams to ensure that product and project goals and objectives can be met in a manner consistent with requirements.
  • In collaboration with NJIA leadership, guide project teams in navigating processes and requirements, and support the development of creative and sustainable solutions to challenges that inhibit the advancement of core initiatives and projects.

Organizational Talent: Ensure organizational talent needs are met

  • Oversee InnovateNJ’s efforts to identify talent needs, and attract and retain top-tier talent to advance the organization’s mission and objectives.
  • Work with team members to develop and advance practices that promote and encourage the healthy evolution of organizational culture.

Do what’s needed for the team

  • Execute additional duties and responsibilities to advance the organization’s mission and work.

Experience, Skills, and Abilities

    Applicants will be assessed based on a demonstrated ability to accomplish the above-discussed responsibilities. We are seeking individuals with the following experience, expertise, skills, and abilities:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience required, as is a demonstrated and deep commitment to public service and impact.
  • 5+ years of direct personnel oversight and management experience.
  • 3+ years of senior executive leadership experience in the non-profit or digital service delivery field, overseeing an organization or division of similar size and scope ($20MM operating budget, 75+ staff members, etc.).
  • Proven expertise in, and deep understanding of, government budgeting, policy and administration processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve diverse problems in highly ambiguous settings, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • A demonstrable ability to rapidly context switch, re-prioritize tasks, and address in-demand team and stakeholder needs with speed and agility.
  • Exceptional communication and people management skills with the ability to build, maintain, and grow professional relationships.
  • Demonstrated success in navigating government bureaucracies and institutions, operating in a highly-regulated environment, and achieving desired outcomes.
  • Experience with, and understanding of, innovation practices in government and/or large institutions, including the use of data to drive decision-making, and approaching problem-solving collaboratively and in an agile manner.
  • Willingness to be available as needed during off hours for occasional rapid/crisis response.
  • Ability to travel to Trenton, NJ with limited notice.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent required; advanced degree such as a J.D., MBA, or master’s degree in public administration, public policy, public finance or another field related to job responsibilities and qualifications is preferred.
  • Dedicated to advancing the mission of the NJ Innovation Authority and public service, with a strong commitment to accessibility and fostering a more inclusive society.

We welcome applicants from a broad range of backgrounds. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply. If you have any questions, please contact .

Compensation: Annual salary of $200,000 commensurate with experience. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid leave, and competitive retirement plan options, as well as other optional fringe benefits.

Hiring Entity: This role will be hired by InnovateNJ - a fiscally-sponsored partner project of the National Center for Civic Innovation that exists to advance NJIA’s work and impact.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer

We are deeply committed to the principles of equity, diversity, and inclusiveness and seek to create a pluralistic community for all. We strongly encourage people of color, members of racial and ethnic minority groups, women, LGBTQI+ people, those with disabilities, and Veterans to apply. We are committed to building a team that is reflective of New Jersey’s incredible diversity.
We do not discriminate against any candidate because of color, race, age, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, pregnancy, marital status, status as a parent, ancestry, national origin, disability (physical or mental), family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, retaliation, or other non-merit based factors.

Eligibility

You must be authorized to work in the United States. Candidates may be required to pass a background check and complete additional steps as part of the application and onboarding process. You will be considered an “at-will” employee, meaning both employer and employee have the right to terminate employment with or without cause or notice.

Role Overview

Encoura is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our One Stop and Help Desk offerings. These solutions enable colleges and universities to deliver accessible, responsive support to students, faculty, and staff across voice, chat, and digital channels. This role owns the evolution of a differentiated, scalable service experience—combining contact center operations, Amazon Connect (AWS Connect), AI-powered voice and chat assistants, intelligent self-service, and seamless human-agent support. You will translate institutional needs, operational insights, and emerging technology into a prioritized portfolio strategy, aligning engineering, service delivery, client-facing teams, and executive stakeholders around measurable improvements in customer experience, operational performance, and growth.

A Day in the Life

  • Own and communicate the One Stop and Help Desk product vision, strategy, multi-quarter roadmap, and prioritized backlog, balancing client needs, competitive differentiation, commercial opportunities, technical investment, and operational efficiency
  • Set product direction for Amazon Connect-based omnichannel experiences, including IVR, intelligent routing, queue management, agent desktop/workflows, integrations, reporting, workforce management, and quality assurance; partner with engineering on architectural tradeoffs and scalability
  • Lead the strategy and delivery of conversational AI across voice and chat—including virtual agents, knowledge-grounded answers, automated resolutions, intent recognition, escalation to human agents, and conversation analytics—with explicit quality, safety, and performance measure
  • Conduct market and customer discovery with higher education institutions, frontline agents, service operations, implementation, sales, and client success; map end-to-end service journeys and translate unmet needs into differentiated product opportunities
  • Define business cases, success metrics, and performance targets; own product-level accountability for CSAT, NPS, customer effort, digital containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, call abandonment, agent productivity, and SLA performance, in partnership with operating teams
  • Use contact center analytics, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, financial/operational data, and competitive intelligence to evaluate opportunities, prioritize investments, monitor AI accuracy and escalation effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement
  • Lead discovery through launch and adoption: define outcomes and requirements, guide UX and technical decisions, make scope and priority tradeoffs, ensure release readiness, and equip go-to-market, implementation, and service teams with positioning and enablement
  • Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without direct authority; proactively manage dependencies, delivery risks, vendor/platform relationships, and roadmap decisions while mentoring less-experienced product colleagues as appropriate

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you'll: Assess the One Stop and Help Desk business, customer segments, economics, service workflows, current roadmap, Amazon Connect architecture, AI capabilities, partner dependencies, and operational scorecard; establish relationships with key leaders and identify immediate risks and opportunities.
  • Within 3 months, you'll: Present a clear portfolio assessment, prioritized multi-quarter roadmap, and measurable outcome framework; align product, engineering, operations, and commercial leaders on strategic priorities, AI automation opportunities, and delivery tradeoffs; lead an initial high-value initiative.
  • Within 6 months, you'll: Be accountable for execution and demonstrated progress against agreed product KPIs; deliver and measure a material portfolio enhancement, advance the voice/chat AI and self-service strategy, and establish a repeatable process for customer discovery, roadmap governance, and post-launch optimization.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically 5+ years of relevant experience, including significant ownership of SaaS or technology product strategy and delivery; prior experience with contact center platforms, customer service technology, or managed service-enabled products strongly preferred
  • Deep understanding of contact center operations and service delivery, including omnichannel engagement, IVR, routing and queues, workforce management (WFM), quality assurance (QA), service-level agreements (SLAs), and reporting/analytics
  • Hands-on product experience with Amazon Connect (AWS Connect) or a comparable cloud contact center platform; able to make informed decisions about platform capabilities, integrations, vendor dependencies, architectural constraints, and total cost of ownership
  • Demonstrated experience launching or scaling conversational AI, chatbots, voice assistants, or automated self-service; understands knowledge management, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, agent handoffs, AI evaluation, and responsible deployment
  • Proven ability to define and improve measurable product and operational outcomes, including CSAT, NPS, customer effort, containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, abandonment, agent productivity, and service quality
  • Strong product leadership skills in discovery, market assessment, strategy, business cases, roadmap prioritization, agile execution, stakeholder influence, and written and executive-level communication; comfortable using Jira, Confluence, and analytics tools
  • Sound commercial and technical judgment; able to work independently through ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, negotiate tradeoffs, and align diverse teams around outcomes rather than feature requests
  • Experience in higher education or EdTech is a plus; commitment to improving the student support experience and using AI to augment—not simply replace—effective human service
  • Successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a CLEAR™ identity verification as part of the pre-employment screening process
    • CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ

The annual base salary range for this exempt position is $160,000 - $175,000 andreflects the midpoint through maximum of the established range for this role. Encoura establishes compensation using national market data, internal equity considerations, and organizational budget factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization. Certain roles may also be eligible for variable compensation in addition to base salary.Employees in this role are eligible for Encoura’s comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other programs that support employee well‑being.

About  Us

Encoura’s mission is to empower students and institutions to create meaningful connections so everyone can make the most informed decisions to achieve their goals. Since 1972, the Company has evolved its products and services to better represent the link between students and higher education institutions and to create the highest probability of student success. 

Encoura’s expertise now spans enrollment, research, marketing, student success, and advancement and provides an unmatched combination of higher education experience and innovative solutions for colleges and universities. The Company also offers Encourage® — the nation’s largest free college and career planning program used by millions of high school students and educators nationwide. 

It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. All applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. 

Encoura endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability and need an alternative method for applying, please contact the Talent Team.

As a Backend Engineer on the Gitaly team, you’ll help build GitLab’s Git data storage tier, a standalone product that provides reliable, secure, and fast access to Git repositories through application programming interfaces (APIs) and storage operations. You’ll work at the boundary between GitLab and Git to make repository access performant and dependable for GitLab.com, self-managed customers, and GitLab Dedicated. Our work spans distributed storage, repository management, high availability, performance, observability, and operational excellence. We’re currently building the next generation of source code management (SCM), including new approaches to scaling Git storage and improving how repository data is managed and served.

You’ll balance roadmap delivery, technical improvements, customer and reliability work, and operational support. We value pragmatic engineering, thoughtful trade-offs, continuous improvement, and sustainable ways of working while operating a service that’s critical to GitLab. Learn more on the Gitaly Team Page.

What you’ll do

  • Own moderately sized to complex technical initiatives from problem definition and proposal through implementation, rollout, monitoring, and operational follow-through.
  • Act as the directly responsible individual for projects by aligning stakeholders, communicating progress and trade-offs, identifying risks, and keeping execution moving with minimal guidance.
  • Lead technical design for distributed storage, Git repository management, performance, reliability, and scalability problems, using data and benchmarking to guide decisions.
  • Partner with engineers and teams across GitLab, including Git, Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, Dedicated, and customer-facing teams, to deliver cross-functional outcomes.
  • Improve engineering practices through mentoring, documentation, knowledge sharing, design reviews, and constructive code reviews.
  • Take operational ownership of the systems you work on, including incident response, post-incident improvements, capacity and performance analysis, and customer escalations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve work beyond an individual change through automation, reusable designs, better dashboards, upstream contributions, and improvements to development and testing workflows.
  • Respond to user emergencies, platform alerts, and support requests, including regular on-call duties.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant professional experience building, debugging, and optimizing distributed or highly available software systems in large-scale production environments.
  • Experience owning complex projects end to end, including technical design, execution, rollout, and operational support.
  • Strong systems design skills and the ability to reason about performance, failure modes, consistency, concurrency, capacity, and observability.
  • A track record of influencing technical decisions and working effectively with stakeholders across teams and disciplines.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, improving team practices, and raising the quality of designs, code, testing, and documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and make trade-offs clear.
  • Professional experience with Go or another backend or systems language.
  • Experience operating production systems, participating in incident response, and turning operational learnings into durable improvements.
  • Experience with Ruby, Git internals, gRPC, or Git server infrastructure is highly desirable.

About the team

The Gitaly team includes Backend Engineers who share ownership of the product’s design, implementation, reliability, and customer outcomes. We work autonomously while collaborating closely through design discussions, code reviews, incident response, documentation, and asynchronous communication. Engineers are encouraged to take ownership as directly responsible individuals, seek input early, make decisions transparently, and share knowledge across the team. Learn more on the Gitaly Team Page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. Role type: Contract

Location: Remote, United States only

About the role: In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do:

  • Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.

  • Assess documentation of systemic cancer therapies, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and supportive care.

  • Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, disease progression, and follow-up care.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications:

  • MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Medical Oncology.

  • At least 2 years of recent outpatient medical oncology experience following fellowship.

  • Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing solid tumors, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.

  • Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.

  • Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.

  • Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.

  • Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.

  • Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process:

  • Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

raw.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.

Essential Job Duties

  • Enterprise Quality Leadership: Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
  • Standardize Testing Processes: Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
  • Tooling Ownership: Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
  • Automation Strategy: Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
  • Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:
  • Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
  • Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
  • Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
  • Security & Compliance Testing Support: Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
  • Customer UAT Support:
  • Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
  • Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
  • Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
  • Quality Metrics & Reporting: Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
  • Shift-Left Quality Practices: Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
  • Incident & Defect Management: Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
  • Organizational Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
  • Release Governance: Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
  • Coding agent advocacy: Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.

Other Job Duties

  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

Travel Requirements

  • Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
  • 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
  • Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
  • Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
  • Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
  • Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
  • AI/ML fundamentals: Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.
The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.
This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.
HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, FP&A
raw.excerpt: It’s an exciting time to join HiBob.  Salesforce is leading a $166 million investment in the company, supporting our vision to bring trusted people context into the AI-powered enterprise.
raw.description:
It’s an exciting time to join HiBob. Salesforce is leading a $166 million investment in the company, supporting our vision to bring trusted people context into the AI-powered enterprise. As we accelerate our product, technology, AI, and innovation roadmap, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape what comes next.

HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people, giving HR and managers all they need to connect, engage, develop, and retain top talent. Since 2015, we've achieved strong and consistent growth, powered by a global team building one of the most modern HR platforms in the market.
Our platform is intuitive, data-driven, and built for the way people work today: globally, remotely, and collaboratively. Companies around the world rely on Bob to create better employee experiences and drive business outcomes.

As part of this evolution, HiBob is expanding into the Office of the CFO. The Finance Tech unit is building an AI-native FP&A product from the ground up: planning, forecasting and modeling on top of the people and financial data our customers already trust Bob with.

We're looking for a senior product manager to join the Finance Tech unit and help build HiBob's FP&A product line. You'll own a core area of the product, such as planning and modeling, data management, or the agentic layer. You'll take it from early concept to customer value, working hands-on with engineering, design and data.
This is a greenfield role with broad scope. It needs strong product fundamentals, real curiosity about how finance teams work, and comfort building in an evolving space where AI is changing what planning software can be.

East Coast location is strongly preferred, though we’re open to exceptional candidates based elsewhere in the U.S.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do
  • Own a key area of the FP&A product end to end, from discovery and definition through launch and adoption
  • Define how plans, drivers, formulas and scenarios work in an AI-native planning experience
  • Partner closely with engineering on architecture and technical trade-offs, including the calculation engine, the data model and integrations
  • Design how agents help finance teams collaborate on budgets and forecasts, surface insights and keep plans reviewable by humans
  • Work with design to shape the planning UI, prototyping early and testing with real finance users
  • Turn insights from customers, the market and competitors into clear priorities
  • Work across HiBob's HR and finance products so FP&A gets the full value of Bob's people data
What makes this role interesting
  • You'll help build a new product line from the ground up, on a platform with an existing customer base
  • You'll shape what AI-native FP&A looks like, at a moment when the category is being redefined
  • You'll work on hard problems: modeling, data unification, and multiplayer AI with real governance
  • You'll join a small, senior, hands-on team where your decisions show up in the product quickly

Requirements

  • 6+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS
  • Hands-on experience building planning, EPM, FP&A, accounting or other finance products, or working in FP&A yourself
  • Solid understanding of how finance teams plan, budget, forecast and model, including drivers, versions, scenarios and dimensions
  • Good technical understanding, and the ability to work closely with engineers on complex systems such as calculation engines, data models and integrations
  • Experience working on AI-powered products, preferably including GenAI or agents
  • Strong product thinking that balances user needs, business goals and technical constraints
  • Comfort prototyping your ideas, whether in Figma, with AI tools or in code
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain product decisions clearly
Strong advantage
  • Experience at a planning or EPM vendor, such as Anaplan, Adaptive, OneStream, Pigment, Vena, Prophix, Board or Jedox
  • Background as an FP&A practitioner, implementation consultant or solution architect
  • Experience with data platforms, unified data models or ERP integrations
  • Experience building on or for MCP, LLM tooling or agent frameworks
  • Experience in domains that require high trust and reliability, such as HR, finance or security

Benefits

At HiBob, our people are at the heart of everything we do.

We’re building a global village of ambitious, thoughtful, and talented Bobbers who want to do the best work of their careers. With a vibrant NYC office and remote teammates across the country, we’ve created an environment where people can be themselves, grow quickly, and make a real impact.
Joining HiBob means working alongside exceptional people while being supported with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and pre-IPO equity, including the perks below.

Ownership & Financial
  • Equity in a global, high-growth HR tech SaaS leader
  • 401(k) with a 3% company match effective the month following your start date
  • $2,500 employee referral bonus
Health & Wellbeing
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage from day one
  • $1,920 annual wellness stipend to support your physical and mental wellbeing
  • Annual Headspace membership and expanded wellness benefits
Workplace Flexibility
  • Hybrid working model for Bobbers in the NY metro area
  • Temporary work from anywhere for up to 2 months per year (after 6 months)
Work-Life Balance
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays to rest, recharge, and enjoy
  • Bob Balance Days – 4 additional days within a calendar year - Enjoy a company-wide long weekend at the beginning of each quarter
  • Your birthday off — plus a special gift from us
Work From Home
  • Home office allowance to set up your ideal workspace
Community & Culture
  • Two paid Social Impact days each year to give back to causes you care about
  • Frequent team and company social events, both in-person and virtual
  • Dog friendly office

If this sounds like something you’ve been looking for, we’d love to have you. Come on, join our village!

raw.description:
Description

Fullpath by Cox Automotive is a fast growing tech company in the automotive space with hubs across the US and Israel. We are disrupting the multi-trillion dollar transportation industry with our advanced Customer Data Platform (CDP) . Our work happens in the fast lane as we bring AI-powered, data-driven solutions to a quickly evolving industry.

Our team at Fullpath is made up of curious and creative individuals who are always looking to achieve the impossible. We are bold, collaborative, and goal driven, and, at our core, we believe every voice has value and can impact our bottom line.

If you are a creative, solutions oriented individual who is ready to put your career in drive, Fullpath is the place for you!

We are seeking a dynamic Director, Retail Sales to work side by side with our Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) in their territories to drive pipeline growth and ensure consistent quota attainment. This is a hands-on field leadership role: you will develop and mentor RSMs and their teams, coach them through every stage of the sales cycle, and ensure all revenue KPIs and metrics are met. You will also recruit and train new RSMs and collaborate cross-functionally to enhance market awareness and achieve revenue goals.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background of progressively responsible experience, a proven record of consistent quota attainment, strong management of sales performance metrics, a vast network in the automotive industry, and exceptional communication and leadership skills. They excel in data-driven decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and SaaS sales, with a proven ability to teach and execute all stages of the sales process. A high level of accountability, ethical standards, and professionalism is essential for success in this role.

This is a remote role reporting to the Head of National Sales with significant travel across the US required.

﻿The salary range listed reflects total on-target earnings (base + variable/commission). Please refer to the compensation details at the bottom of the posting for the full breakdown of base salary and variable structure.

What you will be responsible for

  • Partnering with Regional Sales Managers in their territories, in person and on site, to drive pipeline growth and ensure consistent quota attainment.
  • Developing and mentoring RSMs and their teams, equipping them with both tactical and strategic sales approaches through field coaching, joint prospect meetings, and ongoing feedback.
  • Owning the delivery of all revenue KPIs and metrics, ensuring targets are met and holding teams accountable to them.
  • Driving the achievement of annual financial performance targets by providing strategic sales leadership and clear vision.
  • Leading and supporting all aspects of the sales cycle, including lead generation, prospect cultivation, territory management, and prospect meetings.
  • Conducting weekly pipeline and forecasting reviews, providing coaching on effective sales strategies to ensure deal closure.
  • Recruiting, onboarding, and training new Regional Sales Managers to build a high-performing sales team.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Customer Support and Customer Success to ensure client satisfaction, build pipeline, and support revenue goals.
  • Tracking and optimizing all individual performance goals, ensuring accountability and alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Traveling significantly into the territories to work directly with RSMs, Cox Automotive team members, and key dealer partners.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible work experience, with management experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of consistent quota attainment, effective pipeline management, and completion of sales-related activities, with the ability to coach and develop individual contributors to achieve the same.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Extensive network and established relationships within the automotive industry. • Dynamic and energetic leader who employs a data-driven approach to drive business growth and team development.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with multiple business units to achieve organizational objectives.
  • Demonstrated expertise in articulating and teaching all stages of the sales process, including prospecting, demonstrations, and negotiations.
  • Strong sense of accountability and unwavering commitment to ethical standards and professional excellence.
  • Willingness and ability to travel significantly into the territories, including domestic travel by plane; valid driver’s license.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods and perform extensive computer work, both of which are key aspects of this role.
  • Ability to perform job duties from a home office, when applicable, utilizing necessary technology and maintaining productivity.
  • Regular, reliable attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the job to ensure consistent workflow and communication.
  • Drug Testing: To be employed in this role, you'll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Why you should join us

  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Learning and growth opportunities within a fast-paced tech startup environment
  • An awesome team of forward-thinking, innovative go-getters
  • A family-friendly atmosphere
  • An opportunity to represent top-notch AI technology that solves our customers' challenges

﻿Annual base starting salary: $100,000 - $120,000, depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. On target earnings (base + variable) up to $260,000, with overachievement possible.

Benefits Options: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D, EAP, flexible time off (take as much paid vacation as you deem consistent with your duties and company needs), 7 paid holidays, up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually, additional paid time off for bereavement, voting, jury duty, volunteering, military leave, and parental leave, & 401k with company match.

In the meantime, you can get to know us a little better by checking out @lifeatfullpath on Instagram and Facebook.
