raw.description:
Manager, Sales Effectiveness
Department: Sales & Marketing
Reports To: EVP, Sales & Marketing
Location: Remote

POSITION SUMMARY
As the Manager of Sales Effectiveness, you are the engine that drives our street-level execution. In our lean, high-growth FTTH environment, we don't need a corporate presenter who just points at PowerPoint slides; we need a gritty, hands-on trainer and operational executor who gets in the trenches. You will be the trusted advisor to our sales force, wearing two critical hats: running the daily enablement lifecycle, from onboarding fresh Door-to-Door (D2D) and Inside Sales reps to coach them to their first sale, and executing strategic sales campaigns, SPIFFs, and market-rollout plays. Armed with field data from platforms like Spotio and Terros, you will identify exactly where our reps are struggling on the doors or phones, fix their pitches in real-time, and drive penetration in every neighborhood we light up.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Sales Enablement & Field Training
  • Execute the Onboarding Lifecycle: Run and refine our 30-60-90 day onboarding program for D2D and Inside Sales representatives. The #1 metric is decreasing time-to-first-sale through relentless roleplay, FTTH product education, and objection-handling drills.
  • Drive Tech Stack Mastery: Ensure 100% adoption of our field sales tool (Terros). Train reps to accurately log dispositions, drop pins, manage their daily turf, and prevent "pencil-whipping" so ops receives clean, actionable data.
  • Support Frontline Supervisors: Act as the ultimate wingman to our Sales Supervisors. Help them run structured 1:1s, conduct highly productive field ride-alongs, and show them how to coach reps out of slumps instead of just closing deals for them.
  • Continuous Education & Competitive Intel: Deliver ongoing, punchy training sessions on competitive intelligence. Teach our reps how to perform "bill teardowns" on the doorstep to counter legacy cable (exploding promos, upload bottlenecks) and DSL (copper unreliability).
Sales Programs & Campaign Execution
  • Implement SPIFFs and Contests: Execute data-driven SPIFFs that align with immediate company goals—whether that’s driving the highest take-rate in a newly lit fiber hood, reviving "dark doors," or pushing multi-gig tier adoption.
  • Support the Inside Sales Motion: Work directly with the Inside Sales team to refine call scripts, speed-to-lead cadences, and objection handling for inbound calls and warm leads.
  • Execute MDU Penetration Plays: Roll out specialized D2D tactics to accelerate sales and drive high-density subscriber growth in Multi-Dwelling Units with secured Right of Entry (ROE) agreements.
  • Drive the Re-connect Program: Train the team to execute targeted win-back campaigns, utilizing inside sales dialing and D2D door drops to recover non-pay disconnects and seasonal churners.
  • Deploy Demographic-Specific Initiatives: Train the field on our Home Tech Program, empowering reps to capture older demographics by leading with intuitive streaming education, cord-cutting confidence, and whole-home Wi-Fi solutions.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • 3-5 years of experience in B2C telecom, ISP, or FTTH sales, with a deep, practical understanding of direct sales motions (Door-to-Door and Inside Sales). You must have knocked doors or dialed leads in this industry.
  • Operational Fluency - High proficiency in D2D canvassing and territory management software (Spotio, Terros, SalesRabbit, etc.) and modern CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho). You must know how to read a turf map and spot where reps are skipping houses.
  • Proven Trainer - Track record of delivering sales playbooks, running energetic training classes, and coaching reps one-on-one in a fast-paced environment.
  • Influence Without Authority - Exceptional ability to hold reps and supervisors accountable to coaching metrics and operational standards without being their direct boss.
  • Data-Driven Mindset - Ability to translate raw door-knock data, contact rates, and conversion metrics into immediate, actionable coaching moments.
JOB DETAILS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Moderate Travel – 25%: Ability to travel regularly for activities such as out-of-town meetings, trainings, projects, client meetings, or outreach activities up to 25% of the time.
    • Employees in this category travel regularly, but not extensively. They may visit clients, projects sites or attend meetings in different locations on a regular basis but typically do not need to be away from home for extended periods of time. Some travel may require the employee to work weekends or holidays.
  • This position requires the ability to sit and work at a desk for extended periods of time, using a computer and other office equipment.
  • This position requires the ability to perform fine motor tasks, such as typing or using a mouse, for extended period of time.
  • The schedule for this position is Monday through Friday during normal business hours, with weeknight and weekend availability as needed to fulfill the core duties of the role.
  • This position is Remote.
  • This is an Exempt position.
  • This is a staff position.
COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
  • The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $75,000 – $90,000 per year. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity. For Colorado-based applicants, the pay range and benefits listed above apply in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act.
  • 4 Medical plans with employer contributions for employees and dependents
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Life Insurance and AD&D
  • Voluntary Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan + employer match
  • 15 PTO days, 9 paid holidays + 2 floating holidays
ABOUT VERO
Vero Fiber was formed to fill a need in unserviceable and underserved communities where access to affordable, reliable broadband simply does not exist. Our goal is to bring the highest quality fiber optic-based broadband services to these communities. In addition, Vero strives to enhance communities by becoming an active partner in these communities by adding jobs, supporting local causes, and helping improve the connectivity of schools and rural healthcare as well.

NOTICES
Vero participates in E-Verify. Vero will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. For more information about E-Verify, please visit:
  • This position requires the ability to pass a standard background check upon offer of position.
  • At least 2 professional references are required.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Vero Fiber is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact to request one.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

Role Overview

Lumen is seeking highly technical, product-minded Senior Lead Applied AI Scientists to design, build, deploy, and continuously improve production-scale AI solutions of all varieties: agents, generative, ML, etc. In this role, you will partner with business, product, engineering, and technology leaders to translate high-value opportunities into AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

You will combine deep expertise in AI and machine learning with strong software engineering, experimentation, and product delivery skills. The ideal candidate is a hands-on practitioner who can rapidly prototype, evaluate, and scale AI systems while helping stakeholders navigate technical and business tradeoffs.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and optimize AI solutions from concept through production deployment.
  • Partner with business and product teams to identify opportunities, define success metrics, and validate value through rapid experimentation.
  • Develop advanced AI systems leveraging machine learning, generative AI, retrieval, predictive modeling, and agentic architectures.
  • Define evaluation frameworks and continuously improve quality, reliability, safety, performance, and cost.
  • Partner with Engineering to deliver scalable, production-ready solutions using MLOps and LLMOps best practices.
  • Contribute reusable frameworks, evaluation assets, and technical standards that accelerate AI adoption across the enterprise.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance on complex AI initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Seven Plus years of experience in applied AI, machine learning, or data science, including production AI deployments.
  • Proven track record of delivering AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, predictive analytics, and modern AI techniques.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM, RAG, agentic, and machine learning solutions.
  • Strong experience with AI evaluation, model performance optimization, responsible AI, and production monitoring.
  • Proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, MLflow, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, cloud AI platforms, APIs, and software engineering best practices.
  • Strong product mindset, problem-solving skills, and ability to communicate complex concepts with technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  • One plusyearsofexperience building agent basedsolutions.
  • Experience operating enterprise-scale AI solutions in regulated or security-sensitive environments.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional AI initiatives.
  • Contributions to AI research, patents, publications, or open-source projects.

Join Lumen’s AI Office and help build the next generation of AI solutions that transform customer experiences, accelerate innovation, and create measurable business value.

Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

About the Role

As Principal Architect for AI Security, you will define and lead the security architecture strategy for our AI platform, products, and infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to shape how a fast-moving organization thinks about security at the intersection of machine learning, cloud infrastructure, and product delivery. You will operate as a technical authority — influencing roadmap, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering with leadership to ensure our AI systems are trustworthy, resilient, and defensible.

What You'll Do

Architecture & Strategy

  • Define the end-to-end security architecture for AI/ML systems, including training pipelines, inference infrastructure, model storage, and APIs.

  • Develop and maintain a threat model for AI-specific attack surfaces: model poisoning, adversarial inputs, prompt injection, model inversion, and supply chain risks.

  • Lead design reviews for high-impact systems, setting standards for secure-by-default AI development.

  • Own the AI security roadmap, aligning it with product goals, compliance requirements, and industry best practices.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as an authority on AI security decisions across engineering, product, and research teams.

  • Partner with ML engineers to embed security controls throughout the model lifecycle — from data ingestion to deployment and monitoring.

  • Drive adoption of zero-trust principles, least-privilege access, and defense-in-depth across AI infrastructure.

Governance & Compliance

  • Translate evolving AI-specific regulations (NIST AI RMF) into actionable architectural requirements.

  • Partner with legal, privacy, and compliance teams to ensure AI systems meet internal policies and external obligations.

  • Produce executive-ready security assessments, risk summaries, and mitigation plans.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a bridge between security, platform engineering, data science, and product management.

  • Represent the organization in external forums, customer security reviews, and industry working groups.

  • Contribute to open-source tooling, publications, or speaking engagements to build the organization's credibility in AI security.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in information security, with at least 5 years focused on cloud or platform architecture.

  • Deep hands-on expertise in securing ML/AI systems, including LLMs, training pipelines, and model serving infrastructure.

  • Demonstrated experience with AI-specific threat vectors: adversarial ML, data poisoning, model extraction, and prompt injection.

  • Proficiency in cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and audit logging.

  • Strong background in application security, cryptography, and secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC).

  • Experience leading architectural decisions in a large-scale engineering organization.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain complex security risks to both engineers and executives.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks: NIST AI RMF

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or cloud security specializations.

  • Published research, conference talks, or open-source contributions in AI/ML security.

Additional Information

  • This position pays between $148,800 - 223,200 based on experience and geographical location.

  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

About the Role


As a Product Marketing Specialist, you will play a crucial role in understanding market trends and customer needs to help shape our product strategies. You will work closely with the Product Marketing team to develop and implement effective marketing campaigns aimed at capturing key customer segments. Your analytical skills will be essential for understanding and responding to market changes, helping position our products for success.


Responsibilities


  • Contribute to go-to-market plans for new products, releases, and promotional initiatives.
  • Gather and synthesize customer, market, and competitive insights to identify trends, needs, opportunities, and risks.
  • Support audience segmentation, personas, customer journeys, and use-case development.
  • Draft and refine product positioning, value propositions, messaging, presentations, and marketing collateral.
  • Translate product capabilities and customer benefits into clear, audience-focused communications.
  • Track marketing metrics and present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate cross-functional reviews and activities to support alignment and launch readiness.
  • Support sales training, business-case development, and pricing analysis in partnership with senior team members and Finance.

Skills


  • Market and Customer Analysis: Applies research techniques to interpret customer, market, and competitive information.
  • Data Interpretation: Synthesizes data and communicates clear findings and recommendations.
  • Content Development: Drafts concise, audience-focused marketing content and presentations.
  • Project Coordination: Organizes priorities, timelines, stakeholders, and review cycles.
  • Collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and related teams.
  • Tools: Working proficiency with Microsoft Office, relevant CRM, Excel, AI tools, PowerPoint, and marketing platforms.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 3+ years of experience in product marketing, marketing, market research, or a related function.
  • Work experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Phar or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, analytical, research, and organizational skills.

Client Solutions Strategist

Help healthcare organizations turn complex revenue cycle challenges into stronger performance and better patient support. As a Client Solutions Strategist, you will guide home infusion, ambulatory infusion, and specialty pharmacy clients through practical, data-driven improvements. You will partner with leaders to reduce risk, improve reimbursement, strengthen operations, and build solutions that support long-term growth.

CarePathRx is part of Evernorth, the health services division of The Cigna Group. Together, we bring ambitious thinking, compassionate partnership, and deep expertise to the organizations and patients we serve.

Position Summary

The Client Solutions Strategist provides strategic leadership, operational expertise, and consulting services to healthcare organizations specializing in home infusion, ambulatory infusion, and specialty pharmacy services.

This position is responsible for advising clients on all aspects of revenue cycle management (RCM), business office operations, reimbursement strategy, financial performance, and operational optimization. Key responsibilities include comprehensive revenue cycle assessments, financial modeling, payer contract evaluations, system implementation advisory, workflow redesign, and the development of sustainable operational improvements.

Client Solutions Strategist partners with client leadership and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, mitigate operational and financial risks, improve revenue cycle performance, and implement strategies that support organizational growth.

The role also provides strategic guidance for technology implementations and optimization initiatives, including Epic Willow Home Infusion, Epic Resolute Professional Billing, CareTend, and other infusion management platforms.

Client Solutions Strategist contributes to the organization's advisory strategy, business development efforts, and industry thought leadership.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Conduct revenue cycle assessments to identify operational inefficiencies, reimbursement risks, and opportunities to improve financial performance.
  • Analyze financial and operational KPIs, industry benchmarks, and trends to develop actionable recommendations.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in infusion reimbursement, payer requirements, billing operations, and revenue cycle optimization.
  • Support process improvement initiatives, including workflow redesign, standardization, automation, and development of best practices.
  • Provide revenue cycle guidance during system implementations, conversions, and optimization initiatives, including configuration, testing, training, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business needs, resolve challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Develop project deliverables, operational assessments, executive reports, and recommendations to support client decision-making.
  • Maintain knowledge of industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Support client relationships, business development initiatives, and organizational growth through subject matter expertise and industry engagement.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum of 4 years of healthcare revenue cycle management experience, including 2 years in home infusion, ambulatory infusion, specialty pharmacy, or Durable/Home Medical Equipment (DME/HME) .
  • Strong understanding of reimbursement (preferably infusion) payer requirements, billing operations, denial management, and accounts receivable.
  • Experience evaluating operational workflows, analyzing performance metrics, and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop actionable recommendations and implement sustainable operational solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.
  • High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, finance, or a related field preferred.

Preferred

  • Experience providing consulting or advisory services to healthcare organizations.
  • Experience with Epic Willow Home Infusion, Epic Resolute Professional Billing, CareTend, or comparable infusion management systems.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, workflow redesign, testing, training, and operational optimization.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer reimbursement methodologies, and managed care contracting.
  • Experience developing executive reports, financial analyses, standard operating procedures, and operational recommendations.
  • Familiarity with healthcare automation, emerging technologies, and revenue cycle performance benchmarking.

raw.excerpt: What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you?  When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected.
raw.description:
What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you? When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the world’s leading research and advisory company, achieving consistent double-digit growth by steering clients toward the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else.

When you join Gartner for Chief Sales Officers (CSO), you’ll set your career on track for outstanding achievement with a company that knows no limits. Gartner Executive CSO Partners serve as trusted advisors to our members (clients) who are CSOs or SVPs of Sales from Global 1000 organizations and government agencies. In this role, you’ll be further expanding your knowledge of cutting edge research and trends in the sales function along with your own experience base and personal network.

Our Associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional career development as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team and remarkable clients, Gartner is where you want to be.

About this role:

The Executive Partner’s(EP) role is to serve as a trusted advisor to our senior-most Sales executive clients (Chief Sales/Growth/Revenue/Commercial Officers) and deliver exceptional value by orchestrating the full capability of Gartner (research, analysts, events and peer networking) to help each member-client, define and exceed their specific enterprise goals.

Executive partners work with clients to define develop, prioritize and/or critique sales strategies (including go-to-market) and tactics; develop and/or transform overall skills and capability within the sales organization; assist with the development and execution of functional elements like channel design, compensation architecture, etc; aggregate and deliver Gartner research insights on key initiatives, priorities, and implementations; and in general, becoming a trusted advisor for the SVP, EVP or CSO. The Executive Partner (EP) also partners with the client to develop and execute a workplan and timeline to deliver the client’s most critical initiatives. With the support of their EP, our clients are able to achieve their top and bottom line targets more quickly, cost effectively and with a higher assurance of success.

What you’ll do:

Relationship Management

  • The EP manages 20 to 30 senior executive member relationships and participates in account planning with Senior Client Managers and Senior Account Executives. These three individuals collectively and individually have responsibility for each assigned account.
  • The EP actively participates in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal.
  • The EP performs annual workshops for client member and leads CSO/SVP, Sales breakout sessions during annual Sales Forums.

Success is defined by:

  • Executing a smooth hand-off from the sales team
  • Regularly engaging the member in a substantive manner
  • Creating a complete member profile
  • Partnering with Sales, Research and Service to delight the client
  • Accurately identifying and documenting the member’s Mission Critical Priorities
  • Developing an engagement (value) plan for each client
  • Participating (with Sales and Client Managers) in quarterly account reviews
  • Preparing value-added on-site engagements and member meetings
  • Operational rigor in maintaining client activity in our CRM and scheduling systems

Sales and Sales Support

The EP is responsible for member retention and for contributing to growth through support of sales in prospect cultivation, account planning/development and value demonstration activities delivered through proof-of-concept (POC) engagements

Client Interactions

The EP is responsible for hosting and /or participating in periodic virtual member activities, including workshops,, roundtables and webinars (in collaboration with Gartner Research)

Research Support

The EP supports research activities, such as facilitating member participation in research studies or case panels. The EP will be aligned with and leverage Gartner research positions and initiatives as well as provide feedback from the member base to the research organization. The EP works with research analysts to develop and deliver CSO/SVP Sales relevant research.

Program Delivery

  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Gartner Sales strategy and Gartner Sales product deliverables.
  • Work with members to further their levels of Sales maturity through delivery of research, peer networking, and coaching.
  • Critique client strategies, guide clients in building their organizations, and assist in developing Sales strategies, establishing priorities, and planning for implementation around key Sales initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain working relationships with various internal groups to create a comprehensive, well designed sustainable set of key deliverables for clients (including targeted research, personal coaching sessions, scripted analyst sessions, involvement with appropriate events, etc.)
  • Direct and facilitate member peer group calls and/or meetings

What you’ll need:

Subject Matter Expertise

  • The EP must be a senior business executive and have demonstrated topic knowledge in developing and delivering overall Sales strategy, execution and performance improvement.
  • The EP will be an accomplished current or former SVP, EVP of Sales, CRO, CCO or CSO that has successfully led a sales function with a minimum addressable revenue base of $1 billion and a minimum headcount of 500 people within their Sales organization.
  • As a C-Suite executive, the EP must have a broad base of expertise that has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • The EP is responsible to retain clients in accordance with established Gartner Retention Metrics. In addition, to work closely with Sales to vet and close new business.

Other requirements

  • A university graduate (Masters preferred) with 10+ years' experience working as a SVP, EVP, CRO, CGO, CCO or CSO with an addressable revenue base of at least $1 billion and a team of at least 500 people within their Sales org.
  • An in-depth understanding of the Sales Function and the role of the CSO/CRO/CGO/CCO (including leadership, enablement, operations management, compensation, strategy and trends, use of metrics, etc.)
  • In depth understanding of the business value of Sales and the alignment of Business, Marketing and Sales strategies.
  • Critical thinking and problem solving skills to assess member situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business advice, and the ability to leverage
  • Appropriate (Gartner and other) resources to help clients achieve business results
  • Ability to lead and manage ambiguous situations
  • Candidates must have excellent interpersonal skills; with a healthy dose of humility and experience working with C level executives. This individual should have strong reflective listening skills and the ability to adjust to client cues and needs
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills and strong facilitation and presentation skills
  • Energetic
  • Sales savvy
  • Collaboration and team leadership
  • Sales and / or business development experience or ability with CXO level executives
  • Strong time/project management skills
  • Experience as a Gartner client is preferred

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

raw.description:
Director, Analyst, Sourcing, Contracts and Negotiations – Software Licensing/Salesforce

Remote US/EMEA

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. This Director role is focused on sourcing, contracts and negotiations for enterprise software and SaaS licensing, with deep emphasis on the Salesforce ecosystem. A Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishingInsights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to sourcing strategy, contract structure, negotiation planning, licensing optimization and software/SaaS commercial decision making via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and in-person or remote client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participatewith a diverse, global team of colleagues in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred

  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience

  • 8+ years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller.

  • 5+ years hands-on experience negotiating Salesforcerenewals (including deals within last 12 months) withexposure ideally to such areas asSales/Service Cloud, Gen AI licensing and negotiation (Agentforce, Einstein), Tableau CRM, Success Plans and industry clouds (e.g. Financial Services Cloud, Education Cloud, Marketing Clouds).

  • Subject matter expertise in Salesforcelicensing with particular focus on commercial aspects, software and cloud services market trends.

  • Experience with software license compliance risk assessment, management, and/or mitigation in a software audit context, particularly with Salesforce, is desired.

  • Experience negotiating with and managing other major vendors (e.g., AWS, Google, SAP, Microsoft, Oracle, or ServiceNow) is desired.

  • Executive presence; able to immediatelyestablish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrable excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. raw.title: IT Support Manager - Microsoft Managed Services
raw.excerpt: TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team.
raw.description:
TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team. The Support Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of an ITIL-aligned Managed Services team, delivering high-quality support across Microsoft cloud-focused solutions including Azure, .NET-based applications, Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

The role requires proactive ownership of support operations, identifying and addressing service risks, customer concerns, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets and potential escalations before intervention is required. The Support Manager is responsible not only for monitoring and reporting service performance, but for analysing trends and underlying issues, identifying risks and improvement opportunities, recommending appropriate actions and driving those actions through to completion. The role will ensure service stability, effective incident and problem management, high customer satisfaction and continuous improvement across service operations.

The role holder can work remotely, but the position is open to applicants in either Ireland or the UK only.

TEKenable is a leader in digital transformation, specialising in Microsoft cloud solutions and recognised for excellence in AI and Data. With a global presence and a remote-first policy, we deliver innovative managed services to clients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Service Coordination & Delivery

  • Act as the operational bridge between the Service Delivery Manager and functional delivery teams.
  • Ensure service levels, KPIs, and contractual obligations are consistently met.
  • Support the Service Delivery Manager in contractual compliance, reporting, and client satisfaction initiatives.
  • Serve as the point of coordination for internal teams, ensuring smooth communication between technical functions and service management.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reports, dashboards, KPI metrics and presentations for internal stakeholders, ensuring data accuracy and clarity.
  • Analyse service performance data to identify trends, underlying causes, risks and areas requiring action, providing clear recommendations rather than reporting metrics in isolation.
  • Engage with client operational stakeholders on service delivery matters, while the Service Delivery Manager retains responsibility for overall client relationship, governance, and commercial performance.
  • Participate in client service reviews, governance meetings, and operational reporting sessions alongside the Service Delivery Manager.
  • Provide service performance insights, trend analysis, and improvement recommendations to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships with client operational leads, ensuring alignment between business needs and service delivery.

Operational Ownership

  • Own day-to-day ticket operations including prioritisation, assignment, and SLA adherence
  • Own operational issues and escalations through to resolution, ensuring actions are clearly assigned, tracked and followed through to completion.
  • Proactively identify service risks, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets, customer concerns and potential escalations, taking appropriate action before management or customer intervention is required.
  • Manage backlog, ageing tickets, and escalation handling
  • Coordinate Major Incidents from identification through resolution, ensuring timely internal and customer communication, clear ownership of actions, and appropriate RCA and follow-up activities.
  • Ensure Problem Management activities reduce repeat incidents
  • Manage service delivery across multiple clients, balancing competing priorities and ensuring effective allocation of shared resources
  • Manage prioritisation between BAU support activities and minor enhancements (run vs change)
  • Establish and maintain regular ticket quality reviews, ensuring appropriate documentation, customer communication, troubleshooting, categorisation and adherence to agreed support processes.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor incident and request volumes, escalation trends, and service performance.
  • Provide input into dashboards, reports, and forecasting models to support proactive service management.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with the Service Delivery Manager and Director of Managed Services.
  • Ensure ITIL-aligned processes are embedded and followed across delivery teams.
  • Identify gaps in process adherence and recommend improvements.
  • Understand, comply with and actively promote adherence to ISO27001 and ISO9001 policies and procedures.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed services delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using Delivery Platforms (FreshService, Datadog)

Key Competencies

  • Proactive Ownership & Accountability – takes ownership of service operations, identifies risks and issues early, takes appropriate action and drives activities through to completion without requiring continual management intervention.
  • Leadership & People Development – able to motivate, coach, and manage diverse teams across geographies.
  • Process-driven mindset with attention to compliance and governance.
  • Collaborative leadership—able to influence without direct authority.
  • Analytical and Data-Driven Thinking – able to interpret service data, identify trends and underlying causes, assess risks and translate findings into meaningful insight and clear recommendations.
  • Resilience and adaptability in managing escalations and shifting priorities.
  • Continuous improvement orientation—always seeking efficiency and service quality gains.
  • Initiative & Tooling for Improvement – proactively identifies opportunities to enhance delivery and leverages automation, dashboards, and service management tooling (e.g., ITSM platforms, monitoring, reporting, and analytics) to drive measurable improvements in performance, transparency, and client value.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication – communicates clearly with customers, technical teams and management, and is comfortable challenging, escalating and influencing where appropriate.

Why apply

  • Remote-first flexibility anywhere from Ireland or the UK with global collaboration across Spain, Hungary, and UAE.
  • Industry-leading transformation challenges using Microsoft tech in AI, Dynamics, and Data solutions.
  • Professional recognition, including Deloitte Fast 50, Microsoft Business Applications Partner of the Year, and more.
  • Career growth through coaching, structured development, and international exposure.

Requirements

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed service delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using ITSM Platform

TEKenable's culture is built upon the values of resilience, heartfelt service, always striving and insatiable curiosity. You can learn more about our values at www.tekenable.ie. Candidates applying for this role need to be able to demonstrate how they have applied these values in other roles and how they'll contribute to them, should they be successful.

At TEKenable we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion as we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, disability, sexual orientation, generation, ethnicity, religion, family or parental status, neurodiversity or belief.

Hiring Process

Once you are successfully selected for interview a dedicated talent acquisition manager will reach out and arrange a short pre-screening call. We want to learn more about you and the experience you can bring to the position. The interview process will have 2-3 stages and we will work around your availability. You will the opportunity to talk with our recruitment team at various points throughout the process. All interview stages will be conducted remotely via video calls and arranged at a time that fits with your schedule. We will close the position once the role is filled.

Benefits

Remote working & sustainability - Experience the flexibility to work from Ireland or the UK, avoiding the stress of being stuck in car jams, saving valuable commute time to an office, while actively contributing to a lower carbon footprint and the fight against climate change.

Equipment - We'll set you up with a laptop and any other equipment you might need to get the job done.

Flexible working hours - Once pre-approved by line management, employees can benefit from flexibility around core business hours Monday to Friday.

Health & life Insurance - We offer a comprehensive health & life insurance to ensure your well-being and peace of mind.

Pension Scheme - A supportive employee pension scheme is offered to help you build a secure and comfortable future

Training & Development Support - We invest in your professional growth through structured learning opportunities, certifications, and career development pathways tailored to your role and ambitions.

Sports & Social Events - Join a vibrant community through regular sports activities, team outings, and social events that bring colleagues together and foster meaningful connections beyond work.

Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - Access confidential support, counselling, and well-being resources through our Employee Assistance Programme ,because your mental and emotional health matter just as much as your professional success.

raw.description:
Who We Are & What We Do:

Branching Minds’ mission is to empower all educators to effectively, efficiently, and equitably support the holistic needs of their students; and to create a path to academic and personal success for every learner. Already supporting over 2,000,000 students across 400+ districts from over 40 states, our vision is to be the most effective national K12 school district solution for achieving high-fidelity MTSS/RTI; consistently demonstrating our ability to save teachers' planning/documenting time, improve outcomes of our students, and eliminate achievement gaps.

We don’t play by the rules of traditional organizations. We get to be innovative in the solutions we develop for our partners and the way we conduct our business for ourselves. Branching Minds is also a Benefit Corporation. We prioritize mission alongside profit. We embrace self-management, transparency, collaboration, initiative, and making a difference in the world.

If using innovation to reimagine education in service of equity energizes you -- join our team!

The Calling:

Engaging the full scope of your skills, passion, and creativity in sales, you’ll get to build partnerships with district leaders and help them achieve student success for all learners.

We’re looking for an Account Executive who can succeed across the full sales cycle, from the first outbound touch to signed contract, and who takes ownership of building and advancing a healthy pipeline. You'll own new business with large K-12 districts in your territory and spend meaningful time in the field with prospects and customers.

Selling to school districts requires more than a great product. It takes curiosity, persistence, and the ability to understand complex challenges, connect our solutions to district priorities, and build a compelling case for investment. You’ll navigate multiple stakeholders, manage complex buying processes, and bring the strategic thinking and sales discipline needed to move opportunities forward and close business.

As part of the Revenue team, this role reports to the Director of Sales.

What You Will Achieve:

Keeping your pipeline full

  • Proactively identify and pursue new client relationships with large districts (10,000+ students in size) in your sales territory.
  • Book 1-2 new meetings of your own every week, whether through engagement in the field, email and phone outreach, or other creative approaches. You’ll also receive meetings from inbound leads and our Sales Development Representative, but you won’t succeed in this role without booking your own.
  • When your calendar is light in a given week, spend the majority of your working hours focused on booking meetings.
  • Start and finish your prospecting sequences and campaigns. No random acts of prospecting!
  • Consistently bring new ideas to your 1:1s with your manager: campaigns, sequences, territory trips, and conference ideas.

Winning complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Ask excellent discovery questions to understand prospect needs, challenges, and goals, and tie Branching Minds’ products and features directly to school and district pain points.
  • Strategically map accounts and engage with key decision-makers across multiple stakeholders.
  • Prepare thoroughly for every meeting and follow up promptly afterward.
  • Leave nothing to chance: set a scheduled next step on every deal, and work your pipeline in between scheduled meetings.
  • Develop accurate proposals and contracts that reflect both the client’s needs and the capability of Branching Minds, and negotiate and close with skill.
  • Consistently meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas, pipeline growth, and activity metrics.

Building relationships with district leaders

  • Spend ample time in the field with prospects and customers alike.
  • Represent Branching Minds at industry conferences and networking events to expand market presence and deepen industry knowledge.
  • Earn referrals. You’ll know you’re an expert relationship-builder when the district leaders you’ve sold to or spent time with refer you to their peers.
  • Work closely with Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure a smooth transition post-sale, high client satisfaction, and long-term partnerships within your accounts.

Executing with operational excellence

  • Manage your pipeline and performance independently, with a data-driven approach that uses key metrics to guide decisions.
  • Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date records of all customer interactions in HubSpot, including deal stages, close dates, qualification information, timelines, and next steps.
  • Quickly learn our product, our space, and the problems our buyers need to solve, and stay informed of industry trends and the competitive landscape.
  • Work independently, but never be afraid to ask for help if it increases the chances you win a deal.
  • Contribute to the refinement of sales processes, tools, and methodologies, and support the growth and development of other Account Executives on the Large Market team.

Requirements

Why We Want You:

  • 5+ years of K-12 ed-tech sales experience selling to public school districts.
  • You have prior experience as an SDR/BDR and succeeded. You know the power of prospecting and never feel above the work that made you successful.
  • A track record of moving up through the ranks (for example, SDR to SMB to large market) at a reputable K12, ed-tech company.
  • You bring a proven record of meeting or exceeding quota and closing deals with districts of 10,000+ students.
  • Demonstrated success in an outbound motion. You can describe in detail a specific campaign or approach that led to booked discovery meetings.
  • Experience engaging with senior district decision-makers, with a strong ability to build rapport and trust.
  • Strong organizational systems that let you consistently finish the sequences and campaigns you start, prepare well for every meeting, follow up on time, and manage your pipeline with limited supervision.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions effectively.
  • Experience using HubSpot or an equivalent CRM, and a commitment to keeping it accurate.
  • Comfortable traveling at least 40% to meet with prospects and customers and attend industry events (especially during higher-volume times of year like fall and spring).

Lucky Us If You:

(No biggie if you don’t)

  • Have experience selling RTI/MTSS, Analytics, or Assessment SaaS products

Interview Process:

If we are a match, you can expect a total of 3 steps in the interview process after the initial application

  • 30-minute initial conversation with the Director of Sales
  • 45-minute panel discussion with a member of Sales Team Leadership & a peer Account Executive
  • 30-minute final conversation with the Director of Sales

Benefits

What We Offer You:

  • Check out our Benefits & Perks
  • Fully remote!
  • An awesome, cross-disciplinary, mission-driven team solving meaningful problems that improves the lives of educators and students.
  • Compensation for this position ranges from $90,000 to $105,000 annually, based on experience, expertise, and geographic location, with additional bonus and commission opportunities for total on-target earnings (OTE) of up to $210,000.

Studies show that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented individuals tend to hesitate applying for jobs unless they meet all listed qualifications. At Branching Minds, we prioritize cultivating a diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture. Therefore, if you're passionate about the role but your previous experience doesn't perfectly align with every qualification in the job description, we still urge you to apply. You may be a strong fit for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

In Our Own Words, We Are...

Independent, Relaxed, Ownership, Flexibility, Always Learning, Casual, Adaptable, “Best Idea Wins,” Passionate, Dedicated, Very Capable/Competent, Efficient, Communicative, Welcoming, Caring, Scrappy, Friendly, Co-operative, Agile, Supportive, Principle-Driven, Respectful, Practical, Attentive, Funny, Self-Motivated, Silly Parrots.


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Branching Minds, a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace is one where everyone, regardless of their gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, sexual orientation or identity, education, professional and life experiences, disabilities, and abilities; feels valued and respected. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to continuing to create a diverse, inclusive and equitable environment.

Our Commitment to People with Disabilities

Branching Minds is committed to disability inclusion, and to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at

We are proud to be Great Place To Work® Certified™.

raw.title: JD Edwards Technical Functional Solution Architect
raw.excerpt: ERP Suites is seeking Solution Architects to design and lead the technical solutions behind our client engagements.
raw.description:
ERP Suites is seeking Solution Architects to design and lead the technical solutions behind our client engagements.
In this technical role, you will be responsible for the architecture of JD Edwards solutions, how systems are configured, extended, integrated, and deployed, and for ensuring those designs are implemented correctly through delivery.
Success in this role requires strong technical and functional knowledge. You must understand the business processes and the technology behind them so you can create, review, explain, and defend effective solutions.
Solution Architects at ERP Suites own the solution lifecycle from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, proposal development, technical design oversight, implementation guidance, and post-project review.

Key Responsibilities
Solution Architecture & Design

  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client business processes, objectives, challenges, and technical requirements.
  • Translate business needs into scalable, practical solution architectures and functional designs.
  • Design integrated solutions across enterprise platforms, including JD Edwards, Salesforce, AI technologies, and related business applications.
  • Evaluate solution alternatives by considering business value, implementation complexity, risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce solution architecture documents, workflow diagrams, technical specifications, and implementation roadmaps.
Client Engagement & Presales
  • Serve as a trusted advisor during presales engagements, helping clients identify the best solution for their business needs.
  • Facilitate discovery workshops and requirements sessions with executives, business users, and technical stakeholders.
  • Present solution recommendations with clear business and technical justification.
  • Support proposal development, project estimation, and implementation planning.
  • Set realistic expectations regarding project scope, timelines, costs, and delivery approach.
Delivery Leadership
  • Maintain architectural ownership throughout project delivery to ensure solutions are implemented as designed.
  • Collaborate with project managers, consultants, developers, and client teams to resolve design questions and implementation challenges.
  • Identify risks, technical constraints, and scope changes early, recommending practical solutions when adjustments are needed.
  • Review implementation progress to ensure alignment with architectural standards and client objectives.
  • Participate in post-implementation reviews and continuously improve delivery methodologies and best practices.
About You
You enjoy solving business problems just as much as technical ones. You're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and quickly understand how technology can improve business operations.
You communicate effectively with both executives and technical teams, translating complex concepts into language that builds confidence and trust. You take ownership of your work, make informed decisions, and remain engaged throughout delivery to ensure your solutions achieve the intended outcomes.
You thrive in consulting environments where every client presents a unique challenge and where your ability to think strategically, collaborate effectively, and adapt quickly makes a meaningful impact.
Qualifications:
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more JD Edwards functional areas, including supply chain, distribution, finance, or accounting.
  • Working knowledge of JD Edwards technical architecture.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and solution designs that development teams can use to build and implement solutions.

raw.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An AI Solution Engineering leader who is ready to lead teams that build reliable, production AI products for customer service. You lead engineering teams, including Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who integrate foundation models, RAG pipelines, agents, data services, and application components into products that customers and service employees use every day.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams will be embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You set the standard for how your team work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee AI product engineering programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across leads and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as resolution, average handle time, customer satisfaction, and adoption.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Lead delivery of production AI applications for service: conversational AI agents across voice and digital channels, human agent-assist copilots, knowledge assistants, interaction summarization and quality automation, and analytics agents that let leaders ask questions of their service data in plain language.
  • Hold your FDEs to production-grade standards: tested Python and TypeScript services, eval suites that catch regressions, observability, and clear cost, latency, and safety tradeoffs, so solutions run reliably after handoff.
  • Set engineering standards for how AI components work together, including RAG design, prompt and context engineering, evals and guardrails, model selection, and when fine-tuning is worth the investment.
  • Originate use cases with clients, prioritizing by measurable value and shaping engagements that ladder to a real product, not a proof of concept.
  • Turn conversation designs, customer experience journeys, and prototypes into production code, co-creating from early concepts and feeding back what data and model behavior reveal so the experience keeps improving.
  • Ensure what ships is secure, monitored, and responsible, partnering with specialists in MLOps, AI security, and responsible AI.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships, proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, and crafting proposals that win work our teams are proud to ship.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on the service AI products that matter most to clients, such as agentic customer service and analytics agents, advancing Song Service as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.
  • Strengthen relationships with AI and service platform partners to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow FDEs and the engineers around them, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across use case discovery & prioritization, story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify delivery patterns, eval suites, and reusable components, and feed field learnings back into our offerings to make delivery repeatable.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders. Experience should include:
    • A hands-on background moving AI products into production (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails).
    • Working fluency with the FDE technical stack, including LLM APIs across frontier and open-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral), agentic frameworks and MCP, RAG pipelines and vector databases, Python and TypeScript, REST and GraphQL integration, and model and prompt evals, so you can inspire and challenge your teams' technical designs.
  • Delivery experience on at least one enterprise agent platform in production, such as Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure, Google Gemini, or Databricks Mosaic.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.

Bonus points if you have:

  • A product-led mindset that connects AI and data work to product strategy and the design-to-product pipeline.
  • Experience leading delivery of conversational AI in production, such as virtual agents, voice bots, agent-assist copilots, and knowledge assistants, spanning conversation design, dialog and intent management, and LLM-based agents across voice and digital channels.
  • Experience embedding AI into contact center and CRM platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect, and into the workflows service agents use every day.
  • Experience with conversation intelligence, such as speech and interaction analytics, sentiment, and automated quality assurance, turning service conversations into insight at the enterprise level.
  • A track record of leading business development by shaping proposals, scoping programs, and presenting to clients in a way that builds confidence and closes deals.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to hold difficult conversations with senior client stakeholders, guiding them to outcomes that strengthen the relationship while setting expectations that protect our delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and influence cross-functional decision making.
  • Experience with conversational AI and agent platforms such as Google Customer Engagement Suite, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Salesforce Agentforce, or ServiceNow AI Agents.
  • A full-stack engineering background in web, mobile, or API development.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams spanning design, advisory, and technology, turning research insights and design recommendations into engineered solutions.
  • Experience working in management consulting or a professional services environment.
  • You contribute to external thought leadership, such as publishing POVs, speaking at events, or representing the practice in the broader AI community.

Talixo is the world's leading operator of pre-booked transfers, working with the biggest brands in travel. We partner with fleets in 1,100+ cities and 130+ countries worldwide to provide travellers with reliable, high-quality rides, making their journeys easier and more enjoyable, from door to door. Since 2012, we've been helping travel brands create more connected journeys, and we're looking for people willing to go the extra mile.
Operating across two key locations: Krakow and Berlin, our cohesive teams - IT, Operations, Fleet, Pricing, Sales, Finance and HR - drive technological innovation, operational excellence, and organizational development. With a shared focus on refining processes and enhancing technology while spearheading strategic growth initiatives, we seamlessly contribute to our collective success.

About

We’re looking for a proactive and strategic
Account Managerto drive growth and strengthen relationships with Talixo’s highest-potential Tier-1 partners. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, relationship management, and commercial execution, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment.

Experience in the travel or mobility industry is a strong plus, as the role involves collaborating closely with commercial, product, and tech stakeholders to unlock new revenue opportunities and ensure best-in-class partner satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Own & Grow Our Top Global Partners

Activate Growth

Drive Strategy & Innovation

  • 5–8 years of experience in account management, partner management, or business development, ideally within a B2B, travel, mobility, or tech-driven environment.You have experience managing large, multi-country accounts with complex commercial and operational setups.
