raw.description:
OutcomesAI is a healthcare technology company building an AI-enabled nursing platform designed to augment clinical teams, automate routine workflows, and safely scale nursing capacity.
Our solution combines AI voice agents and licensed nurses to handle patient communication, symptom triage, remote monitoring, and post-acute care — reducing administrative burden and enabling clinicians to focus on direct patient care.

Our core product suite includes:

● Glia Voice Agents – multimodal conversational agents capable of answering patient calls, triaging symptoms using evidence-based protocols (e.g., Schmitt-Thompson), scheduling visits, and delivering education and follow-ups.
● Glia Productivity Agents – AI copilots for nurses that automate charting, scribing, and clinical decision support by integrating directly into EHR systems such as Epic and Athena.
● AI-Enabled Nursing Services – a hybrid care delivery model where AI and licensed nurses work together to deliver virtual triage, remote patient monitoring, and specialty patient support programs (e.g., oncology, dementia, dialysis).
Our AI infrastructure leverages multimodal foundation models — incorporating speech recognition (ASR), natural language understanding, and text-to-speech (TTS) — fine-tuned for healthcare environments to ensure safety, empathy, and clinical accuracy. All models operate within a HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2–certified framework. OutcomesAI partners with leading health systems and virtual care organizations to deploy and validate these capabilities at scale. Our goal is to create the world’s first AI + nurse hybrid workforce, improving access, safety, and efficiency across the continuum of care.
The Role

This is not a traditional, script-reading outbound role. At OutcomesAI, the Business Development Representative sits at the intersection of pipeline generation, demand generation, and brand enablement.

You will be responsible for sourcing high-value enterprise pipeline through direct outbound outreach (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) while simultaneously creating marketing collateral, customer stories, and event promotions needed to effectively hit new pipeline targets.

Key Responsibilities

    Outbound Sales & Pipeline Generation
  • Execute multi-touch outbound cadences combining cold calling, personalized email sequences, video messaging, and LinkedIn networking to target decision-makers (VPs, Directors, and C-Suite leaders in Patient Access, Ambulatory Nursing and Clinical Contact Centers).

    • Collateral & Content Development

    • Brand Presence & Social Selling
  • Build and maintain a vibrant top-of-funnel presence on LinkedIn, positioning OutcomesAI as a thought leader in real-world AI implementation.
  • Monitor relevant industry discussions, communities, and competitor movements to identify emerging prospecting triggers.

What You Bring

    What You Bring

    Experience: 3–5 years of experience in B2B sales development (SDR/BDR), product marketing, growth marketing, or a hybrid GTM role—ideally within B2B SaaS, data/analytics, or artificial intelligence. Healthcare experience is a plus.

    Cold Calling Confidence: Demonstrated comfort picking up the phone, navigating gatekeepers, holding consultative peer-to-peer conversations with senior executives, and handling objections gracefully.

    Content & Storytelling Chops: Exceptional business writing and narrative skills. Ability to write clean, persuasive copy for cold outreach and case studies

    Tech Stack Familiarity: Hands-on experience with modern sales and marketing platforms:

    CRM: HubSpot or Salesforce

    Prospecting & Cadence: Zoominfo, LinkedIn, etc

    Builder Mindset: High agency, intellectual curiosity about applied AI, and comfort working in an evolving, high-growth environment where processes are actively being established.

About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We combine an optimised operating system with orchestration, management, automation, and protection to deliver mainframe-like efficiency, performance, reliability, versatility, and security—while reducing overall cost and complexity.

Our Virtuozzo Infrastructure System (V/IS) brings together compute, storage, and networking to support traditional applications, cloud-native workloads, and AI services. We help organisations modernise their infrastructure, make better use of their hardware, and bring new cloud- and GPU-powered services to market on their own infrastructure and under their own brand.

Our technology serves more than 100,000 companies in over 100 countries. With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue to contribute to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

The Role

Our team develops the V/IS and we are looking for Engineers to join our team. As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building new features, optimizing performance, and ensuring reliability in production environments. You will collaborate across the full stack of the product, from UI and REST APIs to cluster lifecycle management, virtualization, monitoring, and seamless product updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop new features for V/IS.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests to ensure high code quality.
  • Improve and optimise existing functionality for performance and scalability.
  • Provide support and maintenance for real customer environments.

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language: Python, Golang, C/C++, or Rust.
  • Deep understanding of Linux operating system architecture.
  • Solid knowledge of networking concepts.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex challenges.

Preferred Knowledge

  • Experience with hypervisors and container technologies.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems design and implementation.
  • Background in system programming.
  • Understanding of Windows, Linux, or FreeBSD kernel internals.
  • Proficiency with automation and infrastructure tools such as Ansible, Bash scripting, and Terraform.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Web development skills (JavaScript, HTML).

What We Offer

  • Remote and flexible work from European locations.
  • A collaborative engineering culture focused on deep technical challenges and real-world impact.
  • A chance to influence the design and evolution of a global-scale cloud infrastructure platform.
  • Professional development opportunities through training, certifications, and mentoring.
  • Group private medical insurance / medical allowance.
  • Employee/Contributors recognition programmes and incentives.
  • Referral programme bonuses.

The New Jersey Innovation Authority

The New Jersey Innovation Authority (NJIA) is looking for diverse and experienced team members to deploy world-class innovative and digital services that solve pressing public interest challenges for the people of New Jersey. Our work spans numerous issue and policy areas, and is focused on making an impact in the lives of the New Jerseyans that we serve. Our work has decreased the amount of time it takes to apply for Unemployment Insurance, made it easier to start, operate, and grow a business in the Garden State, and connected millions of New Jerseyans to government programs, services, and benefits.
Our team members wear many hats, contributing to both the execution of core projects and the evolution of NJIA. We use data and modern research, design, and development methods to inform our decision making, and we collaborate with stakeholders within and outside of government to understand and solve challenges. To learn more about NJIA read our impact report and visit our About Us page.

The Executive Director serves as a key strategic thought-partner, adviser, and operational collaborator to the New Jersey State Chief Innovation Officer, and as the chief executive of New Jersey Innovation Authority’s (NJIA) fiscally-sponsored partner project, InnovateNJ. Core responsibilities include oversight of InnovateNJ’s personnel, budget, finance, procurement, compliance, and day-to-day operations, while also playing a central role in the strategic support of NJIA’s work. The executive director will operate with significant autonomy, yet in close coordination with the Chief Innovation Officer and NJIA’s senior staff, and work closely with team members across the organization.

As a part of the team, your responsibilities may include:

Organizational Outcomes and Alignment: Supporting and driving organizational planning, advancement, outcomes and achievement

  • In close collaboration with the Chief Innovation Officer, work with initiative, project, and functional leads to set, communicate, measure, and reach organizational objectives and impact, and drive the implementation of approaches and tactics that ensure programmatic collaboration and coordination across programs, products, and practice areas.
  • Identify, obtain, and, oversee the management of InnovateNJ’s financial resources to ensure that adequate funding is available to advance the organization’s core mission, projects, and outcomes, and that funding is expended effectively, efficiently, and in alignment with all applicable rules, regulations, and policies.
  • Oversee and manage the design, implementation, and administration of InnovateNJ policies, processes, and activities that contribute to the continued advancement and evolution of the organization.
  • Coordinate with NJIA’s leadership to ensure internal communication and information flows so that the right information is reaching the right team members at the right time.
  • Represent InnovateNJ, as needed, with key organizational stakeholders across State government and externally.

Partner Project Governance: Serving as Project Director and primary liaison with InnovateNJ’s fiscal sponsor

  • Maintain effective coordination and communication between the InnovateNJ project and its fiscal sponsor, the National Center for Civic Innovation, to ensure seamless operations and compliance.
  • Ensure all program financial activities are conducted through the fiscal sponsor in full compliance with tax-exempt requirements, with proper documentation, approvals, and controls in place for expenditures and contractual commitments.
  • Establish and maintain a compliant workforce that adheres to fiscal sponsor personnel policies, ethical standards, and conflict of interest requirements, with appropriate approvals and documentation for all hiring decisions.
  • Secure and maintain positive donor relationships through compliant contribution processing, timely acknowledgments, and accurate reporting that meets both IRS and donor requirements.
  • Ensure ongoing alignment between InnovateNJ activities and fiscal sponsor policies, procedures, and mission requirements, obtaining necessary approvals for any programmatic changes.

Compliance and Regulatory Affairs: Navigating government, regulatory, and compliance processes and procedures to advance the organization’s mission and work

  • Ensure that all InnovateNJ activities are executed in a compliant manner, consistent with applicable laws, rules, regulations, and funding agreements.
  • Provide programmatic support to project teams to ensure that product and project goals and objectives can be met in a manner consistent with requirements.
  • In collaboration with NJIA leadership, guide project teams in navigating processes and requirements, and support the development of creative and sustainable solutions to challenges that inhibit the advancement of core initiatives and projects.

Organizational Talent: Ensure organizational talent needs are met

  • Oversee InnovateNJ’s efforts to identify talent needs, and attract and retain top-tier talent to advance the organization’s mission and objectives.
  • Work with team members to develop and advance practices that promote and encourage the healthy evolution of organizational culture.

Do what’s needed for the team

  • Execute additional duties and responsibilities to advance the organization’s mission and work.

Experience, Skills, and Abilities

    Applicants will be assessed based on a demonstrated ability to accomplish the above-discussed responsibilities. We are seeking individuals with the following experience, expertise, skills, and abilities:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience required, as is a demonstrated and deep commitment to public service and impact.
  • 5+ years of direct personnel oversight and management experience.
  • 3+ years of senior executive leadership experience in the non-profit or digital service delivery field, overseeing an organization or division of similar size and scope ($20MM operating budget, 75+ staff members, etc.).
  • Proven expertise in, and deep understanding of, government budgeting, policy and administration processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve diverse problems in highly ambiguous settings, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • A demonstrable ability to rapidly context switch, re-prioritize tasks, and address in-demand team and stakeholder needs with speed and agility.
  • Exceptional communication and people management skills with the ability to build, maintain, and grow professional relationships.
  • Demonstrated success in navigating government bureaucracies and institutions, operating in a highly-regulated environment, and achieving desired outcomes.
  • Experience with, and understanding of, innovation practices in government and/or large institutions, including the use of data to drive decision-making, and approaching problem-solving collaboratively and in an agile manner.
  • Willingness to be available as needed during off hours for occasional rapid/crisis response.
  • Ability to travel to Trenton, NJ with limited notice.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent required; advanced degree such as a J.D., MBA, or master’s degree in public administration, public policy, public finance or another field related to job responsibilities and qualifications is preferred.
  • Dedicated to advancing the mission of the NJ Innovation Authority and public service, with a strong commitment to accessibility and fostering a more inclusive society.

We welcome applicants from a broad range of backgrounds. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply. If you have any questions, please contact .

Compensation: Annual salary of $200,000 commensurate with experience. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid leave, and competitive retirement plan options, as well as other optional fringe benefits.

Hiring Entity: This role will be hired by InnovateNJ - a fiscally-sponsored partner project of the National Center for Civic Innovation that exists to advance NJIA’s work and impact.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer

We are deeply committed to the principles of equity, diversity, and inclusiveness and seek to create a pluralistic community for all. We strongly encourage people of color, members of racial and ethnic minority groups, women, LGBTQI+ people, those with disabilities, and Veterans to apply. We are committed to building a team that is reflective of New Jersey’s incredible diversity.
We do not discriminate against any candidate because of color, race, age, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, pregnancy, marital status, status as a parent, ancestry, national origin, disability (physical or mental), family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, retaliation, or other non-merit based factors.

Eligibility

You must be authorized to work in the United States. Candidates may be required to pass a background check and complete additional steps as part of the application and onboarding process. You will be considered an “at-will” employee, meaning both employer and employee have the right to terminate employment with or without cause or notice.

Role Overview

Encoura is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our One Stop and Help Desk offerings. These solutions enable colleges and universities to deliver accessible, responsive support to students, faculty, and staff across voice, chat, and digital channels. This role owns the evolution of a differentiated, scalable service experience—combining contact center operations, Amazon Connect (AWS Connect), AI-powered voice and chat assistants, intelligent self-service, and seamless human-agent support. You will translate institutional needs, operational insights, and emerging technology into a prioritized portfolio strategy, aligning engineering, service delivery, client-facing teams, and executive stakeholders around measurable improvements in customer experience, operational performance, and growth.

A Day in the Life

  • Own and communicate the One Stop and Help Desk product vision, strategy, multi-quarter roadmap, and prioritized backlog, balancing client needs, competitive differentiation, commercial opportunities, technical investment, and operational efficiency
  • Set product direction for Amazon Connect-based omnichannel experiences, including IVR, intelligent routing, queue management, agent desktop/workflows, integrations, reporting, workforce management, and quality assurance; partner with engineering on architectural tradeoffs and scalability
  • Lead the strategy and delivery of conversational AI across voice and chat—including virtual agents, knowledge-grounded answers, automated resolutions, intent recognition, escalation to human agents, and conversation analytics—with explicit quality, safety, and performance measure
  • Conduct market and customer discovery with higher education institutions, frontline agents, service operations, implementation, sales, and client success; map end-to-end service journeys and translate unmet needs into differentiated product opportunities
  • Define business cases, success metrics, and performance targets; own product-level accountability for CSAT, NPS, customer effort, digital containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, call abandonment, agent productivity, and SLA performance, in partnership with operating teams
  • Use contact center analytics, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, financial/operational data, and competitive intelligence to evaluate opportunities, prioritize investments, monitor AI accuracy and escalation effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement
  • Lead discovery through launch and adoption: define outcomes and requirements, guide UX and technical decisions, make scope and priority tradeoffs, ensure release readiness, and equip go-to-market, implementation, and service teams with positioning and enablement
  • Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without direct authority; proactively manage dependencies, delivery risks, vendor/platform relationships, and roadmap decisions while mentoring less-experienced product colleagues as appropriate

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you'll: Assess the One Stop and Help Desk business, customer segments, economics, service workflows, current roadmap, Amazon Connect architecture, AI capabilities, partner dependencies, and operational scorecard; establish relationships with key leaders and identify immediate risks and opportunities.
  • Within 3 months, you'll: Present a clear portfolio assessment, prioritized multi-quarter roadmap, and measurable outcome framework; align product, engineering, operations, and commercial leaders on strategic priorities, AI automation opportunities, and delivery tradeoffs; lead an initial high-value initiative.
  • Within 6 months, you'll: Be accountable for execution and demonstrated progress against agreed product KPIs; deliver and measure a material portfolio enhancement, advance the voice/chat AI and self-service strategy, and establish a repeatable process for customer discovery, roadmap governance, and post-launch optimization.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically 5+ years of relevant experience, including significant ownership of SaaS or technology product strategy and delivery; prior experience with contact center platforms, customer service technology, or managed service-enabled products strongly preferred
  • Deep understanding of contact center operations and service delivery, including omnichannel engagement, IVR, routing and queues, workforce management (WFM), quality assurance (QA), service-level agreements (SLAs), and reporting/analytics
  • Hands-on product experience with Amazon Connect (AWS Connect) or a comparable cloud contact center platform; able to make informed decisions about platform capabilities, integrations, vendor dependencies, architectural constraints, and total cost of ownership
  • Demonstrated experience launching or scaling conversational AI, chatbots, voice assistants, or automated self-service; understands knowledge management, speech analytics, conversational intelligence, agent handoffs, AI evaluation, and responsible deployment
  • Proven ability to define and improve measurable product and operational outcomes, including CSAT, NPS, customer effort, containment, AHT, FCR, self-service adoption, abandonment, agent productivity, and service quality
  • Strong product leadership skills in discovery, market assessment, strategy, business cases, roadmap prioritization, agile execution, stakeholder influence, and written and executive-level communication; comfortable using Jira, Confluence, and analytics tools
  • Sound commercial and technical judgment; able to work independently through ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, negotiate tradeoffs, and align diverse teams around outcomes rather than feature requests
  • Experience in higher education or EdTech is a plus; commitment to improving the student support experience and using AI to augment—not simply replace—effective human service
  • Successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a CLEAR™ identity verification as part of the pre-employment screening process
    • CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ

The annual base salary range for this exempt position is $160,000 - $175,000 andreflects the midpoint through maximum of the established range for this role. Encoura establishes compensation using national market data, internal equity considerations, and organizational budget factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization. Certain roles may also be eligible for variable compensation in addition to base salary.Employees in this role are eligible for Encoura’s comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other programs that support employee well‑being.

About  Us

Encoura’s mission is to empower students and institutions to create meaningful connections so everyone can make the most informed decisions to achieve their goals. Since 1972, the Company has evolved its products and services to better represent the link between students and higher education institutions and to create the highest probability of student success. 

Encoura’s expertise now spans enrollment, research, marketing, student success, and advancement and provides an unmatched combination of higher education experience and innovative solutions for colleges and universities. The Company also offers Encourage® — the nation’s largest free college and career planning program used by millions of high school students and educators nationwide. 

It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. All applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. 

Encoura endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability and need an alternative method for applying, please contact the Talent Team.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Backend Engineer on the Gitaly team, you’ll help build GitLab’s Git data storage tier, a standalone product that provides reliable, secure, and fast access to Git repositories through application programming interfaces (APIs) and storage operations. You’ll work at the boundary between GitLab and Git to make repository access performant and dependable for GitLab.com, self-managed customers, and GitLab Dedicated. Our work spans distributed storage, repository management, high availability, performance, observability, and operational excellence. We’re currently building the next generation of source code management (SCM), including new approaches to scaling Git storage and improving how repository data is managed and served.

You’ll balance roadmap delivery, technical improvements, customer and reliability work, and operational support. We value pragmatic engineering, thoughtful trade-offs, continuous improvement, and sustainable ways of working while operating a service that’s critical to GitLab. Learn more on the Gitaly Team Page.

What you’ll do

  • Own moderately sized to complex technical initiatives from problem definition and proposal through implementation, rollout, monitoring, and operational follow-through.
  • Act as the directly responsible individual for projects by aligning stakeholders, communicating progress and trade-offs, identifying risks, and keeping execution moving with minimal guidance.
  • Lead technical design for distributed storage, Git repository management, performance, reliability, and scalability problems, using data and benchmarking to guide decisions.
  • Partner with engineers and teams across GitLab, including Git, Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, Dedicated, and customer-facing teams, to deliver cross-functional outcomes.
  • Improve engineering practices through mentoring, documentation, knowledge sharing, design reviews, and constructive code reviews.
  • Take operational ownership of the systems you work on, including incident response, post-incident improvements, capacity and performance analysis, and customer escalations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve work beyond an individual change through automation, reusable designs, better dashboards, upstream contributions, and improvements to development and testing workflows.
  • Respond to user emergencies, platform alerts, and support requests, including regular on-call duties.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant professional experience building, debugging, and optimizing distributed or highly available software systems in large-scale production environments.
  • Experience owning complex projects end to end, including technical design, execution, rollout, and operational support.
  • Strong systems design skills and the ability to reason about performance, failure modes, consistency, concurrency, capacity, and observability.
  • A track record of influencing technical decisions and working effectively with stakeholders across teams and disciplines.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, improving team practices, and raising the quality of designs, code, testing, and documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and make trade-offs clear.
  • Professional experience with Go or another backend or systems language.
  • Experience operating production systems, participating in incident response, and turning operational learnings into durable improvements.
  • Experience with Ruby, Git internals, gRPC, or Git server infrastructure is highly desirable.

About the team

The Gitaly team includes Backend Engineers who share ownership of the product’s design, implementation, reliability, and customer outcomes. We work autonomously while collaborating closely through design discussions, code reviews, incident response, documentation, and asynchronous communication. Engineers are encouraged to take ownership as directly responsible individuals, seek input early, make decisions transparently, and share knowledge across the team. raw.description:
Role Title: Medical Oncologist

Role type: Contract

Location: Remote, United States only

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Required Skills:

  • Medical oncology

  • Clinical documentation

  • Ehr systems

  • Ai-generated clinical note review

  • Solid tumor management

About the role: In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient oncology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.

What you'll do:

  • Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.

  • Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).

  • Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to cancer diagnoses, staging, treatment plans, and laboratory or imaging findings.

  • Assess documentation of systemic cancer therapies, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and supportive care.

  • Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, disease progression, and follow-up care.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications:

  • MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Medical Oncology.

  • At least 2 years of recent outpatient medical oncology experience following fellowship.

  • Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing solid tumors, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.

  • Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.

  • Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.

  • Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.

  • Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.

  • Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process:

  • Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.

raw.title: Director, Quality Engineering
raw.excerpt: HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care.
raw.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.

Essential Job Duties

  • Enterprise Quality Leadership: Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
  • Standardize Testing Processes: Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
  • Tooling Ownership: Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
  • Automation Strategy: Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
  • Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:
  • Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
  • Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
  • Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
  • Security & Compliance Testing Support: Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
  • Customer UAT Support:
  • Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
  • Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
  • Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
  • Quality Metrics & Reporting: Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
  • Shift-Left Quality Practices: Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
  • Incident & Defect Management: Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
  • Organizational Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
  • Release Governance: Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
  • Coding agent advocacy: Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.

Other Job Duties

  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

Travel Requirements

  • Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
  • 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
  • Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
  • Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
  • Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
  • Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
  • AI/ML fundamentals: Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.
The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.
This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.
HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

It’s an exciting time to join HiBob. Salesforce is leading a $166 million investment in the company, supporting our vision to bring trusted people context into the AI-powered enterprise. As we accelerate our product, technology, AI, and innovation roadmap, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape what comes next.

HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people, giving HR and managers all they need to connect, engage, develop, and retain top talent. Since 2015, we've achieved strong and consistent growth, powered by a global team building one of the most modern HR platforms in the market.
Our platform is intuitive, data-driven, and built for the way people work today: globally, remotely, and collaboratively. Companies around the world rely on Bob to create better employee experiences and drive business outcomes.

As part of this evolution, HiBob is expanding into the Office of the CFO. The Finance Tech unit is building an AI-native FP&A product from the ground up: planning, forecasting and modeling on top of the people and financial data our customers already trust Bob with.

We're looking for a senior product manager to join the Finance Tech unit and help build HiBob's FP&A product line. You'll own a core area of the product, such as planning and modeling, data management, or the agentic layer. You'll take it from early concept to customer value, working hands-on with engineering, design and data.
This is a greenfield role with broad scope. It needs strong product fundamentals, real curiosity about how finance teams work, and comfort building in an evolving space where AI is changing what planning software can be.

East Coast location is strongly preferred, though we’re open to exceptional candidates based elsewhere in the U.S.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do
  • Own a key area of the FP&A product end to end, from discovery and definition through launch and adoption

raw.title: Product Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: Who Are We? Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants.
raw.description:
Who Are We?

Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program. Our CEO, Zach Goldstein, was named to Nation's Restaurant News 2026 Restaurant Tech Power List.
Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural "core behaviors" with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say "Thanx" Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

Who Are You?

You're a product marketer with an editor's eye. You like talking to customers, and you care about words and the details of positioning at a fine grain. You can read a one-pager an AI agent produced and spot the claim that's slightly wrong, the competitor detail that's out of date, or the line that doesn't sound like us. Then you fix the agent so it doesn't happen again, not just the page.
You use AI every day, and you work in Claude Code. That's the expectation here. You've already built something with it that other people use: a skill, an agent, a workflow, a review checklist. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be precise about what good looks like and unrelenting in making sure the customer's voice comes through at high quality.
You care about accuracy and volume. Agents let one person ship a lot, and you hold every piece to the same bar, so reps never have to double-check what you send them. You notice a gap and fill it before anyone assigns it to you.
You're curious. You keep up with how restaurants and their guests are changing, especially as AI reshapes what operators expect and how they talk about their problems, and you can't help bringing what you learn back to the team.
Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.

Position Overview

Thanx ships a lot. Our customers do interesting things with the platform. A brand switches from another loyalty platform and more than doubles the share of guests it captures. A chain turns on RecoveryAI and wins back guests who had a bad experience before they're gone for good. A franchise system moves digital orders away from a third-party ordering vendor and onto its own app, and cuts its discounting while visits go up. That work only counts if the market, our prospects, and our own teams understand it.
Product marketing at Thanx runs on AI agents. Our competitive intelligence hub reads every competitor's public documentation and drafts comparisons and one-pagers. Other agents draft release notes, build case studies from a single customer interview, and write enablement. The agents do the first draft of most assets. Your job is everything around the draft: the planning, the inputs that go in, and the review before anything ships.
That's this role. You own the work that gets Thanx credit for what we've built: the steady drumbeat of customer communications, case studies, and the information sales, CS, and partners need. You make sure what our agents produce is accurate, on-message, and in front of the right person at the right time, and you tune the agents so each draft needs less of your time. You also own our competitive content in search and AI answer engines, so that when a restaurant brand asks ChatGPT or Google how Thanx compares, the answer is right.
This is an individual contributor role. You report to the VP of Marketing and Partnerships and work day to day with sales, customer success, product, design, and partnerships.

How We Work With AI

With great power comes great responsibility.” Uncle Ben

AI has changed what a day on this team looks like. Investigating an issue used to mean pulling data from several systems by hand. Now an agent can gather the evidence, and your time goes to figuring out what it means. We build our own monitors, lookups, and triage tools, and we expect everyone on the team to build, not just use them.
These tools are wrong often enough that you have to check the numbers and question the first explanation before anything reaches a merchant or a colleague. That part is still your job.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan the work and set up the inputs.Decide what gets made and when, based on the launch calendar, what sales is running into, and where our proof is thin. Give each agent what it needs to get the draft right: the customer interview, the source data, the messaging, and the goal the asset has to hit.
  • Review and approve what our agents produce. Case studies, one-pagers, competitive comparisons, release notes, and enablement all pass through you before they reach sales, customers, or the public. Check every claim against its source, and make sure it matches our messaging and how we want to show up as a company. Review high-stakes assets line by line; spot-check routine ones and widen the check when you find a problem.
  • Tune the agents.When an asset is wrong, fix the cause: the instructions, the examples, the source data, or the quality checks. Keep a running log of the errors you catch, and use it to cut the review each asset needs over time.
  • Customer lifecycle communications.Own our customer lifecycle comms program: every email that goes out to our customers, from onboarding and feature announcements to the monthly product newsletter, plus release notes, customer webinars, and the promotion around them. We ship fast, and your job is to make sure customers know what we've released and start using it. Release notes go out within 48 hours of release, every channel stays on schedule, and emails are measured on the feature activation they drive, not open rates.
  • Voice of the customer and the market.Stay close to what customers and operators are saying, and to how the market is changing as AI reshapes what restaurants expect from their technology. Bring it into the company, to product, sales, CS, and the exec team, and back out as content that earns attention: the stories, points of view, and formats that get operators reading, watching, and sharing.
  • Case studies and proof.Run case study production start to finish. Interview newly launched customers and the internal teams behind them, find the compelling angle, and validate the data. Our case study builder turns one interview into a web page, PDF, sales slide, and social-ready content; you make sure every version is accurate and worth reading.
  • Get sales, CS, and partners the right information at the right time. Know what a rep needs at each deal stage and against each competitor, and make sure our competitive and product hubs deliver it where they already work, before they have to ask. Keep CSMs informed on customer launches so they can speak to them with other customers. Track what gets used, retire what doesn't, and close the gaps you hear about on calls.
  • Customer-win content. Keep a steady flow of customer-win and launch content ("this brand launched this week, here's why it's interesting") for internal channels, partner channels, and our social team to publish.
  • Competitive content for SEO and AEO. Write and publish the comparison and alternative content that wins bottom-of-funnel searches and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Claude, and Google's AI Overviews. Work with Growth on which queries to target and how to measure results.
  • AEO-ready help center. Make sure our public help center articles answer the questions buyers and AI engines actually ask: clear questions, direct answers, current facts, and the context for when and why to use a feature, not just how. Embed video where it helps, and find stale or missing articles before a prospect or a competitor does.

How We Will Know It's Working

At six months:you're shipping high-quality content at volume: release notes, the newsletter, webinars, case studies, help center updates, and competitive pieces, without hand-holding and without anyone needing to double-check it. Customers hear about what we release as we release it, even at the pace we're shipping. You know which features have the biggest gap between value and adoption, and you have campaigns running against them.

At twelve months:customers know what we've released and how to use it, and it shows: adoption of the features you've focused on has moved meaningfully in the right direction. Your output has grown while the quality bar has held, because the agents you tune need less review than when you started. Your content draws an audience: operators read, watch, and share it. Our competitive content ranks and gets cited by AI answer engines for the queries that matter.
We'll measure you on three things: the quality and volume of what you ship, whether customers know what we're releasing, and whether adoption moves.

What We’re Looking For

We don't believe in rigid requirements, but success in this role typically involves:

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS, including 2-3 years in product marketing, content marketing, customer marketing, or a closely adjacent role.
  • A sharp editor's eye for factual accuracy, tone, and claims you can defend.
  • Hands-on, daily use of Claude Code, with something you built or improved that other people use. You don't need to be an engineer.
  • SEO or AEO content experience: you know how comparison and alternative pages win, and how AI answer engines choose what to cite.
  • Experience conducting customer interviews and finding the story inside them.
  • A track record of working productively with sales and customer success, and of getting them information they actually used.
  • Experience running a customer lifecycle email program or other recurring customer communications, such as a newsletter, webinar series, or release notes, and shipping on schedule.
  • Experience with LaunchNotes, Ortto, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional teams you don't manage, and presenting to executives.
  • A habit of keeping up with your market and turning what you learn into content people actually seek out.
  • A structured approach to quality, such as rubrics, checklists, and spot-checks, rather than relying on gut feel.
  • Comfort with video and multimedia formats, not just written content.
  • Restaurant, retail, or hospitality technology experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Compensation:

US - Tier 1

$137,000 - $155,000USD

US - Tier 2

$127,000 - $146,000 USD

US - Tier 3

$126,000 - $138,000 USD

Leveling & Location:

Thanx uses structured internal leveling and location-based compensation. Final leveling and compensation are determined through the interview process based on experience, scope, and work location, and any offer will align with the appropriate range.

Application Process:

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening or assessing applications; human review will always remain part of the process.

Ready to change your life? Apply now!

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Thanx will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with local requirements.

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves:

As a Senior Project Manager on this account, you will keep a national telecommunications client’s network facilities powered, cooled, and ready to grow. You will deliver the larger and more complex capital projects behind that work: power systems, backup generation, HVAC, fire and building automation systems, and space preparation in technical facilities and central offices across the region. You will lead each assigned project as the client’s Owner’s Representative, directing the designers, contractors, and vendors and working with the client’s network, operations, and real estate teams. You will be a trusted technical and delivery partner to the client, and a resource to JLL colleagues on the account. You will join a JLL team that values collaboration, supports each other’s wellbeing, and creates room for career growth.


What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Delivering projects: Manage multiple concurrent projects, including large and complex capital work, from kickoff through commissioning, closeout, and handover.
  • Leading the project team: Lead the design professionals, contractors, and vendors on each assigned project. Set expectations, coordinate the work, and hold the team accountable for quality and schedule.
  • Technical leadership: Review and approve engineering drawings and specifications. Confirm designs meet client standards and fit network equipment installations. Resolve complex technical and coordination issues with minimal guidance.
  • Contractor and vendor management: Prepare RFPs and manage selection with Sourcing. Monitor contractor performance, quality, and compliance.
  • Stakeholder management: Serve as a primary working contact for network field engineers, operations, and real estate personnel. Raise issues early and keep your manager informed.
  • Planning and risk: Build and maintain schedules, keep a risk register, control scope, and manage change orders across your portfolio.
  • Budget and cost management: Prepare, submit, and track budgets and forecasts. Reconcile invoices against work performed and close out project financials.
  • Reporting and improvement: Provide accurate status updates and reports in the client’s required format. Recommend process improvements that make delivery more efficient.
  • Looking ahead: Share what you learn about upcoming facility needs with the JLL account team.
  • Safety: Follow JLL and client safety requirements, and ensure projects meet health, safety, and environmental standards.

Some travel to job sites within the assigned region is required, up to 30% of the time.


Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or [eight] or more years of work experience.

raw.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As the General Manager for Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology (CMET) at Toptal, you will be the visionary architect of our growth strategy in this dynamic industry. We’re seeking a hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial spirit who can inspire and scale a world-class team to drive exponential growth in our enterprise customer base.

In this high-impact role, you will collaborate with Senior Leadership to unlock transformative market opportunities and identify the highest-potential avenues for value creation. Your strategic insight and foresight will be pivotal in shaping the future of Toptal’s presence in the CMET landscape.

You will lead from the front, rolling up your sleeves to work directly with your sales team in forging and nurturing relationships with Fortune 500 companies. Your ability to strategically target and close deals will be integral to our success, positioning Toptal as a leader in the industry.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving growth, a knack for crafting compelling strategies, and the ability to execute at the highest level, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Define strategy & execute tactics to acquire key target prospects while deepening strategic relationships with CMET portfolio clients.
  • Cultivate relationships with Senior leaders at accounts in your team’s portfolio.
  • Leverage your professional network connections to expand reach within your industry.
  • Develop hypotheses to drive the team’s Go-to-Market Strategy and expand Toptal’s presence within Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • Develop & prioritize industry-specific offerings in alignment with Category Service Leaders
  • Evaluate and evolve the team’s short-, medium-, and long-term plan to establish Toptal as the leading provider of professional services in the enterprise space.
  • Develop account prioritization criteria and work with members of the team to optimize account portfolios and engagement strategies.
  • Develop account plans and relationship maps by leveraging industry insights.
  • Lead a team of experienced Sales & Client Services professionals to expand Toptal’s professional services market share within the Communication, Media, Entertainment, and Technology industries.
  • Regularly meet with Sales Director & CMET team members to review KPIs, provide guidance to increase deal velocity, evaluate performance, and develop coaching plans.
  • Lead with both inspiration and accountability, establishing clear performance standards, providing direct feedback in real time, and driving execution through focused, consistent coaching.
  • Actively recruit new members to join our rapidly growing team

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Learn our sales method and our selling process.
  • Meet the team and understand targets and goals.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Build your initial GTM strategy for CMET in partnership with Services GMs, iterating based on feedback from clients while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Get up to speed on your industry territory and understand priority focus areas at the portfolio level
  • Develop a performance cadence with the team to review key metrics (e.g., activity, conversion, etc.) and identify specific areas for improvement.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Roll out a focused industry strategy to align the team around clear goals, tactics, and go-to-market priorities across the CMET.
  • Scale growth with existing clients and have a defined strategy to procure high-potential net-new clients.
  • Engage with services stakeholders to develop coordinated strategies designed to accelerate and diversify growth while strengthening client relationships.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Secure initial traction within the CMET sector by closing new enterprise logos and expanding opportunities with existing clients, laying the groundwork for accelerated growth.
  • Assess current team structure and capabilities, making necessary changes to ensure the right team is in place to support near-term opportunity and long-term growth goals.
  • Establish clear team and individual performance objectives, aligning efforts around pipeline generation, sales velocity, and account development to drive early momentum.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Achieve quarterly and annual growth objectives by setting clear performance expectations across the team, leading business reviews, and coaching through deal cycles.
  • Demonstrate your ability to coach and develop the team to achieve ambitious goals while continuously improving pipeline health, close rates, and exceptional client outcomes.
  • Expand the team’s portfolio by securing five or more new Fortune 500 clients, deepen relationships with existing clients, and promote growth through Toptal’s suite of offerings.
  • Partner with Toptal Leadership to design and operationalize a 12-month growth plan for CMET through focused industry segmentation, strategic account targeting, and effective resource alignment.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in Professional Services, including 5+ years leading sales teams in Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • 5+ years of in-market experience running and managing an industry business unit. Must have current, deep industry relationships at the leadership level within CMET.
  • Experience establishing high-impact, revenue-generating commercial relationships, with a proven track record of success in building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Minimum of 10 years experience building client portfolios of $20M+ with a blended team of hunters and farmers
  • A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and the ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
  • Recent experience selling large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • P&L experience with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Skilled at fostering positive internal relationships to align stakeholders, build consensus, and drive forward key strategic initiatives.
  • Experience at a technology or hyper-growth company is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in an operationally rigorous environment with competing deadlines and fast-paced work product turnaround.
  • Ability to thrive and excel in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  • Professional maturity, solid EQ skills, and executive presence – you’re an adept storyteller with experience building long-term client relationships and influencing senior-level buyers.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to travel and engage with Toptal clients both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. This position will work with engineering, product, and customer enablement teams to validate new functionality, verify system integrations, and support the delivery of production-ready solutions that meet Government-approved requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) certification or comparable software testing credential.

Our employability rate among graduates is 87% across our Full Stack Development, Quality Assurance (QA) and Data Analytics.

We are now looking for a Customer Reputation Specialist to join our LATAM team!

This role focuses on managing, de-escalating, and resolving critical and high-friction student issues across the LATAM market. You will be responsible for handling sensitive student cases, mitigating reputational and legal risks, and negotiating effective solutions while ensuring an empathetic and positive student experience.

Your main goal will be to protect the company's reputation, prevent further escalation, and reach fair and effective resolutions for students and the business.

Please submit your updated resume or CV in English.

What you will do

As a Customer Reputation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing complex student complaints and high-risk cases, communicating directly with students, and coordinating with internal teams to achieve timely and effective resolutions.

Main responsibilities will include:

  • Case Analysis: Thoroughly investigate escalated cases, understanding the context, background, and specific circumstances of each student complaint.
  • Student Communication & De-escalation: Contact students directly through calls and written channels, build rapport, actively listen to their concerns, and de-escalate high-friction situations.
  • Conflict Resolution & Negotiation: Negotiate and mediate agreements with students, aiming to reach mutually acceptable solutions and prevent further escalation, including legal claims, formal complaints, or negative social media exposure.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential reputational, legal, and business risks and take appropriate action to minimize their impact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams to investigate cases, align on solutions, and ensure timely resolution in accordance with company policies.
  • Documentation & Follow-up: Maintain accurate records of case progress, agreements, communications, and outcomes, ensuring proper follow-up until resolution.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in customer service, customer retention, escalations, complaints management, or high-touch customer support roles.
  • Proven experience handling difficult customers, high-conflict situations, sensitive complaints, and complex customer escalations.
  • Experience managing sensitive cases involving potential legal action, formal complaints, legal claims, or reputational risks.
  • Familiarity with handling public customer complaints, social media escalations, and situations involving threats of negative brand exposure.
  • Outstanding active listening and communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive and difficult conversations.
