raw.title: Director, Government Pricing
raw.excerpt: Role OverviewMedispend's government pricing business is growing, and this is the senior addition that allows it to scale.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Medispend's government pricing business is growing, and this is the senior addition that allows it to scale. The Director, Government Pricing is accountable for the accuracy, compliance, and timeliness of government pricing, Medicare, and VA/federal program deliverables across our client portfolio — and for building the capability of the team that produces them.

This is a hands-on role. You will personally perform the most complex calculations and historical corrections, approve client-ready output, and make the regulatory determinations behind both. You will hold approval authority alongside the Senior Director, and extending that depth across the team is a priority — we are targeting three qualified approvers within twelve months.

We deliver these services as a managed service to pharmaceutical manufacturers, predominantly small and mid-size companies without the scale to build government pricing depth in house, so you will be a senior client-facing figure as well as an internal leader.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical execution and regulatory authority

  • Personally perform complex calculations, variance analyses, and historical corrections across AMP, Best Price, URA, PHS/340B ceiling price, ASP, NFAMP, and FCP.
  • Develop and approve calculation methodologies and reasonable assumptions jointly with the Senior Director, ensuring positions are defensible, documented, and consistently applied.
  • Interpret CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program regulations and guidance — line extension, 5i versus standard AMP treatment, brand, generic and authorized generic classification, baseline AMP, prompt pay treatment, and UPPS reporting.
  • Determine transaction eligibility and treatment across AMP, Best Price, ASP, and NFAMP, including returns, chargebacks, rebates, administrative fees, bona fide service fee exclusions, and class of trade.
  • Own program-level positions and approve submissions for Medicare (Part B ASP reporting and certification, Part B inflation rebate, Part D Manufacturer Discount Program) and VA/FSS (65IB, NFAMP, FCP, IFF, quarterly VA sales reporting, TRICARE).
  • Lead historical recalculation and remediation engagements end to end — scope, correction methodology, liability impact, client communication, CMS change requests, and resubmission approval.
  • Review bona fide service fee eligibility and fair market value support, including PBM administrative fee structures, and determine their Best Price, AMP, ASP, and NFAMP implications in partnership with Legal.
  • Monitor CMS, HRSA, and VA policy developments and translate new requirements into calculation, reporting, and system changes.

Review, approval, and quality

  • Review and approve client-ready deliverables across all programs in scope, applying consistent quality control standards and internal controls.
  • Establish a tiered, risk-based review framework so review depth matches exposure, and maintain a documented sign-off record.
  • Monitor CMS, VA, and client deadlines across the portfolio, resolve capacity constraints before they threaten a deadline, and investigate root cause whenever an error reaches a client.

Building capability

  • Manage, coach, and develop Government Pricing Analysts and Team Leads — setting priorities, allocating workload, and ensuring coverage across competing deadlines.
  • Develop at least one additional qualified approver from within the team inside twelve months and develop the Medicare and federal program leads to independent ownership of their programs.
  • Establish and maintain a documented position log of regulatory determinations, alongside methodology documentation, SOPs, and review criteria.
  • Lead technical development, performance management, succession planning, and hiring for the team.

Client partnership, commercial support, and operating performance

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex client issues and disputed results, lead quarterly business reviews, and explain calculation outcomes and rebate liability exposure to client Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders in clear business terms.
  • Support Sales and Account Management with scoping, statements of work, and level-of-effort estimates, and advise clients on Medicaid inflation penalty exposure and proposed WAC increase impacts.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs and service-level targets — timeliness, exception and rework rates, backlog aging, and team utilization — and manage to project budgets and account-level cost to serve.
  • Build the business case for automation and partner with IT, Product, and Development on government pricing logic, configuration, and calculation testing.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
  • 10+ years of pharmaceutical government pricing experience, the majority gained inside a manufacturer or in a role directly accountable for manufacturers' reported prices and certifications.
  • Personal, hands-on ownership of AMP, Best Price, and URA methodology and calculation — not oversight alone. This role performs the work as well as directing it.
  • Deep expertise in the Medicaid Drug Rebate Program, PHS/340B ceiling price, and federal pricing requirements, sufficient to review and approve any calculation the team produces.
  • A record of establishing, documenting, and defending reasonable assumptions and regulatory positions that withstood audit or client scrutiny, including multi-period historical recalculations and corrected CMS submissions.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare Part B ASP reporting and certification, the Part D Manufacturer Discount Program, and VA FSS 65IB contracting, NFAMP, FCP, and IFF obligations.
  • 3+ years leading analysts or technical staff, with a demonstrated record of raising people's technical capability — not only managing workload.
  • Experience with government pricing platforms such as iContracts, Model N, IntegriChain, EVERSANA, Vistex, or comparable solutions, and advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and compliance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Managed services, consulting, or outsourced provider experience supporting multiple pharmaceutical manufacturers.
  • Experience in a smaller or scaling organization where process, documentation, and controls had to be built rather than inherited.
  • Experience building a methodology or regulatory position library used by a team, and establishing KPIs, service-level targets, and quality metrics.
  • Experience advising on line extension, 5i treatment, authorized generic relationships, class of trade, and UPPS corrections.
  • Working knowledge of Public Law pricing compliance and Trade Agreements Act (TAA) requirements.
  • Experience applying AI or automation tooling to regulatory research or calculation workflows, and working proficiency with SQL, Power Query, Alteryx, or comparable data tooling.

What we provide:

  • Merit-based compensation – Competitive base salary plus bonus
  • Work from anywhere – Roles are open to candidates located anywhere in the US (United States)
  • Unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off), including Paid Holidays and Sick Leave
  • 401k+ Match
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Health and wellness perks including life & disability insurance, healthcare funding options like FSAs (Flexible Spending Accounts) and HSAs (Health Savings Account), Dependent Care, an EAP (Employee Assistance Program) program, discounts, Learning and Development

Working Conditions/Physical Demands:

This position is fully remote, with limited travel that may be required for occasional team meetings, training sessions, or business events. Work is performed primarily in a home-office environment using standard office equipment such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone. Employees are expected to maintain a safe, ergonomic, and confidential workspace with reliable high-speed internet access suitable for professional remote work.

The role generally requires extended periods of sitting, viewing a computer screen, and communicating through written and verbal means. Occasional light physical activity (e.g., lifting materials or equipment up to 20 pounds) may be necessary.

Reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable laws to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. Employees working remotely must ensure their workspace meets company standards for safety, ergonomics, and data security as outlined in organizational policy.

Disclaimer: This job description identifies the general duties and minimum level of skills required to perform this job. It is not intended to represent a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned.

Notice for all applicants: we are seeking a permanent full-time employee, this is not a contractor position.

Notice for Colorado and Washington applicants: In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, the expected annual base salary for this role is $150,000–$200,000, plus eligibility for bonus and benefits.

Medispend is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

This role leads the development and delivery of multi-channel marketing and stewardship communications designed to educate, inspire, and move donors, prospects, and volunteers along the giving journey, from early interest through sustained engagement.

This role requires a highly organized, self-directed communicator who can translate complex giving concepts into clear, compelling content while leading multiple initiatives simultaneously and collaborating across teams.

Integrated Donor Communications & Journey Management

  • Plan and lead multi-channel donor journeys incorporating direct mail, email, web, social media, newsletters, and virtual experiences to support both prospect nurturing and ongoing donor engagement.

Content Development & Production Leadership

Email, Digital & Web Strategy

Events, Webinars & Engagement Experiences

Analytics, Optimization & Reporting

  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality of data within projects and areas of responsibility.

Internal Communications & Collaboration

  • Experience in a communications, marketing, or public relations role, with a national scope preferred.
  • Experience leading communications, project management, and editorial planning.
  • Experience working with volunteers and donors, with a working understanding of fundraising.
  • Highly organized, with a proven track record of leading complex projects, multitasking, and setting priorities.
  • Strong writer with excellent written and verbal communication skills, adaptable to a variety of media.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and with context.
  • Self-motivated and able to work with limited supervision.
  • Solid computer skills with the capability to master new software applications and technologies. Excellent skills in Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint required.
  • Ability to engage all major, principal, and planned donor types, and to collaborate with partners across departments and/or teams.
  • Experience producing work for and/or with senior leadership and/or executives.

raw.title: Digital Content Specialist - Website & Social Media
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityWe are hiring a Digital Content Specialist to help us tell those stories well and tell them consistently.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

We are hiring a Digital Content Specialist to help us tell those stories well and tell them consistently. You will interview our engineers, turn their work into thought leadership and project features, and keep kpff.com current. You will manage the website content calendar and contribute the project stories, employee spotlights, and video assets that feed our social channels. You will work day -to-day with our communications team, web developer, regional marketing teams, and engineers across the country.

This is a new role. The person who takes it will help shape what it becomes.

What You Will Do

  • Manage the website content calendar. Build and maintain the editorial calendar for kpff.com, tracking topics, subject matter experts, and publish dates so content moves on a steady rhythm.
  • Establish the process. Help establish the intake process for thought leadership, content standards, and workflows for our content as it moves from office to publication.
  • Interview our engineers. Sit down with structural and civil engineers across our offices, ask good questions, and turn their expertise into blog posts and project features that speak to our clients and our peers in the industry.
  • Keep the website current. Maintain project pages, news, people pages, and thought leadership content so the site reflects the work we are doing right now.
  • Support thought leadership. Work with firm leadership to identify the topics where KPFF has expertise worth sharing, then coordinate the content that puts our people forward as the experts they are.
  • Produce employee spotlights. Tell the stories of the people behind the work, from new graduates to principals, in support of recruiting and firm culture.
  • Coordinate video. Plan and shepherd video content for project and people highlights, working with internal staff and outside videographers. You will oversee the production process rather than edit the footage.
  • Feed the social calendar. Supply project stories, spotlights, photography, and video to the communications team, who owns the social media calendar, and make sure each piece arrives with the context and assets it needs.
  • Support Office touchpoints. Serve as a consistent content contact for Reporting Centers, gathering material and keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Partner with the web developer. Publish finished content in the right format with the right images, tags, and metadata.
  • Help carry the national brand. Support a consistent KPFF voice, look, and standard across all 36 offices, whether the content originates in Seattle or Nashville.
  • Track performance. Monitor traffic and engagement on published content, report on it clearly, and use what you learn to shape the calendar.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experience. Three or more years in content, editorial, communications, or marketing, with writing samples you are proud to share.
  • Curiosity. You are comfortable walking up to a busy engineer, earning their trust quickly, and finding the detail that makes the story. Interest in how things get built matters more here than a technical background.
  • Strong writing and editing. You can take a dense technical explanation and make it clear while keeping it accurate. Our readers are engineers, architects, contractors and owner clients who know the difference.
  • Organization and follow-through. You have run an editorial calendar before. You chase down contributors, hold deadlines, and move work through review.
  • Digital fluency. Hands-on with a CMS (WordPress preferred), comfortable with SEO fundamentals, and current on LinkedIn and Instagram as professional channels.
  • Video coordination. You have organized shoots, managed vendors, or produced short-form video for a brand.
  • Collaboration. Much of this role is earning time and material from people who do not report to you. That takes patience, persistence, and a good sense of humor.
  • Travel. Much of this work happens virtually, but the best stories often mean being there. Expect regular travel to KPFF offices and project sites to connect with engineers in person, as well as attending firmwide events such as the Winter Convention and the P&A meeting.
  • Education. Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, marketing, English, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry, or another technical professional services environment
  • Familiarity with photography direction and digital asset management
  • Basic design skills in Adobe Creative Suite or Canva
  • Experience working across a distributed, multi-office organization

Why KPFF

KPFF is a collaborative, people-centered organization that values connection, curiosity, and long-term growth. In this role, you will help shape how the firm adopts one of the most significant technology shifts of our time — responsibly, practically, and in a way that empowers our people.

If you enjoy building order out of ambiguity, supporting people, and turning strategy into everyday practice, we’d love to hear from you.

Work Environment and Flexibility

This is a work-from-home position, not a location-independent position. Candidates must be based in the United States and able to work standard business hours aligned with the Pacific or Mountain Time Zones. Team members who live near a KPFF office may have the option to work onsite or in a hybrid arrangement. Occasional travel for team meetings, recruiting activities, and office visits may be required.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • Primarily a work-from-home role requiring prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, and participation in virtual meetings.
  • Requires a reliable internet connection and a professional environment appropriate for virtual meetings and candidate conversations.
  • Regular use of standard office technology, including a computer, headset, phone, and video conferencing tools.

Benefits and Compensation

We believe that supporting our people goes beyond the work itself. That’s why we offer a flexible, comprehensive benefits package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Benefits include:

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer contribution
  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Life insurance
  • KPFF Paid Family Leave
  • Short-term and Long-term disability insurance
  • Paid Holidays (including two Floating Holidays)
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, jury duty)

Compensation & Recognition

The expected range for a qualified candidate is $78,000 – $95,000. Additionally, we offer performance-based bonuses to recognize and reward outstanding contributions in each Reporting Center. During the interview process, we'll address any questions you may have about the overall compensation package and benefits.

Work Authorization

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

KPFF Consulting Engineers participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

KPFF Consulting Engineers is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, ethnicity, national origin, religion, marital status, sex/gender (including sexual orientation or gender identity), pregnancy, veteran status, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, or any other protected basis.

At KPFF Consulting Engineers, we are more than just an engineering design firm. For 65 years, we have dedicated ourselves to innovative, sustainable engineering that shapes the built environment and tackles complex infrastructure challenges. Our team culture emphasizes balance, growth, and well-being, supporting each member’s professional journey with flexibility, generous benefits, and a collaborative approach to work-life integration.

With over 1,500 professionals across 36 offices nationwide, KPFF’s decentralized structure allows each office the flexibility to pursue projects aligned with their regional strengths.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI or agent-based products
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences or other regulated industries

raw.description:
This role may require in-person interview/s.

About Osano:

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Senior AI Engineer to build and improve Osano AI, our intelligent privacy assistant. As part of the Osano AI team, you will take capabilities from first idea to production, with an emphasis on delivering capabilities that are reliable, measurable, and trustworthy.

This role goes beyond wrapping APIs or building chat interfaces. We are looking for an engineer who has shipped LLM-powered systems that real users depend on. That means that you’ve dealt with hallucinations, latency, cost, evaluation, and tricky edge cases within agentic systems, and you know what it takes to keep these non-deterministic systems working after launch.

You will often work on problems that aren’t well-defined. Success here depends on how you think, communicate, and work with others as much as on what you build. This position is ideal for someone who is highly technical, thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of 0→1 initiatives, wants to have an outsized impact, and believes responsible AI is non-negotiable.

Responsibilities:

Build and ship production AI

  • Design, build, and maintain agentic features across our products, from early prototype to scaled production deployments.
  • Build retrieval (RAG) systems that build trust through verifiable sources.
  • Build agentic and multi-step workflows with guardrails, observability, and structured outputs.
  • Balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost in production.

Measure and improve AI systems

  • Build thorough evaluation frameworks that cover accuracy, grounding, latency, and reliability, utilizing both offline evaluations and real-world production signals.
  • Deploy data-driven methods to decide what to ship, how to fix it, and what to stop doing.
  • Continuously refine deployed systems based on measurable outcomes.

Collaborate and communicate

  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, privacy experts, and other stakeholders to decide what to build, how to build it, and why.
  • Write clear design documents and run effective technical discussions.

Privacy-First Development

  • Embed privacy-by-design principles across the AI stack.
  • Ensure compliance, data sovereignty, and secure handling practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to align AI capabilities with regulatory standards.

About You:

  • You’re curious, self-directed, and motivated to learn quickly.
  • You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and creating clarity for others.
  • You’re excited about privacy, responsible AI, and building trustworthy technology.
  • You are willing to relentlessly pursue the best, most responsible ways to leverage AI—without overselling its capabilities or ignoring its limitations.

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering or AI/ML experience
  • Demonstrated experience building and running agentic systems in production with real users, not just prototypes or internal demos.
  • Deep technical understanding of LLM usage and orchestration beyond prompt engineering.
  • Proven experience building complex RAG systems and autonomous AI agents.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Concrete examples of getting from ambiguity to results.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Strong expertise in the Python AI ecosystem, including FastAPI and LangGraph.
  • Experience with Knowledge Graphs to enhance RAG precision
  • Familiarity with Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs)
  • Experience with data anonymization techniques
  • Background in compliance-heavy or regulated environments

Why Us:

  • We're a welcoming team that's dependable, curious, moves fast, and full of talented people
  • We're a B-corporation with a mission that matters, in a high-growth space with significant potential
  • You'll have access to our training program, well-defined career paths, and a leadership team that values professional development

Benefits:

  • Competitive-pay compensation and ownership interest/equity
  • Unlimited paid time off, plus a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year
  • We're a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents
  • Osano sponsors individual premiums on base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance via Aetna
  • A fully and permanently remote company, so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Receive a MacBook and $600 to craft your home workspace
  • Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and fun
  • Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness and talk therapy services

A Bit More About Osano

Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest.

We’re backed by top-tier investors including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work.

As we grow, we're looking for individuals who lean into modern technologies and smarter systems to drive efficiency, clarity, and speed; both in our product and in how we operate. If you're excited by the idea of helping build a high-growth, privacy-first company that embraces thoughtful automation, emerging tech, and intentional collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Osano is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Position: Senior Editor, Analytics

Position Type: Full-time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy)

Location: Remote within Canada The Company: Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

Postmedia is looking for a Senior Editor, Analytics to join the National Product and Strategy team. A senior editor within the National Product and Strategy team is a newsroom leader who partners with multiple editorial teams across the company to elevate journalism, strengthen content strategy, and support transformative initiatives. Our Senior Editor, Analytics will translate audience data, market insights, and analytics into actionable editorial recommendations and work with newsroom leaders to build a data culture.

This role blends editorial expertise, strategic thinking, and data-informed decision-making. You’ll work closely with editors, reporters, product teams, and audience specialists to help newsrooms develop and achieve their goals. This is an ideal role for an experienced editor who excels at collaborative problem solving, thrives in complex environments, and can guide diverse teams through both quick-turn and long-term initiatives.

What you’ll do:

Act as the primary point of contact between our analytics department and newsrooms. Advocate for data-driven approaches to inform story decisions, improve page views and grow reader engagement. Work with newsroom leaders to develop a data culture; help make journalists aware of the value of data and how it can support their work. Develop and lead workshops on how to use data to make decisions. Help set key performance indicators. Build and monitor reports with KPIs and results. Analyze audience data, identify trends, and provide timely recommendations that contribute to informed journalistic decisions. Write clear and concise memos and strategic briefs on data-informed opportunities for newsrooms.

Who you are:

You have a minimum of five years of newsroom experience, with knowledge of analytics and audience strategy. You are confident in your abilities to dig deep into the numbers - you thrive in a world of spreadsheets. You understand how to use data to troubleshoot or highlight new opportunities. You are comfortable working with a variety of stakeholders in high-pressure situations. You are a collaborative teammate who is not afraid of trying new things or having difficult conversations. You believe in a people-driven culture, supported by data.

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Base Salary: $75,000-$90,000

raw.description:
The Technical Architect will serve as the technical point of reference, with the objective of transforming business goals into robust, evolvable, secure, and operable architectures. They will lead end-to-end technical architecture design, establish technical and non-functional criteria, support the team during implementation, and ensure that deliverables meet the quality, performance, resilience, and security levels required by a critical enterprise platform.

Responsibilities

  • Define the end-to-end technical architecture of the project, including components, integrations, data flows, dependencies, and boundaries of responsibility.

  • Make and document architectural decisions using ADRs, evaluating alternatives, trade-offs, evolution costs, risks, and operational consequences.

  • Translate functional and non-functional requirements into implementable designs, technical acceptance criteria, and an evolution roadmap.

  • Design scalable and resilient distributed solutions, considering consistency, concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.

  • Participate in the development of critical components and conduct code reviews focused on design, maintainability, security, and operational behavior.

  • Define the testing and quality strategy: unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, performance, resilience, and security testing.

  • Design and review APIs, integration contracts, persistence schemas, and compatibility and evolution mechanisms.

  • Evaluate performance and capacity through analysis, profiling, load testing, and the definition of measurable latency and throughput targets.

  • Ensure the automation of builds, validations, static analysis, deployments, and quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.

  • Integrate secure-by-design principles, threat modeling, secrets management, access control, and traceability into the architecture.

  • Identify technical risks, structural debt, and bottlenecks; prioritize their remediation and communicate their impact on timeline, cost, and scope.

  • Participate in planning complex deliveries, technical estimations, milestone definition, and tracking architectural commitments.

  • More than 4 years of experience as a Technical Architect, with demonstrable experience leading the design and delivery of platforms or projects of high technical complexity.

  • At least 5 years of experience in software development and in Java, Spring Boot, APIs, persistence, distributed systems, automated testing, and CI/CD.

  • Experience in regulated or financial environments with high availability, performance, security, and traceability requirements.

  • Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining standards, managing technical debt, and evolving existing systems.

  • Experience working with Agile methodologies and collaborating cross-functionally with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Business teams.

  • Advanced experience with Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, and designing mission-critical enterprise applications.

  • Mastery of microservices architecture, distributed systems, synchronous and asynchronous integration, and communication patterns.

  • In-depth knowledge of REST API design, contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration governance.

  • Experience with Spring Data JPA, data modeling, transactions, PostgreSQL, and query and persistence optimization.

  • Experience with Gradle or Maven, multi-module projects or composite builds, dependency management, and build automation.

  • Mastery of SOLID principles, DDD, Clean Architecture, design patterns, and refactoring and safe evolution techniques.

  • Experience defining testing strategies using JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, as well as contract, integration, and performance testing.

  • Solid knowledge of concurrency, caching, messaging, idempotency, consistency, resilience, and fault tolerance.

  • Experience with Git, code reviews, branching strategies, and collaborative development practices at scale.

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated quality, static analysis, artifact management, and controlled deployments.

  • Knowledge of observability: structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, alerting, and production diagnostics.

Languages

  • Minimum B2 English level, mandatory. A professional level is required to lead decisions and collaborate with international teams.

  • Spanish – professional level, minimum B2, mandatory.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the architecture of financial platforms, corporate banking, trading, or high-criticality transactional systems.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, or other messaging and distributed processing platforms.

  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud, and deployment patterns such as blue-green, canary, and rolling releases.

  • Experience applying OAuth2, OpenID Connect, threat modeling, secrets management, and application security controls.

  • Knowledge of SRE, SLO/SLI, capacity, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

  • Experience in application modernization, progressive migrations, the strangler pattern, and technical debt reduction.

  • Experience defining architecture standards, technical reviews, and governance models in large organizations.

  • Domain knowledge of Trade Finance or Documentary Trade.

What do we offer you?

  • Full-time or B2B contract
  • Remote within CET Time zone.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

Born on the internet in 2006, BuzzFeed, Inc. is committed to improving it: providing trusted, quality, brand-safe news and entertainment to hundreds of millions of people; making content on the internet more inclusive, empathetic, and creative; and inspiring our audience to live better lives. raw.description:
Head of Business Development

Space Technology | Remote – Europe

About the Company

Our client is an innovative technology company operating at the intersection of advanced additive manufacturing and the space industry.

The company is developing next-generation structural components for space applications using advanced 3D printing technology. Its solutions are designed to support lightweight structures and deployable solar arrays used in satellites.

The business is approaching the completion of its prototyping phase and preparing to move towards commercial production, with the ambition of bringing its technology into real-world space applications.

To support this next stage of growth, we are looking for an experienced Head of Business Development who will take ownership of the company's commercial development and build strategic relationships across the international space ecosystem.

The Role

As Head of Business Development, you will work directly with the founders to drive commercial growth and establish the company as a recognised technology partner within the international space industry.

This is a strategic, relationship-driven position. We are looking for someone who already understands the space industry, has an established network of relevant contacts and knows how to navigate its complex commercial environment.

Your primary focus will be on developing business opportunities across Western Europe, building relationships with satellite manufacturers, space technology companies, system integrators and other relevant industry stakeholders.

We are not looking for someone who needs to build their industry knowledge and network from scratch. We are looking for someone who can bring existing relationships, market access and commercial opportunities from day one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the business development strategy, with a primary focus on Western European markets.

  • Leverage your existing network within the space industry to identify and access potential customers, strategic partners and commercial opportunities.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, including C-level executives, VPs, business unit leaders and technical stakeholders at satellite manufacturers, space companies and relevant organisations.

  • Identify and develop strategic opportunities for the adoption of innovative technology in satellite structures and deployable solar array applications.

  • Lead complex, long-cycle B2B and B2G sales processes, from initial engagement and opportunity development through negotiations and contract closure.

  • Establish and manage relationships with institutional stakeholders, space agencies, research organisations and industry partners.

  • Work closely with the founders and technical team to translate the company's technology into compelling commercial value propositions.

  • Develop go-to-market strategies, commercial models, pricing approaches and partnership structures.

  • Represent the company at international industry events, conferences, exhibitions and customer meetings.

  • Build and maintain a structured business development pipeline, ensuring visibility of opportunities, key accounts and sales progress.

  • Contribute to the company's long-term commercial strategy and, as the business grows, support the development of the future business development team.

What We Are Looking For

Essential experience:

  • At least 7 years of experience in business development, strategic sales or commercial leadership within the space, aerospace or closely related space technology sector.

  • A strong and established professional network within the international space industry.

  • Existing relationships with relevant decision-makers at satellite manufacturers, space technology companies, system integrators, space agencies or other organisations operating in the space ecosystem.

  • A proven track record of developing strategic business opportunities and closing complex, high-value B2B or B2G deals.

  • Experience navigating long and sophisticated sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and technical decision-makers.

  • A strong understanding of the commercial dynamics, key players and procurement processes within the space industry.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, take ownership of commercial objectives and turn relationships into tangible business opportunities.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Additional advantages:

  • Experience with satellite systems, satellite structures, deployable solar arrays or related space technologies.

  • Familiarity with the European space ecosystem, including ESA-related projects and programmes.

  • Experience working with innovative hardware, advanced materials, additive manufacturing or deep-tech solutions.

  • Existing relationships across France, Belgium, Germany and the UK.

  • Experience in early-stage or fast-growing technology companies.

Markets & Business Focus

The primary focus will be Western Europe, with particular emphasis on:

  • France

  • Belgium

  • Germany

  • United Kingdom

Other European markets may also offer relevant opportunities.

Candidates based in Poland will also be considered, provided they bring a strong international network and established relationships within the Western European space industry.

What We Offer

  • A key commercial leadership position with direct access to the founders and real influence on the company's growth.

  • The opportunity to bring innovative space technology from the prototyping stage into commercial production and real-world applications.

  • A competitive compensation package of €8,000–€12,000 per month, depending on experience and profile.

  • Performance-based bonus.

  • ESOP participation from day one.

  • Flexible cooperation model: B2B or employment contract.

  • Fully remote working model – no relocation required.

  • Opportunity to represent the company at international conferences, exhibitions and customer meetings.

  • Business travel expenses covered by the company, including flights, accommodation and event participation.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join a company at a particularly exciting stage of its development.

You will not simply be selling an established product in a mature market. You will help introduce a new technology into the space industry, develop strategic relationships with key players and contribute directly to the company's commercial future.

We are looking for someone who knows the space ecosystem, understands how business is done in this industry and is ready to turn their network and experience into real commercial impact.

If you already have the relationships, industry knowledge and commercial experience to help bring innovative space technology to market, we would be happy to hear from you.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is looking for a Major Account Executive based in Sweden who will be responsible for managing some of our largest enterprise accounts in the Nordics region. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities within your assigned install base, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within a set of current customers

  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management)

  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise

  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually

Bonus Points For:

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Reward

In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 2,985,000 - SEK 3,090,000.Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. raw.description:
POS-34026

HubSpot is hiring a Senior Sales Strategy Analyst to shape how we grow in Australia and New Zealand. You will sit in the JAPAC Strategy and Operations team, with your time focused on ANZ across both Upmarket and Downmarket. You will be the strategic and operational partner to our ANZ sales leaders: setting strategy, owning the operating rhythm, and bringing them insight before they ask for it.

ANZ Downmarket sits within HubSpot's Global SMB organisation. You will stay connected to the global team's strategy, tools and best practice and bring them into ANZ.

You will also work on JAPAC projects and initiatives with regional reach. This role reports to the JAPAC Strategy and Operations Manager.

What you'll do

  • Set the strategy. Define the go-to-market strategy for ANZ Upmarket and Downmarket with the ANZ Executive and Sales Leadership teams.
  • Deliver proactive insights. Spot risks and opportunities in the data and bring them to leaders before they ask.
  • Build models leaders can use. Go deep in the data, build robust models, and turn them into simple outputs leaders can use to explore scenarios.
  • Own the operating rhythm. Run weekly forecasting, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and annual planning.
  • Build with AI. Turn HubSpot data into tools leaders use every week, using Breeze and other AI tools alongside Hex and Looker.
  • Design the system. Shape territories, coverage models, capacity and quota inputs with Sales Ops, Finance and Comp, and run programs that lift pipeline and rep productivity.
  • Join up the demand engine. Work with Marketing, Sales, Partner, BDR and Enablement teams to turn insights into actions.
  • Drive decisions across teams. Share recommendations to executives based on analysis and an outside-in perspective, and align cross-functional teams on the recommendations without formal authority.
  • Connect ANZ to the wider business. Bring Global SMB playbooks into ANZ Downmarket, and contribute to JAPAC projects with regional and global reach.

Problems you'll work on

Examples of the questions this role answers:

  • How should new rep books balance customers and new business?
  • Which verticals justify a dedicated sales play, and how big is the opportunity?
  • How can we build sufficient pipeline coverage for the next quarter?
  • What does the right operating cadence look like as ANZ scales?
  • Which playbooks from other markets should we bring to ANZ, and what needs to change to make them work here?
  • How do we lift productivity per rep across the business, and does the approach need to differ by tenure?
  • How do we build tools that scale globally, so leaders get to insight faster and we deliver insights before they ask?
  • How do we successfully navigate the shift from the SaaS curve to the AI curve?

Who you are

  • A deeply curious self-starter. You find the problem, scope it, and drive it to an answer without waiting to be asked.
  • A strong modeller. You go from raw data to a working model yourself, then turn it into a simple tool leaders use to test scenarios and make the call.
  • Hands-on with data and tools. You extract data from HubSpot or a comparable CRM, and build in Hex, Looker or similar BI tools.
  • A builder with AI. You use Breeze and other AI models to create scalable tools, not just to answer one-off questions.
  • Highly analytical. You know which metrics matter and keep asking why until the answer is useful.
  • A strong storyteller. You own the narrative behind the numbers, sell a recommendation to senior leaders, and defend a view under challenge. You bring strong opinions, loosely held, and know when to disagree and commit.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace in a high-growth SaaS business.
  • Typically 8+ years of professional experience.

Backgrounds we've hired from

HubSpot hires for potential, not a checklist. People who have thrived in this role include:

  • Sales Ops, Sales Strategy, Customer Ops and FP&A professionals
  • Highly analytical management and strategy consultants
  • Data scientists
  • Senior commercial and financial analysts, ideally with experience supporting a sales organisation
  • Technical people with a passion for business problems
  • Sales leaders with strategy development experience

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. What this job involves:

JLL Technologies Enterprise Data team is a newly established central organization that oversees JLL’s data strategy. Enterprise Analytics is an internal analytics-consulting team that provides data driven expertise to various business and support functions. The Senior Data Analyst is an experienced role that combines data-driven storytelling, analytical prowess and expert level stakeholder management to drive significant value. We need a data rockstar to join our growing team and that could be you!


This is remote based role that requires working on the Eastern time zone. As this is part of a global team, flexibility will be needed to accommodate occasional meetings outside of this time zone too.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Partner with Sr level stakeholders to determine creative data-based methodologies for driving business value.
  • Develop professional grade dashboards in Tableau to drive better decision making across the Capital Markets business.
  • Prepare and present findings and analyses to stakeholders through iterative development and agile delivery - drive faster, smarter data driven decisions.
  • Generate revenue or cost saving opportunities through data-driven insights and proactively identify opportunities to optimize the performance and efficiency of existing processes/procedures.
  • Support the roadmap development process through facilitating discussions with stakeholders, researching possible solutions and recommending key areas of opportunity where we can drive analytical value.
  • Lead prioritization and project management efforts to create consistency and ensure expectation alignment with key stakeholders
  • Explore and utilize new data mining and data visualization tools to conduct ad-hoc analysis as required.
  • Leverage additional support teams (Advanced Data Science and Marketing Analytics) to drive even more stakeholder value.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Analytics, Statistics / Mathematics, Computer Science, Econometrics or Data Science and Information Management (advanced degree preferred).
  • 2-4 years of experience with data visualization platforms (Tableau preferred) required (Experience with user design a plus).
  • Programming experience and expertise in SQL (experience with Azure Databricks / Python a plus).
  • Ability to quickly understand, process and consume industrial scale databases using one of these tools.
  • Experience in developing and delivering insights through advanced analytics and working with relational databases, API integrations, data automation preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal communication and active listening skills.

raw.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | NASA | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates from US and Canada only (EST time zone).

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In US, the base compensation range for this role is USD $167,000 - $209,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

About Waymark

Waymark is a mission-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits. We partner with communities to deliver technology-enabled, human-centered support that helps patients stay healthy and thrive. We’re designing tools and systems that bring care directly to those who need it most—removing barriers and reimagining what’s possible in Medicaid healthcare delivery.

Our Values

At Waymark, our values are the foundation of how we work, grow, and support one another:

  • Bold Builders: We tackle the toughest challenges in care delivery by harnessing the power of community and technology.
  • Humble Learners: We seek feedback, embrace diverse perspectives, and welcome challenges to our assumptions.
  • Experiment to Improve: We use data to inform decisions and continuously assess our performance.
  • Focused Urgency: Our mission drives us to act swiftly and relentlessly in pursuit of meaningful results.

If this resonates with you, we invite you to bring your creativity, energy, and curiosity to Waymark.

About this role

You will join our Talent Acquisition team and be Waymark’s recruiter primarily dedicated to professional, leadership, and technology hiring. You’ll partner directly with executives and hiring managers across Technology, Product, Clinical, and corporate functions to hire the people who will build our platform and scale our model to new markets.

You will focus on building up the recruiting engine dedicated to technology hiring: strong intake, building future pipelines, an optimal candidate experience, and an employment brand that tells Waymark’s story well. You will focus on professional and technical hires but also work on care delivery requisitions as needed. You will help build the processes, tools, and talent pipelines that ensure Waymark hires top talent well as we grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-cycle recruiting: Own professional, leadership, and technical searches from intake through offer.
  • Hiring manager partnership: Lead intake meetings, define success profiles, advise on market realities, and keep managers aligned and moving quickly.
  • Sourcing and pipelines: Proactively source passive talent and build standing pipelines for recurring and hard-to-fill roles in technology and healthcare.
  • Agency reduction: Bring agency-filled searches in-house as much as possible and manage any remaining agency relationships against clear cost and quality standards.
  • Candidate experience and process: Build upon our recruiting approach with structured interviews, consistent communication, and a fast, respectful process.
  • Employment brand: Build Waymark’s employment brand and help shape our employee value proposition for candidates.
  • Offers and closing: Partner on offer strategy within Waymark’s compensation framework and close top candidates.
  • Metrics and tools: Track and report time-to-fill, source of hire, pipeline health, and agency spend, and get the most out of our recruiting technology.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including at least 3 years in-house
  • Proven track record of filling technical roles such as software engineering, data, and product
  • Experience recruiting professional and leadership roles, ideally in healthcare or health technology
  • Strong proactive sourcing skills, including LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search, and comfort with a modern ATS
  • Confident, consultative partner to executives and hiring managers making their case using data
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, growing environment and builds process without slowing the work down

Preferred Qualifications

  • Startup or high-growth company experience, including building recruiting processes from scratch
  • Experience recruiting for Medicaid, value-based care, or community-based care organizations
  • Experience building employment brand or candidate pipeline programs
  • Familiarity with structured interviewing and inclusive hiring practices

The expected hiring range for this role is $99,000 – $150,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

This is a remote role, however, candidates living in certain high-cost of living cities such as San Francisco, New York City, and Seattle, may be eligible for an additional market premium.

In addition to salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Stock Options: Opportunity to invest in the company’s growth.
  • Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office.
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive plans to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Life Insurance: Basic life insurance to give you peace of mind.
  • Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, accrued over the year, plus 11 paid holidays.
  • Parental Leave: 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents after six months of employment, and 8 weeks of bonding leave for non-birthing parents.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a company contribution, subject to a vesting schedule.
  • Commuter Benefits: Convenient options to support your commute needs.
  • Professional Development Stipend: A dedicated stipend supports professional development and growth.

Offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Employment history and advanced degree/professional license verification (when applicable) are included as part of the standard background check process.

Don’t check off every box in the requirements listed above? Please apply anyway! Studies have shown that some of us may be less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. Waymark is dedicated to building a supportive, equal opportunity, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging – so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every preferred qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!
