raw.description:
Job Details:

Your military experience is welcomed. Your leadership experience is valued.


Are you preparing to transition from the military and looking for a career where your ability to connect with people, understand their skills, solve problems, and accomplish the mission can make an impact? Ready to continue building teams and serving a mission, this time by helping people find meaningful careers?


Tyson Foods proudly supports the Department of Defense SkillBridge program and invites transitioning service members to join our team as a Talent Acquisition Fellow. This 120-day training opportunity allows you to translate your military recruiting, human resources, personnel, career counseling, leadership, or talent management experience into a civilian career with a Fortune 500 company that values veterans, teamwork, and developing great talent.


In this role, you’ll learn the full recruiting lifecycle while partnering with Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and business leaders to identify, attract, evaluate, and hire the talent needed to support our teams and operations.

Your Mission

As a Talent Acquisition Fellow, you will:

  • Learn the entire recruiting process from identifying an open position through hiring the selected candidate
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, and business leaders to understand hiring needs and develop recruiting strategies
  • Learn to navigate Workday and use an applicant tracking system to manage candidates and recruiting activity
  • Create engaging and compliant job postings that clearly communicate opportunities and qualifications
  • Evaluate applications, contact candidates, conduct interviews, and help manage candidates throughout the hiring process
  • Learn sourcing techniques using job boards, search engines, LinkedIn, social media, niche recruiting platforms, and other sourcing tools
  • Build talent pipelines and develop relationships with prospective candidates
  • Support recruiting events, job fairs, marketing initiatives, and outreach efforts
  • Learn recruiting compliance requirements and the importance of consistent, accurate hiring practices
  • Partner with hiring managers, HR partners, onboarding teams, and Talent Acquisition colleagues throughout the hiring process
  • Participate in projects focused on process improvement, recruiting strategy, candidate experience, and creative approaches to attracting talent

How Military Experience Fits

Your military experience may be considered in lieu of some civilian recruiting or Talent Acquisition experience requirements outlined below. The following are shown for guidance only. Equivalent civilian experience will also be considered.

  • Military Recruiting and Recruiting Operations
  • Career Counseling, Retention, or Career Planning
  • Human Resources, Personnel, or Manpower Management
  • Training, Education, or Professional Development
  • Administrative and Personnel Support
  • Talent Management or Workforce Planning
  • Senior Enlisted Leadership, First Sergeant, or Command Leadership roles involving personnel development, interviewing, mentoring, or staffing

Relevant Backgrounds May Include (Not Required)

Army: 79R (Recruiter), 79S (Career Counselor), 79T (Recruiting and Retention NCO), 42A (Human Resources Specialist), 42B (Human Resources Officer), 420A (Human Resources Technician)

Air Force: 8R000 (Recruiter), 3F0X1 (Personnel), 3F2X1 (Education and Training), 3F5X1 (Administration), 38F (Force Support Officer)

Navy: NC (Navy Counselor), recruiting-focused Navy Counselor assignments, PS (Personnel Specialist), YN (Yeoman), Human Resources Officer backgrounds

Marine Corps: 8411 (Recruiter), 4821 (Career Planner), 0111 (Administrative Specialist), 0102 (Manpower Officer), personnel and manpower management backgrounds

Coast Guard: YN (Yeoman), recruiting assignments, personnel management, career development, and human resources-related assignments

Space Force: Personnel, talent management, recruiting, training, force development, and human capital-related assignments


If you’ve recruited people, counseled service members on their careers, managed personnel, developed teams, built relationships, interviewed candidates, or helped leaders put the right people in the right positions, your skills are highly transferable.

What You’ll Gain Through SkillBridge

  • 120 days of structured Talent Acquisition and recruiting experience before separation or retirement
  • Exposure to the full recruiting lifecycle within a Fortune 500 company
  • Hands-on experience with Workday and civilian recruiting processes
  • Training in candidate sourcing, interviewing, pipeline development, recruiting compliance, and candidate management
  • Experience partnering with Talent Acquisition, HR, business leaders, and hiring managers
  • Supervisor-led instruction, job shadowing, computer-based learning, and supervised hands-on projects
  • Mentorship from experienced Talent Acquisition professionals
  • Exposure to other HR functions and the broader HR ecosystem
  • Potential pathways to Talent Acquisition roles such as Senior Representative TA, Associate TA, and Specialist TA
  • A veteran-supportive culture that understands your transition

At Tyson Foods, Veterans don’t just find jobs. They find a mission and a team.

No

Work Shift:

1ST SHIFT (United States of America)

Pay Range/Rate:

Incentives:

Annual Incentive Plan:

No

Long-Term Incentive Plan:

No

Any listed amounts represent the base pay range. Additional compensation may be available for this position based on various factors such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonuses. Pay is just one part of Tyson’s total compensation package.

The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.


Tyson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, national origin, color, religion, age, genetics, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.

raw.title: Content & Website Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: Pressable is managed WordPress hosting for agencies and businesses that can’t afford slow sites or slow answers.
raw.description:
Pressable is managed WordPress hosting for agencies and businesses that can’t afford slow sites or slow answers. Our customers have enough on their plates, so we make hosting the part they never have to think about. That same standard applies to everything we put our name on, from a support reply to a blog post to a landing page.

We’re hiring a Content & Website Marketing Manager to create content that breaks through to new audiences and to own how all of it lives on pressable.com. Pressable’s MCP and our AI workflows that save agency owners and businesses time are a huge part of that story, and this role will find the angles that matter and publish them on a site that reflects the quality of our platform. At Pressable, you’ll work with a small group of genuinely good people, doing your best work. We believe in being curious, kind and accountable, so most days you’re figuring out what work matters most to the business and the output that will get us there.

About the Role

You’ll write articles and guides, produce demo videos, and run our webinar program. You’ll also own every page published on pressable.com, from blog posts to landing pages to the resource library. If it goes live on our website, it goes through you. The work covers multiple formats, so this role suits someone who enjoys variety and takes pride in a well-run website. You’ll work with Product Marketing, Brand, and Demand Gen on projects across the marketing team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content Creation: Write and edit SEO/AEO (answer engine optimization) optimized blog posts, white papers, and thought leadership articles for agencies and growing businesses. Use research to find new stories worth telling, written from a human-first perspective, and repurpose each piece across channels like social, sales enablement, and Slack.
  • Webinars: Plan and run Pressable’s webinars from start to finish. That includes scheduling, speaker coordination, platform setup, registration pages, promotion, hosting the live session, and follow-up afterward.
  • Demo Videos: Script and record short product demos that show how Pressable features work, and publish them where they’ll do the most good.
  • Content Operations: Manage the content calendar and the website publishing calendar, and keep projects moving through review.
  • Website Publishing & Ownership: Build and launch landing pages, product pages, resource pages, and blog posts in the WordPress block editor. Act as the single point of contact for website requests from across the company, set priorities with marketing leadership, and keep a clear publishing queue so nothing stalls.
  • Site Quality & Governance: Maintain a library of block patterns and page templates so pages stay on-brand and are quick to build. QA every page before launch for layout, mobile, links, forms, and accessibility. Run regular content audits to update, consolidate, or retire outdated pages.
  • On-Page SEO & Site Health: Manage titles, meta descriptions, schema, internal linking, image optimization, and redirects. Partner with Demand Gen to track how campaign and landing pages perform, from load speed and Core Web Vitals to form completions, and fix issues on pages you own.
  • Cross-Team Support: Partner with Product Marketing on launch content and launch-day page updates, with Demand Gen on campaign landing pages, forms, and conversion, and with Brand on voice and visual standards. Work with Engineering when a page needs functionality beyond the block editor.
  • Sales Enablement Support: Help maintain the sales enablement catalog by keeping decks, one-pagers, battle cards, and case studies organized, current, and easy for Sales and Support to find.
  • Performance Tracking: Report on how content and key pages perform across channels like webinars, social, blog, and site traffic, and use what you learn to decide what we make and update next.

You Might Be a Fit If You…

  • Have 4–6 years of experience in content marketing, web publishing, or a related role, ideally in B2B or SaaS.
  • Have managed a company website in WordPress, and know the block editor inside and out—including patterns, reusable blocks, and page templates.
  • Are comfortable with HTML and CSS for fixing layouts and making small tweaks without waiting for a developer.
  • Know on-page SEO well: metadata, redirects, internal linking, and image optimization.
  • Write clearly and can explain technical topics in plain language.
  • Have helped run webinars or virtual events, or are eager to learn how.
  • Can record and edit simple videos and are comfortable on camera.
  • Use AI tools in your daily work and know when your own judgment matters more.
  • Can juggle a publishing queue and several projects at once without dropping details.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in web hosting, WordPress, or another developer-focused product.
  • Experience with HubSpot (forms, landing pages, or CMS integrations).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and site performance tools.
  • Experience with webinar platforms and video tools like Descript.
  • Involvement in the WordPress community, such as WordCamps, meetups, or contributing to the project.

What You’ll Work On Initially

  • Launch and host Pressable’s next webinar series.
  • Publish new guides and articles tied to upcoming product launches.
  • Produce a set of short demo videos covering key Pressable features.
  • Take ownership of pressable.com publishing, and set up an intake and prioritization process for website requests.
  • Audit the site’s existing pages and build a plan to update, consolidate, or retire outdated content.
  • Build a starter library of block patterns and templates for landing and resource pages.

Why Join Pressable?

You’ll have real influence over what Pressable publishes, how our website shows up, and how we show up in the WordPress community. The team moves quickly and gives people room to own their work.

See the perks & benefits of joining Pressablehere.

Location: Remote US

Compensation and Benefits

Salary range: $100,000-$140,000 USD. Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency.

We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated.

This isn’t your typical work-from-home job—we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. Read more about our compensation philosophy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page. And check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves.

About Pressable

Pressable was founded in 2010 and later acquired by Automattic, which rebuilt the platform from the ground up. Today Pressable provides managed WordPress hosting for agencies, developers, and businesses, with developer tools, built-in security, a 100% uptime SLA, and 24/7 expert support. As a business unit within Automattic, Pressable runs like a small company with the backing of a larger one.

raw.title: Infusion Supply Coordinator
raw.excerpt: About AmeriPharmaAmeriPharma is a rapidly growing healthcare company where you will have the opportunity to contribute to our joint success on a daily basis.
raw.description:
About AmeriPharma

AmeriPharma is a rapidly growing healthcare company where you will have the opportunity to contribute to our joint success on a daily basis. We value new ideas, creativity, and productivity. We like people who are passionate about their roles and people who like to grow and change as the company evolves.

AmeriPharma’s Benefits

  • Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life that fits your lifestyle and goals
  • Great pay and general compensation structures
  • Employee assistance program to assist with mental health, legal questions, financial counseling etc.
  • Comprehensive PTO and sick leave options
  • 401k program
  • Plenty of opportunities for growth and advancement
  • Company sponsored outings and team-building events
  • Casual Fridays

Job Summary

The Infusion Supply Coordinator supports safe and efficient home infusion therapy by managing patient-specific infusion supplies and equipment in coordination with Pharmacy, Nursing, and other operational teams. This role is responsible for reviewing and adjusting supply quantities based on patient therapy needs, nursing requests, utilization, and established workflows, ensuring that supplies are sent correctly for the specific catheter line in use to support safe infusion therapy. The coordinator serves as a primary resource for infusion supply questions and is expected to validate that requested supplies are appropriate for the patient's therapy and administration method before changes are made. The role also assists with identifying alternative products, researching new supply options, and submitting requests for new items when current inventory does not meet patient or operational needs. This position requires strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and an understanding of home infusion supplies, equipment, and patient-specific therapy requirements.

Job Details

  • 100% remote position
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm PST
  • Salary Range: $25 to $30 Hourly, DOE

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage patient-specific infusion supplies and adjust quantities based on therapy requirements, frequency of administration, patient utilization, and nursing or pharmacy requests.
  • Review and validate supply requests to ensure the item and quantity requested are appropriate for the patient's therapy, vascular access, administration method, and frequency of use.
  • Identify potentially excessive, insufficient, duplicate, or inappropriate supply requests and clarify discrepancies with Pharmacy, Nursing, or other appropriate team members before processing changes.
  • Collaborate with pharmacists and nursing staff when supply needs require clinical clarification or when requested changes may affect medication administration, vascular access care, or patient safety.
  • Research alternative or substitute supplies when requested products are unavailable, discontinued, backordered, or no longer preferred.
  • Compare alternative products for intended use, compatibility, packaging, availability, and operational feasibility before recommending options for review.
  • Submit requests for new supplies or products when existing inventory does not adequately meet patient, nursing, pharmacy, or operational needs.
  • Maintain and update patient supply profiles to accurately reflect current therapy requirements and prevent unnecessary or outdated supplies from continuing to ship.
  • Review recurring supply quantities and utilization to identify opportunities to reduce waste, prevent shortages, and improve supply standardization.
  • Coordinate with Pharmacy, Nursing, Intake, Production, Shipping, and other departments to resolve supply-related questions and ensure patients receive the appropriate supplies for treatment.
  • Assist with urgent or same-day supply needs by evaluating the request, determining what is required, and coordinating appropriate fulfillment or escalation.
  • Monitor supply inventory concerns and communicate anticipated shortages, unusual utilization, or product needs to the appropriate Production or Supply Chain leadership.
  • Assist with supply standardization initiatives by identifying commonly used products, unnecessary variation, and opportunities to establish preferred supply options.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient-specific supply changes, special requirements, substitutions, and relevant communications in the pharmacy system.
  • Support equipment management, including coordinating equipment needs, replacements, returns, and pickups as applicable.
  • Assist with equipment recovery efforts and collaborate with Specialty Pharmacy or other departments when demand letters or additional follow-up are required.
  • Participate in inventory audits, supply utilization reviews, quality improvement initiatives, and workflow development to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary supply costs.
  • Escalate clinical questions to a pharmacist or nurse when a supply request requires clinical judgment beyond the scope of the coordinator role.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities in different areas of the department on an as-need basis or determined by management
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, collaboration, and service excellence.
  • Take primary ownership of: Patient-specific supply quantities and adjustments, review and validation of supply requests, supply utilization and waste reduction, alternative product research, new supply/product requests, patient supply profile accuracy, supply and equipment issue resolution, and cross-department coordination of infusion supply needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in home infusion, specialty pharmacy, medical supplies, DME, pharmacy operations, healthcare supply chain, or a related setting preferred.
  • Familiarity with infusion supplies, vascular access supplies, administration sets, pumps, and related equipment.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to evaluate whether supply quantities and requests are reasonable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to research products, compare alternatives, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Ability to manage multiple patient-specific requests while maintaining accuracy and appropriate prioritization.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with pharmacists, nurses, technicians, shipping personnel, and other interdisciplinary teams.
  • Attention to detail
  • Supply utilization and inventory awareness
  • Critical thinking and problem solving
  • Patient-specific supply management
  • Cross-functional communication
  • Research and product evaluation
  • Documentation accuracy
  • Prioritization and follow-through
  • Cost and waste awareness
  • Understanding of role boundaries and appropriate clinical escalation

Education and Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or healthcare-related education preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using patient management or inventory systems such as CPR+ preferred.

AmeriPharma’s Mission Statement

Our goal is to achieve superior clinical and economic outcomes while maintaining the utmost compassion and care for our patients. It is our joint and individual responsibility daily to demonstrate to outpatients, prescribers, colleagues, and others that We Care!

Physical Requirements

The following physical activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is continuously required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds and occasionally lift/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must have the ability to regularly walk commercial properties, parking areas, and exterior grounds; use stairs and access building operational areas as required; work in both office and field environments; and occasionally lift and carry light maintenance supplies or equipment.

EEO Statement

The above statements are intended to describe the work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The duties and responsibilities of this position are subject to change and other duties may be assigned or removed at any time. AmeriPharma values diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an AAP/EEO employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability or any other legally protected class.

Salary: $25 to $30 Hourly, DOE

raw.description:
Get to know us

Do you want to help us shape what the future of work will look like and how it will best embrace our life's aspirations? If this sounds like a journey you want to embark on, we may have the right role for you! PayFit is an intuitive software as a service payroll and HRIS solution designed specifically for SMBs. Since 2015, we have set ourselves a mission to simplify payroll for SMBs and enable employers and employees to grow together. We are a European company operating from 3 main countries (France, Spain, and the UK) where we are supporting over 20,000 clients.

Creating a fulfilling work environment and culture is also a core mission at PayFit, and our day-to-day work philosophy is reflected in our four values:

Care:We genuinely care for others whoever they are, whatever they think.

Excellence:We aim to improve and achieve better results every day.

Humility:Staying humble and exchanging transparent feedback helps us to grow and improve.

Passion:We are the architects of PayFit's success.

A key part of our culture, and essential for our success, is also improving the diversity of our teams and building an inclusive culture where you can be yourself at work.

This is why our recruitment focuses on the skills you demonstrate, and not only on your academic background or previous professional experiences. At PayFit we understand that you can gain applicable skills through a variety of life experiences and we are interested in knowing them, too.

Location :Flexible location: work remotely from anywhere in Franceor Spain

Why this role, why now

AI is already embedded across Payfit’s operations. Now we’re doubling down and scaling it as a business-critical capability. We're redesigning high-value workflows so our teams execute faster, with greater accuracy and consistency — and we're doing it with direct CEO sponsorship.

To scale this reliably, we need engineers who blend product sense with strong software fundamentals: people who can go from an ambiguous business problem to a production solution that users actually adopt. You'll partner directly with business owners, integrate with our core systems, and iterate based on real usage and quality signals. The goal: ship production solutions that measurably improve service quality and execution speed across Payfit.

The team You'll join a dedicated AI Enablement team of 4, plus a team lead reporting directly to the CEO. The team's mandate is focused delivery - identifying the highest-value workflow opportunities across Payfit, building AI agents that connect to our business systems, and iterating until solutions become part of everyday work.

You'll work in close, structured collaboration with the Application Framework team in Engineering - co-building shared permissions, approved integrations, evaluation frameworks, monitoring, and human interaction patterns. The focus team owns workflow delivery and adoption; Application Framework owns shared infrastructure and technical standards.
Success is measured in net time saved, cycle time reduction, quality improvements, sustained usage, and operating cost.

What you'll do

  • Partner with business users to map workflows and turn needs into AI-powered solutions that teams actually adopt day-to-day.

  • Design and implement integrations with APIs, applications, and data sources; build agent orchestration, retrieval, and custom capabilities.

  • Ship production-ready AI features with evaluation, monitoring, exception handling, and human review where needed to ensure accuracy and safety.

  • Prioritise opportunities with named business owners, clear baselines, and selection criteria focused on value, feasibility, and readiness.

  • Iterate using user feedback and quality/time-saved signals to continuously raise reliability and adoption.

  • Co-develop reusable components, permissions, and human interaction patterns with the Application Framework team to scale safely.

  • Increase autonomy in business teams by creating templates, training local champions, and establishing clear ownership for ongoing operation and improvement.

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including API and systems design.

  • Proven hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, tools, orAI workflow automation in production.

  • Product sense: you can move from an ambiguous business problem to a reliable, maintainable production solution.

  • Care for security, permissions, evaluation, observability, and maintainability in AI-enabled systems.

  • Comfort working directly with non-technical users and collaborating across engineering and business teams.

  • Ownership mindset across the full cycle: discovery, delivery, production quality, and iteration.

Our hiring process

  • Step 1 — Quick catch-up with Talent Acquisition

  • Step 2 — 45' meeting with our CTO

  • Step 3 — 60–90' Technical Interview

  • Step 4 — 45' Final Interview

Background Check (ISO27001 certification): identity, diploma, and past professional experience will be checked after the offer.

What we offer

Flexibility: We believe it is key to produce your best work and to be fulfilled. We therefore offer the possibility to work away from our main offices, within France/UK/Spain; as well as abroad for a defined period. Further requirements may apply depending on the role and your overall experience.
Learning & Development: In PayFit we have a great learning platform where you can learn new skills every day with the support of our company.
Career Development: We want you to progress and be free to choose which direction you want to grow. There are also opportunities for internal moves.
Health promotion:GymLib subscription with preferential rates. 4 paid sessions with a mental health practitioner and online support with Moka.Care.
Health insurance: Mutuelle Henner (60% covered by PayFit).
Transportation: 50% covered for your public transportation card for those living within Ile de France. A budget to travel to the office for those who live outside of it.
Meals: A restaurant card with our partner Swile ( 9€ per workday).
Home office budget: 150€ per year to help you get set up in the best conditions. A MacBook is our standard working tool.
Parental support: 20 weeks maternity leave covered by PayFit and 4 weeks leave for the second parent.
Time off:25 days of holidays + RTT days (depending on the contract).

Disability Inclusion:All of our positions are open to any person living with a disability. To guarantee equal treatment and opportunities, we will take, based on individual needs, appropriate measures to adapt the work conditions of PayFiters with disabilities, and if needed also during the recruitment process. Please let us know what you need and we will do our best to accommodate!

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an AVP, Strategic Partner Delivery, you will be tasked with leading SentinelOne’s relationship with a strategic global services partner, helping the two organizations deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for customers from the earliest proof of value through implementation, ongoing service, and renewal. Together, SentinelOne and its partner bring expert-led managed security services to more organizations in more regions. This is a hands-on executive player-coach role: you will lead a dedicated team, aligning Product, Engineering, Sales, Renewals, Legal, and Finance around a single operating model.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Serve as SentinelOne’s executive lead for the partnership, owning the joint operating plan, roadmap, and regular partnership reviews, and communicating progress, decisions, and risks to executives.
  • Lead a team spanning customer experience, service quality, and technical validation; establish clear operating rhythms, shared decision-making, and issue resolution across both organizations; hire and coach leaders, and build a culture of ownership, transparency, and measurable results.
  • Ensure customers have a named SentinelOne owner from proof of value through onboarding, deployment, ongoing service, and renewal, with smooth handoffs and fast time to value.
  • Define customer experience standards and service-level expectations, and use clear metrics and scorecards to track service quality and drive continuous improvement.
  • Own senior customer escalations and drive timely resolution and lasting corrective action, partnering with Product, Engineering, and technical teams to improve platform and service readiness.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 15 or more years of leadership across enterprise Customer Experience, cybersecurity services, managed services, technical operations, or strategic technology partnerships; leadership experience in cybersecurity, MDR/MSSP, managed SIEM, incident response, or enterprise professional services.
  • Proven ownership of a complex global delivery, service-provider, or strategic partner relationship; experience launching or scaling partner-led delivery models while protecting customer trust.
  • Experience building and developing senior cross-functional teams and influencing organizations beyond direct reporting lines; strong executive judgment in critical customer escalations and ambiguous delivery challenges.
  • Expertise in partner management, service delivery, SLA/SLO management, and continuous-improvement programs; commercial fluency spanning renewals, delivery capacity, and customer outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into operating plans, use metrics to drive decisions, and communicate effectively with C-level stakeholders; success in this role means faster resolution of customer issues, on-time delivery of the joint roadmap, strong partner relationship health, and improved time to value, service experience, and renewal outcomes.
  • Knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity and the journey from technical validation and implementation to managed services and renewals.
  • Familiarity with SentinelOne Singularity, endpoint security, AI SIEM, threat hunting, and regulated or large-enterprise customer environments.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

About the Company:

Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences.
Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!

About the Role:

We are looking for a strategic, highly connected Partner Director, Federal to build and scale Netomi’s partner strategy across the U.S. Federal Government market.

This role will own the development of Netomi’s Federal partner ecosystem—identifying, recruiting, and growing relationships with the systems integrators, consulting firms, resellers, technology partners, and other organizations that influence how AI solutions are bought and deployed across government.

Reporting to the VP, Alliances, Partners & Channels, you will develop the relationships and joint go-to-market motions that create access, pipeline, and revenue within the Federal market. You’ll work closely with GTM, Field Engineering, Partner Enablement, Product, and Marketing to turn strategic partnerships into meaningful business outcomes.

Responsibilities:

    Federal Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Development

  • Build and execute Netomi’s partner strategy for the U.S. Federal market.

  • Identify, recruit, and develop high-value Federal systems integrators, consulting firms, resellers, and technology partners.

  • Build senior relationships across the Federal partner ecosystem and establish Netomi as a strategic AI partner.

  • Identify the partnerships and routes to market that can accelerate Netomi’s access to priority agencies and opportunities.

    • Joint GTM & Pipeline

  • Develop joint business plans, account strategies, and go-to-market motions with strategic Federal partners.

  • Generate and influence qualified Federal pipeline through the partner ecosystem.

  • Support partner-led and co-sell opportunities from identification through execution.

  • Work with partners and internal sales teams to identify key stakeholders, contracting paths, and strategies for strategic Federal opportunities.

  • Establish clear goals and accountability around partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue.

    • Partner Development & Activation

  • Build strong executive relationships and create alignment around mutual business opportunities.

  • Partner with the Partner Enablement function to ensure Federal partners are effectively onboarded, trained, activated, and equipped to position Netomi.

  • Identify opportunities for joint solutions, pilots, and strategic programs that demonstrate Netomi’s value within government environments.

  • Act as a key connector between Federal partners and Netomi’s internal teams.

Requirements:

  • 15+ years of experience in Federal partnerships, alliances, channels, business development, or enterprise technology.

  • Demonstrated success building and managing strategic partnerships within the U.S. Federal market.

  • Established relationships within the Federal SI, consulting, reseller, and/or technology ecosystem.

  • Track record of generating measurable pipeline and revenue through partnerships.

  • Strong understanding of Federal technology buying, procurement, and contracting environments.

  • Experience with enterprise SaaS, cloud, AI, CX, automation, or related technologies strongly preferred.

  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

Who You Are:

  • Deeply knowledgeable about the U.S. Federal Government technology and partner ecosystem.

  • A relationship builder with an established network across Federal SIs, consulting firms, resellers, and/or technology partners.

  • Commercially minded and focused on turning partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue.

  • Comfortable navigating complex organizations, procurement environments, and long enterprise sales cycles.

  • Entrepreneurial and energized by building a new market and partner motion from the ground up.

  • Able to operate strategically while remaining hands-on in developing relationships and advancing opportunities.

  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform government operations and constituent experiences.

About Us:

How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 179 years?!

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

What’s the role?

As Chief Commercial Officer is responsible for the development and execution of the company’s go-to-market strategy to drive sustainable revenue growth, maximize customer lifetime value, and optimize all commercial functions (sales, marketing, pricing, channel, and customer success) for the US lens market. The CCO ensures alignment across product, operations, and finance to deliver profitable growth and a best-in-class customer experience.

Sound Interesting?

Here’s what you’ll do:

Strategy and leadership

  • Define and execute the company’s commercial vision, go-to-market strategy, and 3–5 year revenue plan for the US lens business.
  • Translate market insights into differentiated value propositions and scalable revenue growth.
  • Prioritize investments across sales, marketing, pricing, and partnerships to hit top-line and profitability targets.

Revenue growth and performance

  • Own revenue targets, pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and quota setting.
  • Lead and optimize sales, marketing, and customer success motions to maximize acquisition, retention, and expansion.
  • Develop and manage pricing, packaging, and discounting strategies to improve margin and competitiveness.

Go-to-market execution

  • Architect multi-channel sales approaches (direct, indirect, partner, and digital) and oversee lens channel strategy.
  • Oversee demand generation, branding, product marketing, and enablement programs.
  • Drive a cohesive customer lifecycle with a focus on adoption, expansion, and advocacy.

Customer and partner ecosystem

  • Build and manage strategic partnerships, alliances, and ecosystem programs.
  • Ensure a superior customer experience across pre-sale, onboarding, support, and renewals.
  • Establish strong governance for customer insights to influence product and service offerings.

Operations, analytics, and governance

  • Implement data-driven processes for planning, budgeting, and performance tracking.
  • Oversee CRM, analytics, and reporting to sales, marketing, and customer success leadership.
  • Collaborate with Product, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure scalable and compliant commercial practices.

People and culture

  • Recruit, mentor, and retain top commercial talent; foster a high-performance, inclusive culture.
  • Align incentives, recognition, and development programs with company goals.
  • Promote cross-functional collaboration and a culture of accountability.

Dimensions / Key Data

  • Employees Nb. of direct reports: 5
  • Nb. of indirect/project reports: 125

KPIs

  • Revenue growth and revenue mix by product/region
  • Sales pipeline velocity, conversion rates, and quota attainment
  • Gross margin and overall profitability of go-to-market programs
  • Customer acquisition cost (CAC) and either lifetime value (LTV) or payback period
  • Net revenue retention (NRR) and expansion rate
  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and time-to-value
  • Channel partner performance and partner profitability
  • Forecast accuracy and go-to-market ROI
  • Employee engagement and turnover within commercial teams

Do you qualify?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred
  • ABO Certification desirable.
  • 12–20 years of progressive commercial leadership experience, including P&L responsibility.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering top-line growth and improving margins in a B2B or B2B2C environment.
  • Experience leading sales, marketing, pricing, and customer success teams, ideally with multi-channel/go-to-market strategies.
  • Strong data analytics, forecasting, and CRM systems experience (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo).
  • International experience and comfort working across multiple regions and cultures.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive stake holding skills.
  • Change management and talent development capabilities.
  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset.
  • Customer-obsessed and data-driven decision maker.
  • Collaborative leader who builds trust and drives cross-functional alignment.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and able to manage ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

Working Environment:

  • Travel up to 90% as required.
  • Occasional evening/weekend work aligned with global teams and key events.

The annual pay range for this position is $240,000 - $300,200.


The pay offered for this role may be influenced by factors such as job location, scope of role, qualifications, education, experience, & complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent.

This position is eligible for a Performance Bonus.

raw.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.
Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) Specialist to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The ETL Specialist will develop, maintain, and optimize data integration processes that enable reliable movement and transformation of enterprise data for analytics, reporting, and artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) applications.

This position will support the Summit Data Platform by integrating data from diverse sources, modernizing legacy data workflows, and delivering efficient, scalable data pipelines that meet established performance, quality, and governance standards

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL and Extract, Load, and Transform (ELT) pipelines to ingest, process, and integrate data from enterprise systems, legacy platforms, and cloud-based sources.
  • Develop and optimize data transformation workflows using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, and related technologies.
  • Implement batch, incremental, and streaming data integration processes based on source system characteristics and operational requirements.
  • Transform raw data into standardized, consumption-ready datasets that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and downstream applications.
  • Develop and maintain pipeline orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, and automated error-handling capabilities.
  • Support migration and modernization of legacy data integration processes, ensuring data consistency and continuity between source and target environments.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data quality specialists to implement automated validation, reconciliation, and data freshness checks within integration workflows.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline failures, processing delays, and performance issues, implementing corrective actions to improve reliability and efficiency.
  • Optimize data movement and transformation processes to improve processing speed, resource utilization, and cloud operating costs.
  • Collaborate with data governance specialists to implement approved data standards, metadata requirements, and data lineage documentation within integration workflows.
  • Maintain technical documentation, including source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, pipeline configurations, and operational procedures.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Five or more years of professional experience developing and maintaining enterprise ETL, ELT, or data integration solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data extraction, transformation, and processing.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, or comparable enterprise data integration technologies.
  • Experience integrating data from relational databases, application programming interfaces (APIs), flat files, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Experience developing and maintaining batch and incremental data processing workflows.
  • Knowledge of data transformation techniques, source-to-target mapping, and relational data modeling.
  • Experience implementing pipeline scheduling, orchestration, monitoring, and error handling.
  • Experience troubleshooting data integration failures and optimizing pipeline performance.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.
  • The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting VA or other federal agency data modernization initiatives.
  • Experience migrating legacy ETL processes to Microsoft Azure cloud environments.
  • Experience with Delta Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, or dedicated SQL pools.
  • Experience implementing streaming or event-driven data integration using Apache Kafka or comparable technologies.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices for automated pipeline deployment.
  • Experience working with sensitive healthcare data and federal privacy and security requirements.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate or comparable data integration certification.

Benefits (including but not limited to):

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Optional FSA
  • Paid parental leave
  • Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
  • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
  • No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
  • Pet insurance
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend
  • Tuition and training reimbursement

raw.description:
Make Every Experience Matter

Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe. 

About the opportunity :

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to shape the future of two complementary PharmaTech products: Platforce and Kheiron.

Platforce helps pharmaceutical and life sciences companies improve field execution, HCP engagement, commercial operations, and performance intelligence. It supports pharma-specific workflows through its own CRM capabilities and integrations with existing enterprise systems.

Kheiron is an AI-powered field-readiness and training platform that enables pharmaceutical professionals to practice realistic HCP interactions, receive structured feedback, and strengthen commercial effectiveness.
Together, the products address connected challenges across field readiness, customer engagement, execution, and performance. Each also delivers independent value to customers.

We are seeking someone who combines strong software product management expertise with a sound understanding of pharmaceutical commercial operations and enjoys working directly with customers.

Your mission:

Lead the evolution of our products from primarily customer-request-driven development toward a proactive, customer-validated, and commercially focused approach. Initially, you will operationalize our current product strategy and roadmap. As you build market and product knowledge, you will increasingly shape strategy and identify new opportunities for differentiation and growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand customers and validate opportunities
    - Engage directly with pharmaceutical companies, commercial leaders, SFE and Commercial Excellence professionals, and end users.
    - Conduct discovery interviews; understand customer workflows, challenges, and unmet needs.
    - Use customer research, feedback, and product usage data to validate ideas and test product concepts before development.
    - Recognize patterns across customers and distinguish market needs from individual feature requests.
  • Shape product strategy and roadmaps
    - Translate business objectives and market insight into clear priorities across Platforce and Kheiron.
    - Own and continuously refine product roadmap proposals and prioritization rationale.
    - Evaluate initiatives against customer value, strategic differentiation, commercial impact, effort, and risk.
    - Research competitors and emerging technologies to identify meaningful opportunities for innovation.
    - Build a coherent portfolio proposition while preserving the standalone value of each product.
  • Partner with the product development team
    - Work closely with Project Managers, Business Analysts, engineers, designers, and QA specialists.
    - Define customer problems, expected outcomes, functional scope, and success criteria for initiatives.
    - Guide Business Analysts in converting validated decisions into actionable requirements and user stories.
    - Resolve scope and prioritization trade-offs; review solutions and assess whether delivered features create the expected value.
    - Support releases, adoption, and iterative improvement.
  • Contribute to commercial product success
    - Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to align product investments with market needs.
    - Contribute to product positioning, value propositions, pricing and packaging, launches, and go-to-market initiatives.
    - Participate in strategic product conversations, selected demonstrations, and customer-facing presales discussions.
    - Identify product-led opportunities to increase adoption, retention, customer value, and revenue growth.
    - Define and monitor product success measures, including adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, and business impact.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience managing B2B SaaS or enterprise software products.

This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis.

Android Police is expanding its freelance roster and hiring multiple experienced features writers to deliver sharp, authoritative stories across the Android universe. You’ll pitch and produce original, reader-obsessed narratives—deep dives, hands-on experiments, timely takes—that power our site, social channels, and newsletters.

What We Cover

• Android phones, tablets, and apps

• Smart home devices and ecosystems

  • Amazon Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Kindle lineup
  • E Ink hardware (e-readers, note-takers, displays)
  • Android OS updates, features, and hidden tricks

• Productivity apps and workflows

The Role

  • Hands-on writing: Freelance contract with a minimum set of published stories per month.
  • Pitch-driven: You own your ideas. Submit strong pitches weekly.
  • Quick-response availability: Pitch and file same-day or next-day pieces on breaking news, OS drops, or viral trends.
  • No commerce, affiliate, or sponsored content—100% editorial.
  • Mix of formats: A healthy chunk of first-person pieces, plus reported features, how-tos, and analysis.

Requirements

  • Proven experience: 3+ years writing features for established tech/consumer outlets (prior bylines required).
  • Deep knowledge of at least one beat above; bonus for multiple.
  • Hardware on hand: Current Android devices (Android 14+) and any smart home/E Ink gear you’ll cover.
  • US or Canada-based preferred. We’ll consider exceptional writers elsewhere if you can reliably work within an Eastern time zone.
  • Passion for your beat and a drive to deliver fresh, original takes.

Big Plusses

  • Solid media contacts for exclusives and sourcing
  • Bylines at outlets like Android Authority, 9to5Google, 9to5Mac, XDA, Pocket-lint, How-To Geek, or similar
  • Strong social-media presence and engaged following
  • Familiarity with Android Police’s voice and audience

How We Work

  • Payment: Timely bi-monthly or monthly payments via PayPal, or Payoneer. Competitive per-story rates, paid on publication.
  • Process: Every piece goes through professional copy edit; we create custom art; your work is promoted across our social channels and newsletters.
  • Quality bar: Excellent, well-sourced writing (we fact-check everything).
  • Long-term home: Most writers stay for years. We run training workshops, offer growth paths to fixed base roles, product-review gigs, and more.

Application Requirements

  1. Three relevant previously written articles (at least one hands-on)
  2. Brief note on your primary beat + hardware setup
  3. Fresh pitch idea tailored to Android Police
  4. Links to your social profiles / portfolio

We will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you'd make a solid addition to the team.

raw.description:
About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced English into Bulgarian linguists specializing in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) documentation translation and review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate medical device and in vitro diagnostics documentation from English (US) into Bulgarian.

  • Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated content, ensuring accuracy, terminology consistency, and compliance with project-specific quality requirements.

  • Review and address QA feedback and client feedback on flagged linguistic issues.

  • Meet agreed deadlines and maintain consistent quality across assigned projects.

  • Work within the client's CAT tool environment using MemoQ version 12.5 or higher.

Field of Expertise

  • Medical Devices: Instructions for Use (IFUs), user manuals, product documentation, technical documentation and related materials.

  • In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD): Diagnostic product documentation, instructions, labeling and related medical content.

Must-Have Criteria

Relevant Translation Experience

  • At least two years of professional translation experience in Life Sciences, specifically involving Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics documentation.

  • Practical experience translating medical and technical documentation in the relevant fields. Experience exclusively in Patents is not sufficient.

  • Familiarity with ISO standards and quality requirements applicable to Life Sciences translation.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with MemoQ version 12.5 or higher is mandatory.

  • Candidates must have a suitable desktop version of MemoQ installed. The free version is also acceptable.

  • A MemoQ license will be provided by the client; there is no need to purchase one.

  • Ability to perform both Translation and Copy Edit tasks.

Nice-to-Have

  • Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology or a related field.

  • Previous experience working with medical device manufacturers, IVD companies, CROs or other Life Sciences organizations.

  • Familiarity with medical terminology, regulatory requirements and quality assurance processes in the medical industry.

Project Details

  • Language Pair: English (US) into Bulgarian

  • Task Types: Translation and Copy Edit

  • Content Specialties: Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics

  • Expected Capacity: Weekly availability required.

  • CAT Tool: MemoQ version 12.5 or higher (mandatory; license provided).

Additional Project Information:

  • Translation tasks are paid per word.

  • Copy Edit tasks are paid either per hour or per word, depending on the project scope and volume.

  • For smaller Copy Edit assignments, payment will be calculated per word, as minimum fees cannot be offered.

  • Follow-up tasks may include reviewing QA feedback and addressing client feedback on issues flagged during quality checks.

  • These follow-up activities are covered within the initial scope of the assigned task and will not require a separate PO.

  • Any tasks outside the initial project scope, or assignments for projects in which you were not originally involved, will be covered by a separate PO.

Before Applying

Please note that an assessment will be part of our onboarding and quality procedure. Candidates will be required to complete the standard Medical Devices assessment. Please only apply if you are willing to complete the assessment.

Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical Devices translation experience, including:

  • Total years of professional translation experience.

  • Years of experience specifically in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics.

  • Examples of medical documentation and content types translated.

  • Your experience with memoQ (please specify the version used).

  • Your experience performing both Translation and Copy Edit.

  • Your contact information (email AND phone number).

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

We look forward to receiving your application!

raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance (P4).

About the job

We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services.

We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation. In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset and a desire to solve big challenges, you’ll find yourself at home.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes
  • Negotiate with customers and carriers with an understanding of resolution levers available as per contractual terms and industry norms
  • Identify, analyze, and handle fraudulent misuse (such as Artificially Inflated Traffic) and billing errors (such as rate differences) with both vendors and customers
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer and vendor disputes from intake of disputes to initiating disputes, tracking progress, and ensuring timely, documented resolution
  • Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes
  • Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud
  • Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes
  • Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is
  • Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices
  • Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in telecom operations, fraud operations, customer success, vendor management, procurement, collections, or consulting.
  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience negotiating disputes constructively with customers or vendors.
  • Experience in collections, dispute resolution, or billing analysis.
  • Experience in project management.
  • Experience wrangling data with Excel / Google Sheets, Looker or SQL.

Desired:

  • Understanding of the A2P SMS ecosystem, international traffic routing, international revenue share fraud (IRSF), artificially inflated traffic (AIT) and the ecosystem profit chains.
  • Understanding of industry standards with respect to AIT and fraud handling such as frameworks from i3forum, GSMA, MEF or ITW Global Leaders’ Forum.
  • Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files.
  • Experience working with workflow platforms like Airtable or building dashboards.
  • Experience in telecom, technology, or consulting industries.
  • Experience with advanced data analysis like Python or scripting
  • Experience with AI and automation tools to accelerate productivity.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CT, NJ, NY, WA, PA or the surrounding areas of San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, or San Jose, CA

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. 108,720.00 - $135,900.00.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $115,120.00 - $143,900.00.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $127,920.00 - $159,900.00.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs)

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 30, 2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
