raw.title: Director, Logistics
raw.excerpt: Finding the right place to grow your career isn’t (over) easy, so we’re here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms.
raw.description:
Finding the right place to grow your career isn’t (over) easy, so we’re here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms. We think you’ll appreciate our focus on Conscious Capitalism, which drives business decisions that benefit all our stakeholders (leading to even better business results). You might be drawn to our innovative approach and refusal to settle for the “way things have always been done.” Or you could find it exciting to grow your skills while working for an industry-leading brand. Whether you’re into our values, our brand, or our egg-cellent puns, we hope you’ll join our Crew and help us change the world 108 square feet at a time!

At Vital Farms, we’re proud of the diverse communities we serve and the stakeholders who help bring our purpose to life. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it.

Your Role:

This position reports to the Vice President, Supply Chain.

You know that great logistics is more than moving product from one place to another. It is how we protect quality, deliver for our customers, support our farmers and crew, and grow responsibly. You bring a strong mix of strategy and operational leadership, and you are just as comfortable setting the direction for the network as you are working through a transportation disruption, a provider performance issue, or a difficult cost and service trade-off.

At Vital Farms, you will lead our end-to-end logistics network across inbound farm transportation, outbound customer transportation, warehousing, cold storage, and distribution. You will build the systems, partner relationships, operating rhythms, and team capabilities needed to deliver reliable service, preserve cold-chain integrity, manage cost, and scale with the business.

What You'll Do:

You will own the logistics strategy and lead the team and external partners responsible for moving and storing finished goods safely, reliably, and efficiently across the Vital Farms network.

Lead the logistics strategy and network

  • Set and execute a logistics strategy that supports Vital Farms’ growth, customer commitments, stakeholder model, and evolving supply chain operating model.
  • Own short- and long-range capacity planning across transportation, cold storage, warehousing, and distribution; identify constraints early and build practical contingency plans.
  • Evaluate network design, lane strategy, storage footprint, and operating models to improve service, resilience, scalability, and total delivered cost.
  • Translate logistics performance, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions into clear recommendations for Supply Chain and company leadership.

Own inbound and outbound transportation performance

  • Oversee inbound transportation from farms and suppliers and outbound transportation to customers and distribution points.
  • Lead governance for dedicated fleet and managed transportation partners, including routing, appointment scheduling, load building and optimization, tendering, carrier performance, freight claims, and special requests.
  • Use on-time pickup, on-time delivery, customer scorecards, freight performance, and exception data to set expectations, drive accountability, and improve service.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for transportation disruptions, balancing immediate recovery with root-cause correction and prevention.

Lead warehousing, distribution, and 3PL partnerships

  • Maintain overall accountability for receiving, storage, inventory handling, order fulfillment, and shipping of finished goods across the network.
  • Manage and strengthen relationships with third-party transportation, distribution, and warehousing providers through clear governance, contracts, performance reviews, KPIs, and corrective action plans.
  • Partner with site, Quality, and distribution leaders to maintain food safety, cold-chain integrity, inventory accuracy, pallet and load quality, and consistent shipment standards.
  • Support new facility and distribution-capability readiness, including operating requirements, systems integration, launch planning, and transition into sustainable operations.

Build financial and operational discipline

  • Develop and own logistics budgets and forecasts, including transportation, warehousing, distribution, accessorial, claims, and related operating costs.
  • Identify cost drivers and loss areas, build fact-based recommendations, and deliver sustainable savings without compromising food safety, quality, crew safety, or customer service.
  • Establish a practical KPI and operating-review cadence that creates one shared view of service, inventory flow, capacity, cost, risks, and actions.
  • Partner with Finance and Supply Chain peers on forecasts, accruals, variance reviews, customer pickup economics, and business cases for logistics investments.

Advance systems, data, and continuous improvement

  • Improve the integration and effective use of D365, transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, 3PL platforms, automation, and reporting tools.
  • Connect operational data across internal and partner systems so teams can identify issues quickly and translate insights into action.
  • Lead continuous improvement across transportation and distribution, including standard work, exception management, claims, inventory handoffs, customer feedback loops, and escalation paths.
  • Partner with IT, Operations Development, and external providers to improve system reliability, visibility, controls, and readiness for future growth.

Lead the team and cross-functional partnerships

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Logistics team with clear roles, priorities, decision rights, and accountability for results.
  • Build strong working relationships across Farm Support, Operations, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, IT, and commercial teams.
  • Create a culture of urgency, ownership, constructive challenge, learning, and recognition while modeling Vital Farms’ values.
  • Build team capability and succession depth across transportation operations, analytics, systems, partner management, and network leadership.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • You have 10+ years of progressive experience in logistics, transportation, warehousing, or distribution, preferably in food, beverage, CPG, or another temperature-sensitive environment.
  • You have led a complex, multi-node logistics network and managed third-party transportation and warehousing providers.
  • You understand transportation markets, carrier and fleet operations, warehousing and distribution, cold-chain requirements, and relevant regulatory considerations.
  • You can manage budgets, analyze cost and service trade-offs, and deliver measurable operational and financial improvements.
  • You have experience with ERP and supply chain execution technology, such as D365 or a comparable ERP, TMS, WMS, warehouse automation, and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • You use data and sound judgment to turn operational details and ambiguity into clear decisions and action plans.
  • You communicate clearly, influence across functions, negotiate effectively, and lead through external partners as well as direct teams.
  • You are a proven people leader who coaches, develops talent, and creates clear accountability.
  • You are available to travel approximately 20-30% based on business needs, provider reviews, facility support, and network initiatives.
  • Bonus points if you have launched or scaled logistics capabilities, facilities, automation, or major system integrations.
  • You’re no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own.
  • You give a sh*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of.
  • You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day.
  • You can walk in someone else’s boots – You seek to understand other’s viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table.
  • You don’t walk on eggshells – You’re not afraid to leave the bullsh*t behind and have honest conversations.
  • We recognize that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may have strengths we haven’t yet considered!

What We Bring to the Table:

  • A fast-paced, energetic, remote environment with passionate people who are leading a movement to bring ethically produced food to the table.
  • Competitive pay and benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Paid Parental Leave, just to name a few).
  • Generous retirement contributions: 401(k) + 3% Contribution from Day 1.
  • Free eggs, along with friends and family discounts.
  • Fun team SWAG that will make you the talk of the town.
  • Professional development opportunities and an amazing team dedicated to your growth.

At Vital Farms, compensation decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to, skill level, experience, education, training, market demands, and business needs. A reasonable estimate of the current starting annual base salary for this position is $170,000 - $190,000. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum end of the range would not be typical in order to allow for potential continued future salary growth.

#VFPJ

Who We Are:

Vital Farms, a Certified B Corporation, offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms became a national consumer brand that works with 600 family farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Vital Farms’ products, including shell eggs, butter, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs, are sold in over 24,000 stores nationwide.

Vital Farms’ ethics are exemplified by its focus on the humane treatment of farm animals and sustainable farming practices. In addition, as a Delaware Public Benefit Corporation, Vital Farms prioritizes the long-term benefits of each of its stakeholders, including farmers and suppliers, customers and consumers, communities and the environment, crew members, and stockholders. In short, we exist to improve the lives of people, animals, and our planet through food.  

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

To fulfill Vital Farms mission of bringing ethically produced food to the table, we’re committed to building teams that reflect diverse perspectives and lived experiences. We believe that when all crew members feel valued and respected, they bring their best ideas forward - fueling innovation, belonging, and shared success. We strive to create a welcoming environment rooted in equal opportunity and encourage individuals from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

To that end, we make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Vital Farms does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender and gender identity, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, marital status, age, national origin, citizenship status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Ready to Join Us?

Together, we’re cultivating an environment where every Crew member can thrive, grow, and know they’re part of something bigger - improving lives through ethical food.

If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you! Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - you might be exactly what we need!

Next Steps:

Shortly after you complete your application, you'll receive a follow-up email elaborating on any potential next steps in our process. If you don't immediately receive said follow-up email, we would highly encourage you to check your spam filter!

In order to fulfill Vital Farms mission to “bring ethically produced food to the table,” we seek to build teams that leverage diverse perspectives to create a welcoming and innovative environment that is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunities.

To that end, we make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Vital Farms does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender and gender identity, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, marital status, age, national origin, citizenship status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Staying Safe During Your Job Search

At Vital Farms, we care deeply about the people interested in joining our Crew. That includes helping protect candidates from fraudulent recruiting activity and creating a hiring experience that is safe, respectful, and transparent.
Unfortunately, job scams are becoming increasingly common. We encourage all applicants to stay vigilant throughout the hiring process and verify opportunities directly through our official careers page.
Vital Farms recruiters will only contact candidates through official company channels, including email addresses ending in @vitalfarms.com. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or personal banking information during the hiring process. We also do not extend job offers without a formal interview process.
If you receive suspicious communication claiming to represent Vital Farms, we encourage you to avoid engaging and report it to us at .
We are committed to treating every candidate with fairness and respect and to creating a hiring experience worthy of your trust.

Notification to Agencies:

**Vital Farms is not accepting unsolicited third-party recruitment agencies in the hiring process for this role. If you are a potential candidate interested in a role with Vital Farms, please submit an application directly.

California Applicants:

Please see our California Employment Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose personal information as part of our recruitment and hiring process.

Please Note: This position is designated as remote within the United States; however, we are currently unable to employ individuals residing in the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Mississippi, Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota, West Virginia and Wyoming

raw.description:
Job Title: Associate Application Engineer – AI & Data

Location: Remote (Must reside within the contiguous United States)

Department: Business Intelligence

Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt

About the Role

PaceMate is looking for an Associate Application Engineer to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you’ll help build and maintain the internal applications, automation systems, and AI-enabled workflows that power PaceMate’s clinical and operational functions. You’ll work closely with our Senior Director of AI & BI and cross-functional teams, developing APIs, integrations, and data pipelines while getting hands-on experience with modern AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows.

This role is designed for a career-driven technical professional with strong problem-solving ability, curiosity, and an interest in building modern applications, automation systems, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions. The ideal candidate is excited by technology, enjoys learning how systems work together, and wants to grow their skills in application development, automation, and scalable data architecture.

We’re looking for a highly technical builder who can own applications, automate processes, solve complex system problems, and help scale the next generation of internal platforms and AI-enabled solutions across the organization. You’ll work across analytics applications, automation systems, AI workflows, integrations, and operational tooling. This is a role built for someone who wants to grow from a junior-level developer into a well-rounded engineer capable of supporting applications, automation, and intelligent systems.

The ideal candidate naturally thinks: “How do we build this better, automate this, and scale this long-term?” , not someone focused solely on dashboards or manual reporting.

What You’ll Do

Application Development & Support

  • Support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of internal applications and automation systems
  • Help improve application reliability and performance
  • Build APIs, integrations, workflows, and backend services supporting business operations
  • Troubleshoot and resolve bugs, system issues, and performance bottlenecks
  • Contribute to feature development, testing, and modernization efforts

Data & Platform Engineering

  • Develop and optimize data models, queries, and integrations across MySQL, PostgreSQL, Salesforce, and internal systems
  • Build scalable automation and data-processing solutions
  • Help ensure the integrity and reliability of operational and analytical data flows
  • Support AI-enabled workflows and automation pipelines
  • Implement monitoring, validation, and observability practices

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Use AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to accelerate delivery
  • Identify opportunities to automate operational processes
  • Partner with leadership to prototype and deliver innovative solutions
  • Stay current on emerging technologies and recommend scalable approaches

What We’re Looking For

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 1–3 years of experience in software development, automation, data, or a similar technical role (internships, bootcamps, and hands-on project experience count!)
  • Experience supporting applications, scripts, integrations, or automation projects preferred
  • Familiarity with TypeScript, Vue, Python, JavaScript, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, APIs/integration frameworks, or cloud automation tooling is a plus
  • Comfort with (or curiosity about) AI-assisted coding tools like Claude and Cursor
  • Experience in healthcare technology or data-intensive environments is a plus

Nice to Have

  • AWS, EKS
  • Databricks or Snowflake
  • Docker / containerized applications
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR)
  • Experience with frontend frameworks and modern UI development

Logistics

  • 100% remote, open to candidates anywhere in the contiguous U.S.
  • Requires a dedicated home office space and reliable high-speed internet
  • Occasional limited travel may be required

PaceMate is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

About PaceMate®

PaceMate® is a patient-centered, tech-enabled cardiac device monitoring platform serving integrated delivery networks and academic health systems nationwide. Vendor-neutral and EMR-agnostic, PaceMate connects every major device manufacturer into a single platform that sits on top of any EHR.

More than 2.3 million patients are managed on the industry’s only research-grade cardiac dataset, validated by 33 peer-reviewed publications, powering AI-driven clinical and operational analytics. A managed patient services model extends clinic capacity and ensures every cardiac device patient is monitored, every time.

Learn more at PaceMate.com

raw.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Senior Renewal Manager, Enterprise at Chainguard, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the retention and long-term success of our largest and most strategic customers. You will own the renewal process for a defined book of high-value accounts, managing complex, multi-year, multi-product renewals from early planning through close while delivering a thoughtful, value-driven customer experience.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, and Ops. You will partner closely with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers on every account: you own the renewal, CSMs own adoption and outcomes, and AEs lead expansion. Your work ensures renewal conversations start early, are grounded in the value customers have realized, and support Chainguard’s broader revenue and retention goals.

You will act as a trusted partner to customers, guiding renewal conversations with procurement, security leaders, and executives with clarity, empathy, and confidence. Strong business acumen, comfort with complex negotiation, and cross-functional leadership are essential, as each renewal carries significant revenue and requires coordination across many stakeholders.

What you’ll do:

  • Renewal Management: Own the end-to-end renewal process for a portfolio of enterprise customers, starting renewal planning 120+ days out and driving on-time renewals through account strategy, stakeholder engagement, and negotiation.
  • Value & Business Case: Partner with CSMs to build renewal business cases grounded in adoption, CVE reduction, and engineering time saved, and present them to economic buyers and executives.
  • Commercial Execution: Structure and negotiate multi-year terms, ramps, co-terms, and pricing changes, and coordinate with Finance, Legal, customer Procurement, and Deal Desk to ensure accurate and timely contract execution.
  • Account Team Partnership: Work with AEs to align renewals with expansion opportunities, so renewal and growth motions move together rather than compete.
  • Forecasting & CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate renewal data in CRM, including forecasts, risks, and renewal status, to provide clear visibility and predictable outcomes.
  • Risk & Retention Strategy: Identify renewal risks early, including budget pressure, adoption gaps, stakeholder changes, and competitive threats, and lead cross-functional plans to mitigate churn and protect gross retention.
  • Process & Playbooks: Develop and refine enterprise renewal playbooks, including executive engagement and procurement navigation, to increase efficiency and improve on-time renewal rates.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as the escalation point for the most complex renewals, mentor other Renewal Managers, and help shape how the function scales across segments.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B SaaS in renewals, account management, or sales, with direct ownership of six-figure customer contracts.
  • Track record of renewing large, multi-year enterprise agreements at or above value, including through competitive displacement attempts and budget pressure.
  • Proven ability to drive complex renewals with predictability and deliver against gross retention targets.
  • Experience negotiating multi-year agreements, pricing, and contract terms with enterprise procurement teams while maintaining strong customer relationships.
  • Comfort engaging senior stakeholders, including security, engineering, and procurement leaders.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex renewal cycles simultaneously.
  • Comfort generating quotes, preparing order forms, and maintaining CRM hygiene, ideally in Salesforce.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to operate with full autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead the build-out of new processes where needed.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience working with large enterprises in regulated industries such as financial services or healthcare
  • Experience in a high-growth or early-stage startup environment
  • Familiarity with security, DevSecOps, or developer-focused products
  • Passion for technology and cybersecurity

Pay Range: Up to 144,286 GBP 70/30 OTE

If your experience is close, but doesn’t fulfill all requirements, please apply. Chainguard is on a mission to build the best team. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring Chainguardians with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

Work with Storyblok’s dynamic legal team and play a vital role in our day-to-day operations in the EMEA region. The primary focus of this role is leading SaaS sales contract negotiations—drafting, redlining, and closing enterprise agreements that enable Storyblok’s EMEA sales team to move quickly and confidently. Beyond contracts, your responsibilities span advising on corporate, privacy, employment and labor law, and supporting product and cybersecurity compliance initiatives. You will lead legal projects with autonomy, guide business teams, and collaborate with external counsel as needed. While focused on the EMEA region, you will also support legal initiatives in AMER, contributing to global policies and aligning legal processes across regions. Additionally, you will provide legal training, empower team members to manage day-to-day legal tasks, and support the legal leadership in executing strategic priorities and continuous improvement efforts.

This role requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional teams across the company—with a particular emphasis on the Sales team—as well as Marketing, Partners, Product, People, etc., to provide practical, business-minded legal support .

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Lead the redlining & negotiating process and own SaaS enterprise sales contracts as the primary focus of this role—including MSA, GTC/ToS, NDA, DPA, and other legal agreements—enabling the EMEA sales team to close deals efficiently and with legal confidence
  • Advise on legal principles relating to data privacy, IP, information security, and corporate risk mitigation
  • Lead the review and negotiate partnership agreements with our partners in EMEA
  • Lead (globally) with review and negotiation of procurement and marketing contracts as needed
  • Lead HR related projects & provide legal support for certain employment and labor law topics
  • Draft, review, and maintain company-wide policies in accordance with applicable legal requirements and organisational governance standards
  • Responsible for monitoring and assessing developments in applicable laws and regulations, advising the business on emerging legal risks and required adaptations to agreements, policies, or operational practices
  • Provide legal advice and lead from a legal side the new product initiatives & feature launches
  • Initiate and lead comprehensive legal training to different teams (e.g. prepare and structure the information for training)
  • Independently lead and own the end-to-end delivery of cross-functional legal projects and improvement initiatives across multiple business regions, ensuring coherent alignment with applicable regulatory frameworks, local counsel, and key business stakeholders
  • Identity and lead the continuous improvement of legal processes, templates, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency and best practice adoption across the organisation
  • Support the legal team to build and maintain documentation for the whole team
  • Be responsible and contribute across a range of administrative functions and project-based work, adapting to evolving priorities and business needs
  • Provide accurate and concise legal research as needed
  • Drive and implement regional legal strategies to support the company’s growth and operations


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Law Degree and Bar Admission to at least one jurisdiction in Europe
  • 4+ years of experience with a primary focus on drafting, redlining, and negotiating sales contracts. SaaS or fast-paced tech experience providing in-house support to enterprise sales teams is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Enterprise Sales teams to negotiate customer-facing commercial agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, Terms of Service, and related SaaS contracts.
  • Strong understanding of commercial contracting with deep expertise in sales contracts and legal processes
  • Broad and in-depth specialized knowledge of the EU legal framework plus some knowledge of the UK and/or U.S. law would be strongly preferred

QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent English language skills
  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of contracts under tight deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders including sales, finance, HR, and product teams
  • Interested in learning fast and participating in a wide variety of legal projects
  • Skilled in providing concise legal advice to business teams
  • Ability to analyze the needs of different parties quickly and provide a creative solution
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of matters end-to-end, while operating effectively within a broader legal team structure
  • Understands and perform in complex legal and business processes
  • Good organizational skills & well structured to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.
  • Takes initiative and brings a sense of accountability in the workplace - proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented
  • Overcomes challenges through teamwork, optimism, and just enough humor to keep things exciting (without compromising professionalism, of course)

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

raw.description:
At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

Position Description
Connect Centric is seeking an HRIS Data Conversion Analyst to provide subject matter expertise and hands-on support for the extraction, preparation, validation, conversion, and testing of Human Capital Management (HCM) data from UKG to Workday in support of our client’s Workday implementation.

You will partner with HR, finance, IT, and Workday implementation partners to support end-to-end data conversion activities, including data readiness, conversions, validation, and testing. You will also support routine UKG reporting throughout the implementation period.

What You Will Do
• Review existing UKG data structures, tables, and historical records used for Core HR, Recruiting, Benefits, and Talent data.
• Identify data quality risks, gaps, and dependencies early in the conversion process.
• Extract data from UKG using People Analytics reporting through IBM Cognos Analytics.
• Clean, standardize, and transform data to align with Workday data models and load requirements, applying business rules for data mapping and translation.
• Prepare the load-ready data templates required for Workday conversion.
• Develop and maintain detailed data mapping documents from UKG fields to Workday objects and fields.
• Document transformation logic, assumptions, exclusions, and data ownership, and support creation of a data dictionary.
• Support conversions and test loads into Workday tenants.
• Perform data validation and reconciliation between UKG and Workday, and prepare validation and reconciliation summaries.
• Identify and troubleshoot data load errors and exceptions; maintain issue logs and track conversion defects through resolution in partnership with functional leads.
• Support user acceptance testing by validating converted data against business expectations.
• Assist with final data loads and cutover planning, and provide post-load validation support during go-live readiness activities.
• Support ongoing scheduled and ad hoc reporting needs in UKG during the implementation period.
• Collaborate with functional and technical teams to identify, document, and manage reporting dependencies that may shift as reporting sources transition from UKG to Workday.

Required Qualifications
• Demonstrated experience with HR data conversions for Workday implementations.
• Hands-on experience extracting and preparing data from UKG Pro, including Core, Recruiting, Onboarding, and Learning.
• Strong understanding of UKG and Workday HCM data structures.
• Advanced Excel skills, including data validation, lookups, and transformation logic.
• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
• Ability to document complex data logic clearly for functional and technical stakeholders.
• Experience working in cross-functional implementation teams.
• Ability to manage multiple conversion activities under tight timelines.

Position Details
Position Type: W2
Location: Fully Remote
Pay Rate: $115,000 - $125,000/per year
Must be permitted to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

raw.description:
Description

Fullpath by Cox Automotive is a fast growing tech company in the automotive space with hubs across the US and Israel. We are disrupting the multi-trillion dollar transportation industry with our advanced Customer Data Platform (CDP) . Our work happens in the fast lane as we bring AI-powered, data-driven solutions to a quickly evolving industry.

Our team at Fullpath is made up of curious and creative individuals who are always looking to achieve the impossible. We are bold, collaborative, and goal driven, and, at our core, we believe every voice has value and can impact our bottom line.

If you are a creative, solutions oriented individual who is ready to put your career in drive, Fullpath is the place for you!

We are seeking a dynamic Director, Retail Sales to work side by side with our Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) in their territories to drive pipeline growth and ensure consistent quota attainment. This is a hands-on field leadership role: you will develop and mentor RSMs and their teams, coach them through every stage of the sales cycle, and ensure all revenue KPIs and metrics are met. You will also recruit and train new RSMs and collaborate cross-functionally to enhance market awareness and achieve revenue goals.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background of progressively responsible experience, a proven record of consistent quota attainment, strong management of sales performance metrics, a vast network in the automotive industry, and exceptional communication and leadership skills. They excel in data-driven decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and SaaS sales, with a proven ability to teach and execute all stages of the sales process. A high level of accountability, ethical standards, and professionalism is essential for success in this role.

This is a remote role reporting to the Head of National Sales with significant travel across the US required.

﻿The salary range listed reflects total on-target earnings (base + variable/commission). Please refer to the compensation details at the bottom of the posting for the full breakdown of base salary and variable structure.

What you will be responsible for

  • Partnering with Regional Sales Managers in their territories, in person and on site, to drive pipeline growth and ensure consistent quota attainment.
  • Developing and mentoring RSMs and their teams, equipping them with both tactical and strategic sales approaches through field coaching, joint prospect meetings, and ongoing feedback.
  • Owning the delivery of all revenue KPIs and metrics, ensuring targets are met and holding teams accountable to them.
  • Driving the achievement of annual financial performance targets by providing strategic sales leadership and clear vision.
  • Leading and supporting all aspects of the sales cycle, including lead generation, prospect cultivation, territory management, and prospect meetings.
  • Conducting weekly pipeline and forecasting reviews, providing coaching on effective sales strategies to ensure deal closure.
  • Recruiting, onboarding, and training new Regional Sales Managers to build a high-performing sales team.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Customer Support and Customer Success to ensure client satisfaction, build pipeline, and support revenue goals.
  • Tracking and optimizing all individual performance goals, ensuring accountability and alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Traveling significantly into the territories to work directly with RSMs, Cox Automotive team members, and key dealer partners.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible work experience, with management experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of consistent quota attainment, effective pipeline management, and completion of sales-related activities, with the ability to coach and develop individual contributors to achieve the same.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Extensive network and established relationships within the automotive industry. • Dynamic and energetic leader who employs a data-driven approach to drive business growth and team development.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with multiple business units to achieve organizational objectives.
  • Demonstrated expertise in articulating and teaching all stages of the sales process, including prospecting, demonstrations, and negotiations.
  • Strong sense of accountability and unwavering commitment to ethical standards and professional excellence.
  • Willingness and ability to travel significantly into the territories, including domestic travel by plane; valid driver’s license.
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods and perform extensive computer work, both of which are key aspects of this role.
  • Ability to perform job duties from a home office, when applicable, utilizing necessary technology and maintaining productivity.
  • Regular, reliable attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the job to ensure consistent workflow and communication.
  • Drug Testing: To be employed in this role, you'll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Why you should join us

  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Learning and growth opportunities within a fast-paced tech startup environment
  • An awesome team of forward-thinking, innovative go-getters
  • A family-friendly atmosphere
  • An opportunity to represent top-notch AI technology that solves our customers' challenges

﻿Annual base starting salary: $100,000 - $120,000, depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. On target earnings (base + variable) up to $260,000, with overachievement possible.

Benefits Options: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D, EAP, flexible time off (take as much paid vacation as you deem consistent with your duties and company needs), 7 paid holidays, up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually, additional paid time off for bereavement, voting, jury duty, volunteering, military leave, and parental leave, & 401k with company match.

In the meantime, you can get to know us a little better by checking out @lifeatfullpath on Instagram and Facebook.

description: Infilla is looking for a Founding Partnerships Lead to build the network of allies, funders, and distribution partners that brings Infilla warm introductions, funded deployments, and deals that direct sales couldn't reach alone.

raw.title: Founding Partnerships Lead
raw.excerpt: Infilla is looking for a Founding Partnerships Lead to build the network of allies, funders, and distribution partners that brings Infilla warm introductions, funded deployments, and deals that direct sales couldn't reach alone.
raw.description:
Infilla is looking for a Founding Partnerships Lead to build the network of allies, funders, and distribution partners that brings Infilla warm introductions, funded deployments, and deals that direct sales couldn't reach alone.

As our first partnerships hire, you'll build Infilla's relationships with the industry associations, consultants, and philanthropies that shape how cities and counties approve housing. We already know which organizations matter in each state. Your job is to turn that playbook into trusted relationships and a steady flow of warm introductions for our sales team.

Infilla's mission is to make more housing happen faster by making permitting unremarkable. The U.S. is short 4-7 million homes, and local permitting is one of the top bottlenecks with approvals taking months to years. Infilla is building the modern permitting platform that helps local governments review projects faster, more consistently, and more transparently. Customers include San Francisco, New York City, and the State of Delaware, among others. We're backed by Basis Set Ventures, Base10 Partners, Urban Innovation Fund, SHAKTI VC, 20Growth, Bloomberg Beta, and 20+ founders/operators who've built products at scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER

  • Infilla has trusted relationships in 15 priority states with the industry associations who shape permitting, housing, or municipal government

  • 3+ philanthropic partners run innovation-grant programs that fund municipalities to adopt Infilla

  • 3+ consulting partners have signed referral or co-sell agreements, write Infilla into their client proposals, and have each brought Infilla at least one qualified opportunity

  • Every ally, partner, and funder lives in one tracker with an owner, a next step, and the pipeline or dollars it produced

WHAT YOU'VE DONE BEFORE

  • Built partnerships that produced results you can name in deals, dollars, and dates, not just MOUs signed or events attended

  • Run complex projects and many stakeholder relationships at once, in consulting, chief of staff, policy, or startup roles

  • Ended or turned down partnerships that weren't working, and can explain why the partners you kept said yes and stayed engaged

  • Earned past partners or funders who would happily work with you again

  • Made AI a core part of how you work, not an occasional assist

WHAT YOU'RE GREAT AT

Relationship building is where you must be great; commercial judgment is a close second.

  • Relationship building: You earn trust fast and keep it. You're equally comfortable with homebuilders, planners, funders, and elected officials, across red and blue states. You learn what each ally needs and deliver it before asking for anything, and you turn one intro into three.

  • Commercial judgment: You know which relationships lead to deals and money. You pick allies by whether they reach our buyers, understand referral and co-sell terms, and can present Infilla as an outcome a foundation already wants.

  • Project management and follow-through: You run dozens of relationships at once without dropping anything. Every ally has a next step and a date, and every intro you hand to sales arrives with context.

  • Clear writing: Your intro emails, partner one-pagers, and grant applications lead with the point, use real numbers, and stay calm and nonpartisan.

  • Scrappy, AI-leveraged execution: You're a team of one who ships the good-enough draft now and improves it later. You use AI daily for research, drafting, and meeting prep, and you keep the CRM current without being asked.

NICE TO HAVE, NOT NEEDED

  • Existing relationships in housing and land use: Homebuilders Associations, Building Industry Associations, ULI, housing nonprofits, or YIMBY groups

  • Won foundation or grant funding

  • GovTech or public-sector experience

Research shows women & minorities are more likely to consider themselves unqualified if they don't meet every single requirement in a job description. This represents what we're ideally looking for, but everyone is unique. We hire for strengths & potential, not lack of weakness or a perfect resume fit.

DETAILS

  • This is a remote US-based role, with a preference for candidates in Washington, D.C. We're open to a contract-to-hire or full-time arrangement.

    • Travel is on an as-needed basis for conferences and networking events

  • You will join the GTM team and report to the CEO

  • Full-time benefits: meaningful equity, healthcare / vision / dental insurance, 401K, and 26 days of PTO including federal holidays

  • We cannot sponsor visas at this time

THE PROCESS

We aim to make this happen in 1-2 weeks:

  1. Initial call with Jenny, our CEO, to assess mutual fit (20 min)

  2. Past work deep dive with Jenny to assess relationship building and commercial judgment (60 min)

  3. Network-building session with Jenny on how you'd grow Infilla's relationships in one priority state (60 min)

  4. 3 reference checks, including at least one partner or funder you've worked with

HOW WE WORK

  • Ideas > Hierarchy - Best idea wins regardless of source. Be intellectually honest.

  • Kind > Nice - Share clear, helpful feedback often. Voice your concerns and listen.

  • Courage > Comfort - We do the right thing, even when hard or uncomfortable.

  • Hours > Weeks - Solve it in hours, not "eventually." Speed is our biggest edge as a startup.

  • Fix > Flag - See a problem, own it, and fix it — don't wait for someone else to.

LEGAL

Infilla is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the interview process, let us know and we'll make it work.

raw.description:
Overview

POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the general supervision of the Operations Manager, the Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for the coordination of administrative processing of disability determinations for all in and out of state contracts. This position is responsible for making strategic decisions on case assignment and for keeping cases on timeline. The Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for work flow management and training of Disability Assistants as well as performing those front line functions when necessary to maintain unit production standards. This position is the primary hub for all incoming/outgoing correspondence, disability supplements, and is the primary interface with clients, agencies, and DES staff regarding incoming and outgoing medical information, mail, transportation and records. Decisions made in this area directly impact the timeline for the disability review process, the workload of review staff, and the determination of benefits for all in and out of state agency applicants. The Lead Disability Assistant is a primary customer service interface for DES' SPMP with clients and external agencies.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Manage unit work flow, assuring the proper numbers of Disability Assistants are assigned to each task on a daily basis.
  • Train new and existing Disability Assistants in work functions and job duties.
  • Monitor customer service phone queues for adequate coverage and provide call escalation response for front line staff.
  • Monitor unit key performance indicators.
  • Act as unit Disability Liaison for agency partner inquiries and issues.
  • Track priority case requests and ensure prompt completion of work on such cases.
  • Initial review of all disability supplements for accuracy, completeness, and alerting SPMP of priority cases and of important clinical information contained in cases.
  • Make complex decisions regarding privacy matters associated with the client’s case, including determination of who DES may exchange information with regarding the client’s case, what information may be mailed, and what is required, by HIPAA, to allow conversations to take place. These decisions are conveyed to SPMP through detailed case notes and individual consultation.
  • Determine if requests for information are legally complete, communicate with agencies about cases that do not meet HIPAA requirements for protected healthcare information and consult with SPMP about decisions regarding whether to return to cases to the agencies or clients for further development.
  • Telephone contact with clinical treating sources to assure timely receipt of clinical information at the request and direction of SPMP.
  • Review information in external databases such as the Massachusetts Medicaid Information System and MassHealth MA21databases in order to identify cases that SPMP could complete quickly.
  • Coordinate transportation of clients to consultative examinations and provide feedback to SPMP on unusual circumstances that would impact the review process.
  • Make decisions for rescheduling of clients’ clinical evaluations, based upon agency guidelines and provides input and feedback to SPMP. Explain complex state and federal regulations to clients, agencies and medical providers, answer disability process questions as they arise.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2-Year College Degree in business or a related field
  • 5-7 years of relevant office experience
  • Demonstrated knowledge of medical terminology or willingness to take a course in Medical Terminology
  • Knowledge of HIPAA laws and regulations especially as it refers to the confidentiality of PHI
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office products, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor and generate reports
  • Requires organizational and excellent interpersonal skills, oral and written communication skills necessary to interact with all levels of personnel.

Additional Information

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in a medical setting
  • Knowledge of DEScovery database
  • Experience working as a member of an inbound/outbound call center
  • Experience training staff on complex tasks
  • Ability to create power point demonstrations for the purpose of training staff
  • Thorough understanding of DES’s processes and procedures pertaining to all in and out of state contracts
  • Ability to create processes and procedures for new programs as need arises.

raw.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
raw.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

As a Manual Exploratory Tester (User Testing) , you will play a critical role in validating the quality of our Luma platform. You will focus on exploratory/user testing—investigating new features, workflows, and edge cases to uncover unexpected behaviours and usability issues. You’ll work closely with developers, product owners, and automation engineers to ensure defects are caught early, well-documented, and resolved quickly.

A background in science (chemistry, biology, or related field) is required as you will understand the scientific workflows and real-world use cases of our customers.

In this role you will get to:

  • Conduct exploratory and manual testing (UAT) across web-based applications within the Luma platform.
  • Develop tests/exploratory test guides to ensure business requirements are met and provide detailed feedback to design/product.
  • Validate new features, integrations, and scientific workflows, ensuring functionality aligns with product requirements and user expectations.
  • Log clear, reproducible bug reports and collaborate with developers for quick resolution.
  • Provide critical feedback on usability, scientific workflow efficiency, and overall user experience.
  • Collaborate with automation engineers to identify areas suitable for automated coverage and review assertions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness activities.
  • Advocate for quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

We are looking for people who have an education in, or significant work experience in Biology, Chemistry, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences or similar scientific field and can demonstrate experience as a User Tester, Scientific Application administrator/owner, Software Tester, QA Analyst/User Testing, with a strong focus on exploratory testing

The key skills we are looking for

  • Extensive knowledge of biology or chemistry, with the ability to understand and test scientific user experiences and workflows.
  • Experience using or testing scientific/informatics software, ideally within a scientific environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity to probe beyond obvious test cases.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies, edge cases and usability issues.
  • Personal experience using AI-driven tools and workflows to support day-to-day work.
  • Understanding of SaaS architecture, integrations and security.

You may also have:

  • Experience testing SaaS or complex web applications
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Zephyr Scale, or similar test management/bug tracking systems
  • Hands-on experience with backend validation, including API testing and database checks
  • Calling APIs with tools like Postman/Bruno
  • Practical knowledge of GraphQL, including querying, mutations, and schema validation
  • experience with backend validation of APIs, services, and database interactions to ensure data integrity and system reliability.
  • Tools like Postman/Bruno for RESTful API testing and validate GraphQL queries/mutations against backend services.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer

Salary:

$128,000.00 - $176,000.00

Location:

Home / Mobile,AZ-001

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced and technically adept Technical Consultant to join our Process Quality team. In this role, you will lead presales technical engagements for our process quality offerings — including AI-enabled capabilities — building and delivering demos, presales collateral, and technical consultations that showcase the value of our Fault Detection (FD), Run-to-Run (R2R), and Statistical Process Control (SPC) solutions. Your deep semiconductor fab process quality expertise, combined with working knowledge of ML/AI applications, will play a key role in addressing client needs, differentiating our product and AI offerings, and driving successful customer adoption.

Travel Requirement: up to 25%

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement

  • Collaborate with sales teams to identify customer needs, conduct requirements analysis, and design process quality solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Lead and standardize product demonstrations and proof-of-concept (PoC) activities for FD, R2R, SPC, and AI-enabled process quality applications.
  • Customize demos to highlight the unique value of our process quality solutions and AI/ML-based quality capabilities (e.g., anomaly detection, virtual metrology models).
  • Develop technical proposals, solution configurations, and ROI/value narratives to align offerings with customer-specific needs.

Technical Consultation and AI/ML Enablement

  • Provide in-depth technical consultation and training materials on process quality product features, functionality, and integration capabilities.
  • Maintain working knowledge of ML/AI techniques applied to process quality, sufficient to explain and position these capabilities with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate capabilities and use cases into customer-facing messaging.

Feedback and Product Improvement

  • Work closely with product development and engineering teams to design tailored FD/R2R/SPC and AI-enabled solutions that address customer requirements.
  • Gather feedback from regional presales and customers to inform continuous product and AI based quality capabilities improvements.
  • Act as the voice of the customer, communicating needs and challenges to the product development team.

Business Process

  • Maintain up-to-date presales collateral, demo assets, and training materials for the worldwide presales team.
  • Centralize documentation throughout the presales process, from opportunity identification through customer commitment.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in a semiconductor fab or related high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Prior experience in technical presales, solutions engineering, or consulting, including building collateral and delivering customer demos.

Technical Proficiency

  • In-depth knowledge of process quality applications: Fault Detection (FD), Run-to-Run (R2R) control, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor process flows, equipment, and metrology.
  • Working knowledge of ML/AI concepts and applications in process/quality monitoring (e.g., anomaly detection, virtual metrology), with the ability to speak credibly to technical and business audiences.
  • Familiarity with data analytics tools (Python, SQL, JMP, Minitab, or similar) is a plus.

Communication Skills

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with experience interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customer executives.

Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

  • Ability to assess complex customer requirements, analyze large process/quality datasets, and design tailored solutions that address technical challenges effectively.

Additional Information

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 25% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

As an Associate Dean of Academic Strategy Management, you will be a full-time member of university staff responsible for advancing strategic priorities in our online Global Campus (GC) organization. You will lead, support, and implement cross-functional initiatives in partnership with academic and operational teams, translating established strategy into coordinated plans, projects, and measurable outcomes.


You will provide subject matter expertise in academic strategy, analysis, and process improvement, with a focus on strengthening academic operations, supporting academic quality and effectiveness, and improving the processes and infrastructure that enable effective work. You will use data, technology, and continuous improvement practices to identify opportunities and support informed decision-making.


You will report to an Executive Director of Academic Strategy Management and may provide project or initiative leadership to faculty and staff in support of established goals and strategic priorities.


What you'll do:


Academic Operations

  • Provide operational support for academic processes, using data, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to monitor trends and program health, suggest enhancements, and identify emerging risks.
  • Evaluate academic policies and contribute to policy review efforts to ensure clarity, compliance, and consistency.
  • Contribute to governance processes and institutional decision-making practices.
  • Support accreditation reporting by coordinating with key institutional partners.
  • Strengthen program review processes by evaluating user feedback and recommending changes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong working relationships and serve as a trusted point of contact for colleagues across the university, coordinating requests and sharing information to promote shared accountability and the adoption of new tools and practices.
  • Work with partner teams to align and standardize non-curricular academic requirements.
  • Facilitating cross-functional groups as needed to clarify responsibilities, coordinate shared processes, and support consistent implementation/execution.

Strategic Implementation, Process Improvement & Innovation

  • Lead, support, and participate in institutional and programmatic initiatives, defining clear measures of success in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Implement academic process improvement to reduce rework, delay, and cost while increasing scalability.
  • Guide the integration, use, and adoption of AI and other emerging technologies in academic operations through responsible, well-governed implementation.

What we're looking for:

  • At least 2 years of progressive experience working in higher education administration.
  • A master's degree from a regionally accredited higher education institution.
  • Broad knowledge of a wide range of functional areas within higher education institutions.
  • Demonstrated experience in project management, including planning, coordinating, and executing cross-functional initiatives within higher education or other similar environments
  • Foundational understanding of artificial intelligence (AI), including its practical applications, with the ability to learn, evaluate, and effectively apply emerging AI technologies.


We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request.

Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $97,384.00 - $131,756.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

We are seeking an experienced HR, Leave Administration, or Employee Relations professional to lead a project focused on strengthening our employer accommodations and leave of absence programs. This role will build a scalable framework for managing workplace accommodations, conduct a comprehensive audit of paid and unpaid leaves of absence, identify compliance risks and process gaps, and establish sustainable governance for monitoring and implementing future regulatory changes.


The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of leave and accommodation requirements, strong project management skills, and experience developing compliant, employee-centered processes within a complex organizational environment.


Key Responsibilities

Accommodations Framework Development

  • Assess current accommodation practices, workflows, documentation, and decision-making processes.
  • Design and implement a comprehensive accommodations framework that supports consistent administration and compliance.
  • Develop standardized intake, interactive process, documentation, approval, tracking, and communication procedures.
  • Create templates, tools, and guidelines for HR, managers, and employees.
  • Establish roles, responsibilities, and escalation pathways for accommodation requests.
  • Recommend case management and recordkeeping best practices.

Leave of Absence Compliance Audit

  • Conduct a comprehensive review of all paid and unpaid leave programs and practices.
  • Evaluate leave administration processes for compliance with applicable federal, state, and local requirements.
  • Assess coordination between leave, disability, workers' compensation, accommodations, payroll, and benefits administration.
  • Identify compliance risks, operational inefficiencies, documentation gaps, and inconsistent practices.
  • Provide recommendations and an action plan to address findings.

Process Design & Governance

  • Develop standardized operating procedures for leave and accommodation administration.
  • Establish processes for reviewing legislative and regulatory changes affecting leave and accommodations.
  • Create a sustainable governance model for implementing policy and process updates.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with HR, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Employee Relations, and business leaders to gather requirements and validate recommendations.
  • Facilitate working sessions and process-mapping exercises.
  • Present findings, risks, recommendations, and project updates to leadership.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

  • Deliver comprehensive process documentation, workflows, and training materials.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and training to internal stakeholders to support long-term program ownership.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience administering or consulting on leave of absence and accommodation programs.
  • Strong knowledge of employee leave and workplace accommodation practices.
  • Experience conducting compliance reviews, audits, or process assessments.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and document HR processes and operational frameworks.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting multi-state employers and Puerto Rico.
  • Experience implementing or improving leave management programs.
  • HR certification (SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or equivalent).
  • Experience working with leave administration vendors and HRIS platforms.
  • Background in benefits, employee relations, compliance, or employment law.

Deliverables

By the end of the engagement, the consultant will provide:

Accommodations

  • Comprehensive accommodations framework and administration model.
  • Training and communication materials for HR and key stakeholders.

Leave Compliance

  • Audit report assessing paid and unpaid leave compliance and operational effectiveness.
  • Gap analysis with prioritized recommendations and risk assessment.
  • Standard operating procedures and workflow documentation.
  • Sustainable governance process for monitoring and implementing regulatory changes.
  • Training and communication materials for HR and key stakeholders.
