raw.description:
Avanade Account Technology Strategist (ATS)


Join us as an Account Technology Strategist (ATS) and help shape the future of digital transformation for some of our most strategic clients. In this role, you'll serve as a trusted technology advisor, partnering with senior customer executives to align business priorities with innovative technology strategies that accelerate growth, drive business outcomes, and unlock the full potential of the Microsoft ecosystem.


We're looking for a strategic thinker and relationship builder who combines business acumen with deep technology expertise. You'll collaborate closely with Microsoft Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Solution Specialists, and Avanade Business Development leaders to drive cloud adoption, AI innovation, and digital transformation across a portfolio of Small, Medium & Corporate (SMC) clients. You'll identify growth opportunities, develop executive-level technology roadmaps, and help customers realize measurable business value while strengthening long-term partnerships.


Come join us

At the intersection of business and technology, you'll help customers navigate complex transformation journeys and maximize the value of their Microsoft investments.

As a trusted advisor, you'll lead strategic conversations, influence executive stakeholders, and drive adoption of cloud, data, AI, security, and modern workplace solutions.

Working alongside Avanade and Microsoft teams, you'll develop innovative technology strategies that accelerate Azure consumption, support Microsoft solution adoption, and create opportunities for Avanade consulting services. Together we do what matters.


What you’ll do

Executive Technology Leadership

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business executives, and line-of-business leaders across a portfolio of 8–10 accounts.
  • Facilitate strategic discussions on business transformation, AI adoption, cloud modernization, cybersecurity, data platforms, and workplace productivity.
  • Develop executive-level technology visions and multi-year transformation roadmaps aligned to customer business objectives.
  • Lead technology conversations that position Microsoft as the preferred strategic partner.

Account Planning & Growth

  • Create and maintain comprehensive technology strategies for assigned accounts.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Microsoft cloud consumption and platform adoption.
  • Develop account technology plans that support revenue growth, customer retention, and long-term value realization.
  • Influence customer investments toward Azure, Microsoft 365, Security, Fabric, Data & AI, and Business Applications solutions.

Industry & Business Consulting

  • Understand industry trends, regulatory challenges, and competitive pressures across multiple sectors.
  • Translate industry-specific challenges into business and technology solutions.
  • Share leading practices, industry benchmarks, and AI-enabled innovation opportunities.

AI and Innovation Strategy

  • Lead executive conversations around generative AI, Copilot, intelligent agents, and emerging technologies.
  • Identify high-value AI use cases and establish adoption roadmaps.
  • Help customers define governance, security, and change management strategies for AI deployment.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists to accelerate AI solution adoption.

Technical Strategy Development

•Guide customers through:

oCloud migration and modernization initiatives

oData platform modernization

oSecurity transformation programs

oDigital workplace strategies

oApplication modernization

oHybrid and multi-cloud architectures

  • Align technical architectures to business outcomes and investment priorities.

Orchestration & Team Leadership

  • Act as the virtual CTO for the account team.
  • Coordinate Microsoft specialists, architects, customer success managers
  • Drive alignment across pursuit, solutioning, implementation, and adoption activities.
  • Ensure customer engagements are coordinated and outcome-focused.

Business Value Realization

  • Support the development of business value cases, ROI analyses, and executive presentations.
  • Establish measurable success criteria for transformation initiatives.
  • Track business outcomes and customer success metrics.
  • Demonstrate realized value from Microsoft technology investments.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Customer Success

  • Customer satisfaction and relationship health

•Executive engagement coverage

  • Technology strategy completion and quality

•Customer referenceability

Business Growth

•Azure consumption growth

•AI and Copilot adoption rates

•Avanade services engagement growth

Transformation Outcomes

  • Digital transformation initiatives launched

•Business value assessments completed

  • AI opportunities identified and implemented

•Strategic roadmap execution progress

Skills and experiences

Required Experience

  • 8+ years of technology consulting, enterprise architecture, account management, or technology strategy experience.
  • Experience engaging executive stakeholders and business decision makers.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships.
  • Experience driving cloud, data, AI, security, or application modernization initiatives.

Technical Knowledge

Strong understanding of at least three of the areas below, with a willingness to develop deeper knowledge across the remaining areas:

•Microsoft Azure

•Microsoft 365

•Security and Compliance solutions

  • Data & AI platforms (Fabric, Foundry, etc.)

•Business Applications (D365)

  • Cloud architecture and modernization strategies

•Generative AI and intelligent agents

Business Skills

  • Executive presence and communication skills

•Strategic thinking and business acumen

  • Account planning and opportunity development
  • Financial and business case development

•Stakeholder management and influence


.

Skills & Experience

Characteristics that can spell success for this role:

  • You are a trusted advisor who builds credibility and influences executive stakeholders.
  • You combine business acumen and technology expertise to deliver meaningful customer outcomes.
  • You excel at developing strong partnerships across customers, Microsoft, and Avanade teams.
  • You identify growth opportunities and translate business priorities into strategic technology solutions.
  • You take ownership, communicate with impact, and drive results through collaboration and innovation.

Enjoy your career

Some of the best things about working at Avanade:

  • Opportunity to work for Microsoft’s Global Alliance Partner of the Year (20 years in a row), with exceptional development and training (minimum 80 hours per year for training and paid certifications)
  • Real-time access to technical and skilled resources globally
  • Dedicated career advisor to encourage your growth
  • Engaged and helpful coworkers genuinely interested in you

A great place to work

As you bring your skills and abilities to Avanade, you’ll get distinctive experiences, limitless learning, and ambitious growth in return. As we continue to build our diverse and inclusive culture, we become even more innovative and creative, helping us better serve our clients and our communities. You’ll join a community of smart, supportive collaborators to lift, mentor, and guide you, but to also lean on your expertise. You get a company purpose-built for business-critical, leading-edge technology solutions, committed to improving the way humans work, interact, and live. It’s all here, so take a closer look!

We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.

Create a future for our people that focuses on

  • Expanding your thinking • Experimenting courageously • Learning and pivoting

Inspire greatness in our people by

  • Empowering every voice • Encouraging boldness • Celebrating progress

Accelerate the impact of our people by

  • Amazing the client • Prioritizing what matters • Acting as one

Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.

THE ROLE

Performance Improvement (PI) Practice within Nordic’s Strategic Advisory Services (SAS) is responsible for helping healthcare organizations address some of their most challenging strategic, clinical, and operational problems for clients across the healthcare ecosystem.

Members within our PI project teams wear multiple hats to deliver quality work, including building insightful data analyses, gathering requirements, mapping workflows, designing use cases, and researching the latest changes impacting the healthcare industry. As such, our Senior Consultants are expected to:

  • Think creatively and support the delivery of a wide range of strategic initiatives
  • Have strong communication and collaboration skills as they work closely with client end-users, technical developers, clinical providers, and senior leadership
  • Demonstrate qualitative and quantitative management consulting skills
  • Lead workstreams and facilitate client-facing meetings

With guidance and mentorship from project and practice leadership, the Senior Consultant role provides individuals with extensive opportunities to gain experience across clinical, financial, patient experience, and technical solutions sought after within the healthcare industry to improve wellness and care for all.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A Consultant within PI will be responsible for, but not be limited to:

  • Partner with PI team members to implement advisory solutions and demonstrate the value of the solution throughout the client engagement.
  • Collaborate with project leadership to develop and maintain project management artifacts including but not limited to workplans, status reports, decision and risk logs
  • Create complex analytical models to drive unique solutions to complex healthcare problems
  • Develop detailed financial analysis, statistical reports, visualizations, and presentations for both internal team and client review
  • Facilitate client interviews and meetings
  • Conduct detailed analyses to identify specific opportunities for improvement, as well as implementation recommendations
  • Consistently deliver work products that are high-quality and client-ready
  • Contribute to practice knowledge capital and tool development
  • Develop and update related work plans, issue logs, status reports, and related initiative trackers.
  • Review and validate conducted analyses and client deliverables before submission
  • Complete quality reviews on team member work products before delivery to client personnel, validating team member findings and observations, and corroborate team member process improvement and analytic activities
  • Mentor junior resources
  • Demonstrate and embody Nordic’s maxims

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education & Industry

  • Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference in data sciences, finance, business, healthcare administration or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in the healthcare industry (e.g., healthcare organization, consulting) preferably within hospital administration (e.g., finance, supply chain, HR, decision support, informatics) or revenue cycle (e.g., registration/patient access, HIM, coding, revenue integrity or billing/follow-up/denials management)

Professional Attributes

  • Strong communication skills (i.e., excellent listener, comfortable speaking to groups, able to drive client meetings)
  • Collaborative work style (e.g., able to work with business, technical and clinical resources)
  • Creativity and critical thinking in solving complex problems
  • Strong presentation development skills (e.g., translating data to information, identifying themes, storyboarding)
  • Ability to work independently as well as within a team environment
  • Ability to balance multiple assignments at the same time
  • Attention to detail and able to quickly pivot assignments based on changing priorities

Core Software Skills

  • Strong expertise using Microsoft Office products
  • Prefer experience working with EMR (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech) or ERP solutions (e.g., Oracle, Infor, Workday)
  • Demonstrated knowledge using some of the following tools:
    • GenAI Assistants (CoPilot)
    • Analytical (PowerBI, Tableau)
    • Programming languages (SQL, Python)

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • Travel up to 20% of the time.

Nordic is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply, including women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead EMS transformation, automation, client onboarding, and operational improvement projects within a growing managed services organization. This role will manage cross-functional initiatives, drive project execution, mitigate risks, and ensure successful delivery of business objectives. The ideal candidate brings strong project management expertise, stakeholder management skills, and a proven track record of delivering measurable business results.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Leadership

  • Lead multiple complex EMS projects and strategic initiatives from inception through implementation and post-launch stabilization.
  • Develop and manage integrated project plans including scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, and timelines.
  • Establish project governance frameworks, communication plans, escalation processes, and leadership reporting.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Operations, Technology, Automation, Finance, Banking, Compliance, Product, and Client Services.
  • Ensure project deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Create clear and visually engaging project roadmaps, dashboards, and executive presentations using tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, PowerPoint, and Excel.

EMS Transformation & Automation

  • Manage initiatives supporting the EMS automation and digital transformation roadmap.
  • Coordinate requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment, and stabilization activities.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to streamline workflows and identify automation opportunities.
  • Oversee automation projects related to:
    • Client onboarding
    • Account setup and maintenance
    • Master data validation
    • Invoice processing
    • Payment operations
    • Reporting and analytics
    • Exception management
  • Support Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), workflow automation, and AI-driven process improvement initiatives.

Client Onboarding & Implementations

  • Lead enterprise client implementations and expansion initiatives across the EMS portfolio.
  • Develop comprehensive implementation plans covering:
    • Requirements gathering
    • Data migration
    • System integration
    • Testing
    • Training
    • Operational readiness
    • Go-live activities
  • Coordinate internal and client-facing dependencies to ensure successful onboarding and timely revenue realization.
  • Conduct readiness assessments and lead stabilization efforts following deployment.

Operations Excellence

  • Drive projects impacting invoice management, data extraction, payment processing, quality assurance, reporting, and back-office operations.
  • Collaborate with operational leaders to align project plans with real-world business processes and service delivery requirements.
  • Support process documentation, SOP development, controls, training programs, and change management initiatives.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve scalability, efficiency, productivity, service quality, and profitability.

Banking & Payment Operations

  • Manage initiatives involving banking transitions, payment operations, financial integrations, and related process changes.
  • Coordinate activities among banking partners, compliance teams, technology organizations, finance groups, client stakeholders, and EMS operations.
  • Develop and execute transition plans including testing, cutover strategies, approvals, risk mitigation, and post-go-live support.
  • Ensure operational, financial, regulatory, and client risks are proactively identified and managed.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Maintain comprehensive risk, issue, action, decision, and dependency logs.
  • Proactively identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Escalate critical issues with clear business impact assessments and recommended solutions.
  • Manage dependencies across business teams, technology groups, vendors, and client organizations.
  • Monitor risks related to data quality, resource availability, development timelines, testing schedules, and subject matter expert engagement.

Executive Reporting & Governance

  • Prepare executive-level status reports and presentations highlighting:
    • Program health
    • Milestone progress
    • Key accomplishments
    • Risks and issues
    • Decisions required
    • Resource needs
  • Provide a consolidated portfolio view across multiple EMS programs and initiatives.
  • Facilitate governance meetings, steering committees, and leadership reviews.
  • Develop dashboards and performance reporting that support informed decision-making.
  • Ensure project documentation and approvals are maintained in a structured and auditable manner.

Stakeholder & Resource Management

  • Influence and coordinate cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
  • Partner with leadership to identify and resolve resource constraints.
  • Define clear ownership, responsibilities, and accountability across workstreams.
  • Build strong relationships with business leaders, technology teams, clients, vendors, and external partners.
  • Mentor project managers, analysts, and coordinators supporting EMS initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Project Management, Technology, Finance, Operations, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of progressive Program or Project Management experience.
  • Proven success leading large-scale, cross-functional business and technology initiatives.
  • Experience delivering transformation, automation, operations, managed services, financial services, or process improvement programs.
  • Strong expertise in project planning, milestone management, risk management, dependency tracking, and resource coordination.
  • Experience communicating effectively with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Advanced analytical, operational, financial, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to simplify complex technical and operational concepts into clear business communication.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Experience using Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar project management platforms.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, or related project management certification.
  • Experience within utility management, accounts payable, invoice processing, banking, payment operations, fintech, or managed services environments.
  • Experience managing enterprise client implementations and operational transformations.
  • Knowledge of automation technologies, workflow solutions, AI platforms, and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP).
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies.
  • Experience leading globally distributed and cross-functional teams.

If you're creative, passionate about kubernetes and GPUs, and love having fun, please apply today!

For two decades, we have pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With the invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass video games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis and scientific research. Today, we stand at the beginning of the next era, the AI computing era, ignited by a new computing model, GPU deep learning.

  • Implementing monitoring and health management capabilities that enable industry leading reliability, availability, and scalability of GPU assets. You will be harnessing multiple data streams, ranging from GPU hardware diagnostics to cluster and network telemetry.
  • Working with teams across NVIDIA to ensure production AI clusters run reliability and consistently with maximum performance. Evaluating system failures and improving services based on a well-defined incident management process.

What we need to see:

  • Direct experience in a software engineering role within a highly technical organization with demonstrable impact from your work. Software development experience with kubernetes APIs and frameworks not just operating a cluster.
  • Highly motivated with strong communication skills, you can work successfully with multi-functional teams, principles, and architects and coordinate effectively across organizational boundaries and geographies.
  • 8+ years in similar role and experience on large-scale production systems. Experience with common software engineering principles, tools and techniques.
  • You possess a BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a comparable Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Technical knowledge, including a systems programming language (Go, Python) and a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Technical competency in managing and automating large-scale distributed systems independent of cloud providers. Advanced hands-on experience and deep understanding of cluster management systems (Kubernetes, Slurm, Bright Cluster Manager)
  • Proven operational excellence in maintaining reliable and performant AI infrastructure.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you are creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

raw.description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Gig: How You’ll Make an Impact

Our Operations team is looking for a Logistics Contractor to support omnichannel distribution while a team member is out on leave—keeping inbound freight and forwarder relationships on track, and owning the transactions, landed cost, and inventory reconciliation that keep our books accurate across every location. The contractor will be working up to 40 hours per week. This is an initial 6-month contract engagement, with the option to extend based on business needs.

This is a coverage role with real ownership. You'll be the person our forwarders and 3PLs hear from when a shipment needs to move faster or a booking decision has to be made, and the person Sourcing, Inventory Planning, and Accounting come to for shipment status, transaction accuracy, and landed cost questions. We're not looking for someone to hold the seat warm. We need someone who can read a shipment exception, decide what to do, and close the loop with the transactions and reconciliations that keep inventory accurate across every channel. You'll report to the Director of Operations and work closely with Sourcing, Inventory Planning, Channel Management, Accounting, and our forwarder and 3PL partners.

This role is remote-friendly but must be based in the U.S. or Canada. Hatch is based in California, so we ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

What You'll Do

📆 Projects:

  • Own day-to-day international inbound freight execution across Flexport and Amazon Global Logistics (AGL): create and manage bookings, review rates and surcharges, track shipments from factory to destination, and resolve exceptions with carriers and forwarders
  • Manage Amazon inbound programs end to end: FBA shipment creation and labeling, AWD placement and replenishment, inventory removals, resolving inbound creation issues by creating cases with Amazon as needed, and FC routing changes—across US and our expanding EU and UK marketplaces
  • Serve as the single source of truth on shipment status. Publish recurring shipment updates to the supply chain team so planning, sourcing, and channel partners know what's landing when, without having to chase it
  • Coordinate customs clearance and trade compliance: HTS classification support, commercial documentation accuracy, customs broker coordination, and responses to CBP requests for information
  • Access US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) ACE portal to match customs check numbers to their related entry numbers
  • Partner with Sourcing and our contract manufacturers (Luxshare, Escatec, and others) on shipping documents, labeling requirements, cargo readiness, and payment or document-release blockers that hold up freight
  • EPR maintenance: Pull monthly/quarterly reports as needed, ensure invoices are paid, request updates on pending EPR numbers, and request contracts for new territories
  • Maintain and update landed cost on a shipment and individual product basis.
  • Create and reconcile transactions in Netsuite that accompany the physical movement of goods between supplier and warehouse.
  • Own month-end inventory reconciliation process across all physical locations.
  • Escalate 3PL and forwarder SLA misses, chase credits on performance-related chargebacks, and partner with Accounting on freight invoice and deduction disputes

🚀 Wishlist:

  • Build a lightweight weekly inbound health summary so leadership sees freight risk, cost trends, and Amazon inventory position without asking for it
  • Document the recurring plays—AGL vs. Flexport routing decisions, Amazon booking workarounds, EU customs routing, CBP response process—so this knowledge doesn't live in one person's head
  • Identify freight cost savings opportunities through carrier and mode comparison, and bring a recommendation rather than a spreadsheet
  • Support peak season readiness: BFCM inventory positioning, AWD storage promotion deadlines, and Chinese New Year factory shutdown planning
  • Improve the inbound exception loop so delays surface to planning and channel teams the same day, not the same week

✨ Human:

  • Proactive communicator: you post the update before someone asks for it, and you say what you're doing about a delay in the same breath as reporting it
  • Independent operator: you own your workstream, make routing and escalation calls without daily check-ins, and know which decisions genuinely need your manager
  • Calm in exceptions: customs holds, missed vessels, withheld bills of lading, and Amazon portal glitches are the job, not the emergency. You work the problem and keep everyone informed
  • Ramps fast: You're comfortable being useful in week two of a contract engagement, in someone else's systems, on someone else's partner relationships

What You'll Bring

Must have:

  • 5+ years in international logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain operations, ideally in consumer electronics or CPG. This is a coverage role with a short ramp, so we're looking for someone who has done this work before rather than someone growing into it
  • Hands-on experience running international ocean and air freight yourself: creating bookings, reading rate structures and GRIs, managing forwarders, and resolving shipment exceptions without waiting for someone to tell you what to do
  • Direct, personal experience with Amazon inbound programs—Seller Central, FBA shipment creation and labeling, AWD—including the operational quirks of Amazon's routing and receiving rules
  • Working knowledge of customs and trade compliance: HTS classification, commercial documentation, duties, and responding to CBP requests for information
  • ERP experience including transfer order management, receipt creation, and month-end transaction completeness audit.
  • Knowledge and experience in performing month-end inventory reconciliations.
  • Strong written communication. A real part of this role is clear, timely async updates that a cross-functional team can act on
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and something always pops up mid-day

Strong plus:

  • Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) and Amazon Warehousing and Distribution (AWD) experience specifically
  • NetSuite
  • Familiarity with CBP’s ACE portal
  • EU and UK import experience, including customs clearance routing
  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers in Asia on shipping documentation and cargo readiness
  • Freight cost analysis and carrier or mode comparison

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work
  • We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
  • Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
  • We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
  • We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility

About Hatch

Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.

Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences

  • Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
  • Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
  • Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package

We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?

We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.

  • Du führst Erstgespräche mit IT-Leitung, Head of Infrastructure und Geschäftsführung in der technischen Tiefe
  • Du begleitest Angebote und Verhandlungen bis zum Abschluss, inklusive Scoping mit dem Team, das das Projekt später umsetzt
  • Du arbeitest sauber im CRM und steuerst deine Zahlen selbst: Pipeline, Forecast, Abschlussquote
  • Du nutzt unseren Sales-Stack, um Zielkunden zu finden und anzusprechen: Von Sales Navigator über Waalaxy und Smartlead bis zu Signalen aus dem Markt. Wo KI dir Arbeit abnimmt, setzt du sie gekonnt ein
  • Du bringst Signale aus dem Markt zurück ins Unternehmen und prägst mit, wie wir unsere Leistungen positionieren
  • Du bist bei Kundenterminen, Messen und Branchenevents vor Ort präsent

was du mitbringst

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, zum Beispiel BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Vertriebsmanagement oder Marketing
  • 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung
  • Erfahrung im Umfeld Cloud, Hyperscaler, SaaS, IT-Dienstleistung oder Digitalagentur
  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen CRM-Systemen (zum Beispiel Pipedrive, HubSpot oder Salesforce): Du pflegst deine Daten, weil du selbst damit arbeitest, nicht weil jemand es verlangt
  • Eine KPI-getriebene Arbeitsweise: Du kennst deine Zahlen, planst deine Pipeline und sprichst offen über Zielerreichung
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1), weil du täglich mit deutschsprachigen Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen arbeitest
  • Bereitschaft, für Kundentermine innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen

Das freut uns zusätzlich:

  • Erfahrung mit modernen Sales-Tools für Recherche und Outreach, zum Beispiel LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Waalaxy, Smartlead, Signalist oder vergleichbare Lösungen
  • Fortgeschrittene KI-Kenntnisse: Du nutzt Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude nicht nur zum Textschreiben, sondern baust dir damit Recherche, Qualifizierung und Routine im Alltag schlanker
  • Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen Dienstleistungen oder Projektgeschäft statt reinem Lizenzvertrieb
  • Ein Grundverständnis von Cloud-Themen wie AWS, Azure, Kubernetes oder Containern. Alles Weitere bringen wir dir bei.
  • Erfahrung mit längeren Verkaufszyklen und mehreren Entscheider:innen auf Kundenseite
  • Englischkenntnisse

Und das ist uns menschlich wichtig:

  • Ein selbstbewusstes, charismatisches Auftreten: Du gehst auf Menschen zu, hältst auch im Gespräch mit Geschäftsführung souverän dagegen und bleibst dabei sympathisch
  • Du verkaufst wie ein Mensch, nicht wie ein Skript. Sales-Roboter gibt es genug, wir suchen jemanden, der zu unserem Team passt
  • Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln und Neues zu lernen (Unsere Branche dreht sich schnell!)
  • Offenheit für Trends in Cloud, DevOps und Sales: Du liest dich ein, probierst aus und bringst Ideen mit

du bist uns wichtig

  • Gestalte deine Entwicklungsumgebung individuell und nutze deine favorisierten Tools. Dein Arbeitsplatz, dein Setup.
  • 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands, optional Büro in Berlin oder Rostock
  • Bei uns arbeitest im eigenen Rhythmus und am eigenen Ort. Das Team Daily ist dein einziger Termin.
  • Wir hören nie auf zu lernen! Profitiere von 5.000 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr
  • Feiere mit uns Erfolge, denn auch regelmäßige Teamevents dürfen bei uns nicht fehlen!
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, Voll- oder Teilzeit, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Überstundenausgleich

so bewirbst du dich

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Hilfreich sind dein frühestmöglicher Starttermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung. Wenn du magst, nenn uns ein, zwei Zahlen aus deinem Vertriebsalltag (zum Beispiel Zielerreichung oder typische Deal-Größe), daran sehen wir am schnellsten, ob es passt.

Fragen vorab? Melde dich gern per Mail:

Krystsina Kunert,

raw.description:
Job Description

As a growing non-profit organization, we’re dedicated to improving our policies, procedures, and practices while maintaining a supportive, family-oriented work environment. We’re looking for a candidate who is:

  • Passionate, self-motivated and deadline driven bringing their unique skill set and ideas to the table.

  • Confident and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity.

  • Capable of handling multiple responsibilities with ease.

  • A solution focused impact player that can solve challenges individually and as a team.

Who should apply:

  • If you’re looking for an opportunity that fosters the growth and development of under-resourced youths in the Atlanta area, apply for this position!

  • A genuine interest in empowering and inspiring young people will be an asset in this role.

  • If you seek an organization that supports the growth and development of all team members, you should apply for this role at Passion for Life.

  • If you resonate with the organization's goal of helping students discover their passions and build fulfilling careers.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop high energy, fun interactive workshops, full semester career development class, and summer camp curriculum to create creative experiential learning.

  • Create instructional materials for facilitators and coaches. Materials include classes, student guides, training manuals, teaching guides, and videos.

  • Research and identify learning activities and technologies that can be incorporated in training programs.

  • Collaborate closely with the curriculum development team and the training delivery team.

  • Assist with needs analysis by collecting and organizing feedback on existing training programs and materials.

    Required Skills:

  • Creative and Innovative mindset.

  • Passion for creating unique learning experiences for youth

  • Must have: A background in learning/teaching, instructional design, or curriculum development.

  • The ability to adjust quickly to changing priorities and ambiguous situations is crucial in a fast-paced, non-profit environment.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to create guides and presentations.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Computer proficiency.

  • Nice to have: Skills using Google Suite (Docs, Slides and Sheets).

Qualifications

Experiences:

  • Development: 6 months experience designing and developing curriculum, teaching materials, or learning content.

  • Knowledge of Instructional Design Theories and Models: Familiarity with established instructional design principles (e.g., ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy) could enhance the quality of the learning experiences created.

    Education Requirement:

  • Nice to have: Bachelor’s degree or higher.

  • If pursuing a Bachelor’s degree (Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Curriculum Development, Education, Organizational Development or Business is required), you must be a Junior or Senior.

  • Knowledge of Instructional Design Principles (Adult learning and K-12) and familiarity with established instructional design methodologies (e.g., ADDIE, SAM, Bloom's Taxonomy) are required.

  • Time Commitment: 8-10 hours a week for a minimum of 3 months

  • Must attend mandatory weekly and monthly meetings (virtually)

Passion for Life (P4L), a 501c nonprofit

The mission of Passion for Life is to help high school students identify their passions and help them create a plan to turn them into rewarding careers.

We are a youth workforce development organization that serves youths who would otherwise go unnoticed: the under-resourced and at-risk youths who have limited to no access to the technology, financing, and professional networks that can empower them to pursue their dreams.

Passion for Life is committed to providing a secure and nurturing environment for underserved youths, where they can be seen, heard, and believed.

Through our innovative, experiential-based Finding Passion Workshops, Investigative Coaching, and Career Readiness Training programs, youths increase their self-confidence and self-efficacy, gain insight into their strengths and passions, and develop an actionable career plan that aligns with their core values and personal vision.

Founded in 2009, Passion for Life is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that serves 200+ youths annually.

raw.description:
Overview

JOB TITLE: Senior ServiceNow Developer

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: Department of Homeland Security (DHS), U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)

POSITION INFORMATION: Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting federal agency clients

LOCATION: Fully Remote (U.S.)

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

CLEARANCE: Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking a highly motivated, mission-focused Senior ServiceNow Developer to join our growing team supporting U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). This fully remote role works on enterprise ServiceNow implementations that enhance operational efficiency, improve service delivery, and support critical government missions. The Senior ServiceNow Developer plays a key role in designing, developing, configuring, and implementing ServiceNow applications and enhancements, collaborating closely with stakeholders, administrators, architects, and business teams to deliver scalable solutions while ensuring adherence to platform best practices and development standards.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Development & Configuration
    • Design, develop, configure, and implement ServiceNow applications, modules, and enhancements.
    • Develop and maintain custom ServiceNow functionality, workflows, and integrations.
    • Create and maintain Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Access Control Lists (ACLs), Workflow Activities, UI Policies, and Catalog Items and Catalog Workflows.
  • Platform Support & Delivery
    • Support multiple ServiceNow instances and domains for internal and external customers.
    • Support deployment and rollout activities for new applications and enhancements.
    • Troubleshoot platform issues and identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Collaboration & Agile Delivery
    • Work independently and collaboratively as a senior member of a technical delivery team.
    • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to iterative development efforts.
    • Collaborate with business, systems, and technology stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Compliance & Documentation
    • Ensure solutions align with security, governance, and federal compliance requirements.
    • Contribute to documentation, knowledge transfer, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
    • Support governance of the ServiceNow platform by applying development standards consistently across releases.
  • Technical Leadership
    • Provide technical guidance on ServiceNow design, architecture, development standards, and platform best practices.
    • Serve as a senior technical resource for the delivery team, sharing ServiceNow expertise and best practices.
    • Translate business requirements into clear technical designs and implemented solutions.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting federal government clients and programs.
  • Strong experience developing custom ServiceNow solutions using JavaScript and platform scripting capabilities.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical designs and implemented solutions.

PREFERRED:

  • Deep knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and core modules, including Service Catalog, Service Portal, Incident Management, Knowledge Management, and Reporting and Dashboards.
  • Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) processes.
  • Knowledge of ITIL best practices and service management frameworks.
  • Familiarity with PMP, PRINCE2, or related project management methodologies.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale ServiceNow environments.
  • Experience performing data analysis, data modeling, and working with large datasets.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) principles and enterprise application support.
  • Experience with platform performance monitoring, optimization, and governance.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS:

  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
  • Additional ServiceNow certifications are highly desirable.
  • ITIL Foundation Certification.

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to the nature of this government contract.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This is a fully remote position within the U.S. No relocation or office reporting is expected.

ITC Federal is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

raw.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.
Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Data Quality Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Data Quality Engineer will develop and implement automated data quality controls to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data used for analytics, reporting, and artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) applications.

This position will support the Summit Data Platform by validating data ingestion and transformation processes, monitoring data quality, and ensuring datasets meet Government-approved standards before publication and customer use.

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated data quality tests and validation processes for cloud-based data ingestion, transformation, and analytical workloads.
  • Perform data reconciliation and equivalence testing between source systems, legacy platforms, and Summit datasets to verify data accuracy and migration parity.
  • Implement data quality checks for completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness in accordance with Government-approved standards.
  • Develop and maintain automated monitoring, anomaly detection, and alerting capabilities to identify data quality issues and pipeline failures.
  • Validate compliance with established data freshness and reliability Service Level Agreements (SLAs), documenting test results, exceptions, and residual risks before dataset publication.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, data governance specialists, and data owners to implement approved quality rules, thresholds, and publication criteria.
  • Investigate data discrepancies, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate corrective actions to prevent recurring quality issues.
  • Maintain data quality rules, test cases, validation results, and supporting documentation in the Data Quality Rule Library and related repositories.
  • Develop and maintain data quality metrics, dashboards, and reports, including contributions to the Summit Data Quality and Ingestion Dashboard.
  • Support production monitoring and release readiness by validating corrective actions, retesting affected datasets, and confirming compliance with established quality standards.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Five or more years of professional experience in data quality engineering, data validation, data testing, or a related discipline.
  • Strong proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) for data profiling, reconciliation, validation, and analysis.
  • Experience developing automated data quality tests and validation scripts using Python or comparable programming languages.
  • Experience testing Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, and Transform (ELT) processes in enterprise data environments.
  • Experience validating data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across multiple source systems and data platforms.
  • Experience with data reconciliation, regression testing, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience documenting data quality rules, test results, defects, and corrective actions.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.
  • The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting VA or other federal agency data modernization initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services, Azure Databricks, or Delta Lake.
  • Experience implementing enterprise data quality frameworks or tools such as Great Expectations, Soda, or comparable technologies.
  • Knowledge of Data Management Association (DAMA) data quality principles and enterprise data governance practices.
  • Experience implementing data observability solutions and automated quality monitoring for large-scale data pipelines.
  • Experience working with sensitive healthcare data and federal privacy and security requirements.
  • Relevant certification in data management, data quality, cloud data engineering, or data analytics.

Benefits (including but not limited to):

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Optional FSA
  • Paid parental leave
  • Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
  • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
  • No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
  • Pet insurance
  • Monthly phone and internet stipend
  • Tuition and training reimbursement

raw.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

Join us in one of our most critical member care management roles, inspiring behavior change and motivating members to adopt new behaviors and improve their health. As an RN at Twin you make a difference in people's lives every day by providing clinical guidance, support, education, and encouragement to empower your members seeking to prevent and reverse chronic metabolic diseases and improve their overall health.

This job is a great fit for you if you have expertise with building rapport with members, are highly motivated, energetic, and focused on enhancing the quality of healthcare. You have demonstrated the ability to work collaboratively with an interdisciplinary care team in the adoption of new technologies to coordinate care, engage in shared decision making, and achieve successful clinical outcomes. You are comfortable leveraging data in observing trends and developing corrective action plans to facilitate the transformation of member lives.

The schedule for this position is:

  • Tuesday - Saturday 8-4 PST (9--5 MST, 10-6 CST, 11-7 EST)

Join Us

This is an exciting role for a Registered Nurse with a diverse healthcare systems background. Join us to use your finely-tuned skills in assessing physical and psychological-social needs. You will support a dynamic care team in identifying member goals, health priorities and learning opportunities. This will include utilizing motivational interviewing techniques and designing interventions with members to build engagement and improved health outcomes. Other skill set considerations include ability to work efficiently and with competing priorities, comfort with technology and data, as well as employing knowledge of care management principles.

This role will report to a nurse manager and work within a team pod structure. A successful candidate for this role will be curious, collaborative and adaptable to member journey and team needs. You will be excited to jump into a day that may look a bit different than the day before, while making improvements along the way and building upon your highly-valued skill set.

Responsibilities

  • Delivers remote clinical monitoring and member education via software, video conferencing, and the Twin Health electronic medical record
  • Promotes member self-care management by utilizing clinical judgment, data analysis and critical thinking skills
  • Evaluates member progress toward goal achievement, including identification and evaluation of barriers to meeting or maintaining plan of care and/or health status
  • Prioritizes and manages individual members along the Twin journey by monitoring health condition reversal trends, conducting lab reviews, supporting medication management
  • Collaborates closely with team colleagues including nurses, health coaches, providers, and operations teams to drive a seamless experience for members
  • Engages the nursing philosophy to capture a holistic picture of the member’s clinical status from Intake to ongoing care management
  • Gives appropriate health guidance by utilizing clinical knowledge, training and protocols
  • Leverages the nursing processes to triage member alerts and inquiries
  • Strictly adheres to Standard Operating Procedures for member management and escalations
  • Provides timely responses and feedback to colleagues regarding member care
  • Conducts detailed monitoring to support medication reconciliation and adherence
    • Collaborate with members and pharmacies to identify solutions to defray costs for members and reduce gaps in coverage
  • Organizes accurate records and maintains confidentiality according to federal law and Twin policies
  • Generates and analyzes reports as needed for management, identifying trends, anomalies and areas of concerns
  • Contributes to the development and improvement of clinical care that enhances cost effectiveness while ensuring quality care

Qualifications

  • Currently active and unencumbered RN license within the state in which patient care is occurring
  • Minimum 4 years of nursing experience in various healthcare systems such as hospitals, Federally Qualified Health Care centers, ambulatory care environments (primary care, internal medicine, family practice, surgical/multi-specialty), health payor systems (case management), etc.

  • Preferably skilled in motivational interviewing and driving behavior change

raw.description:
Product Manager — Virtualisation & Cloud Infrastructure

Location: Remote in Europe / EMEA

Department: Product Management

Employment type: Contractor friendly

Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We combine an optimized operating system with orchestration, management, automation, and protection to deliver mainframe-like efficiency, performance, reliability, versatility, and security—while reducing overall cost and complexity.

Our Virtuozzo Infrastructure System (V/IS) brings together compute, storage, and networking to support traditional applications, cloud-native workloads, and AI services. We help organisations modernise their infrastructure, make better use of their hardware, and bring new cloud- and GPU-powered services to market on their own infrastructure and under their own brand.

Our technology serves more than 100,000 companies in over 100 countries. With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue to contribute to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

The Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager for V/IS to help shape the future of the Virtuozzo product suite, including virtualisation, cloud management platforms, and infrastructure solutions for CSP, MSP, and SME markets.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong product judgement, technical depth, market awareness, and customer empathy. You will work closely with engineering, sales, marketing, support, and customer-facing teams to define what we build, why we build it, how we position it, and how it creates measurable value for customers.

This is not a pure backlog-management role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage deeply with technical customers, understand infrastructure markets, make clear prioritisation decisions, and turn product direction into execution.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Drive product strategy for the Virtuozzo product suite, including virtualisation, cloud management platforms, and infrastructure solutions for CSP, MSP, and SME markets.
  • Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with company business objectives, customer needs, market opportunities, and Virtuozzo’s broader platform direction.
  • Engage with key customers and stakeholders to gather insights, validate product hypotheses, and refine strategies to address market demands.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and support teams to ensure successful execution of product launches, feature iterations, and market positioning.
  • Lead market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive threats, ensuring Virtuozzo is positioned to capitalise on new technologies and shifts in the market.
  • Define and implement pricing models and value propositions that drive customer adoption and revenue growth while maintaining a competitive edge in the market.
  • Work on cross-product initiatives to create a seamless experience across the Virtuozzo ecosystem, including integrations with third-party tools and emerging technologies.
  • You will also help connect product strategy to real customer outcomes: faster cloud service launches, lower infrastructure cost, better operational efficiency, improved monetisation for service providers, and a simpler experience across the Virtuozzo platform.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience in cloud infrastructure, virtualisation, cloud management platforms, infrastructure software, hosting, telco cloud, MSP/CSP platforms, or adjacent technical domains.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure technologies such as virtualisation, KVM, OpenStack, Kubernetes, software-defined storage, networking, orchestration, automation, or cloud management platforms.
  • Experience building product strategy and roadmaps for technical B2B products used by infrastructure teams, service providers, managed service providers, enterprises, or SaaS companies.
  • Ability to work closely with engineering teams and engage in technical discussions with architects, developers, solution architects, support engineers, and customer operations teams.
  • Strong customer-discovery skills, with the ability to translate technical and commercial pain points into clear product priorities.
  • Experience with market analysis, competitor research, pricing, packaging, value propositions, and product positioning.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product narratives, roadmap updates, business cases, and launch materials.
  • A structured, analytical approach to prioritization, with comfort using customer input, market data, usage data, commercial impact, and technical feasibility to make product decisions.
  • Confidence working across distributed, international teams.

Nice to Have

  • CSP, MSP, hosting, telco, or cloud service provider environments.
  • VMware alternatives, OpenStack-based platforms, KVM-based virtualisation, Kubernetes orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
  • Product ownership for cloud control panels, cloud management platforms, portals, billing integrations, self-service platforms, or infrastructure operations tooling.
  • Pricing and packaging for infrastructure software, subscription models, usage-based models, or service-provider commercial models.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, GPU infrastructure, edge infrastructure, hybrid cloud, or multi-cloud management.

What We Offer

  • Remote work from Europe / EMEA.
  • Flexible working hours and a distributed international team.
  • High ownership and visibility within the Product organisation.
  • The opportunity to influence product and R&D direction from day one.
  • A technical, engineering-driven culture with practical decision-making and minimal bureaucracy.
  • Work on meaningful infrastructure products used by cloud providers, MSPs, SaaS companies, and enterprises.
  • Private medical insurance support, depending on location and employment setup.
  • Additional benefits depending on country, location, and preferred employment method.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Sendoso is where you go to build something bigger than yourself. We’re a venture-backed company with multiple revenue streams, more than 500 customers and 15,000 active users, and tens of millions of dollars of funding. Our company is on an unprecedented growth trajectory and we’re looking for people who want to do great things.

Ranked #1 on software review sites like G2, Sendoso helps companies stand out by giving them meaningful, new ways to engage with their buyers and customers. Our award-winning Sending Platform connects online and offline experiences via cloud software, automation, and real-world logistics, a feat that few companies have achieved.

With the acquisition of Merch, Sendoso now sources, decorates, and produces branded merchandise in-house, so customers get everything from custom swag to gifting, warehousing, and fulfillment under one roof.

And we believe that relationships matter, so we’re on a mission to create more human connections in a digital world. If you’re ready to seize tremendous opportunity, take ownership, and do meaningful work that moves the needle, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Manager, Merchandise Operations to oversee the day-to-day execution of our branded merchandise and promotional products offering.

In this role, you'll serve as a merchandise expert across internal teams and work directly with customers to develop creative, effective merchandise solutions. You'll manage our merchandise Customer Success team, oversee projects from sourcing through delivery, and coordinate with suppliers and fulfillment partners to ensure exceptional execution.

The ideal candidate brings strong promotional products industry experience, excellent project management skills, and a proactive, hands-on approach to solving problems and improving processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Merchandise Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert on promotional products, branded merchandise, product sourcing, decoration methods, and industry trends. Recommend creative products and strategies tailored to customer objectives, budgets, and timelines.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Campaign Studio, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop merchandise solutions for campaigns, events, gifting initiatives, and other branded experiences.
  • Customer Engagement: Participate in customer discussions to provide product recommendations, sourcing guidance, and expertise on merchandise programs and execution.
  • Project Management: Oversee merchandise projects from initial concept and sourcing through quoting, sampling, production, fulfillment, and final delivery. Ensure timelines, quality standards, and customer expectations are met.
  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop the merchandise Customer Success team, providing operational guidance, training, workload prioritization, and oversight of order execution.
  • Supplier Management: Build and maintain relationships with domestic and international suppliers, negotiate pricing where appropriate, and coordinate production requirements.
  • Creative Sourcing: Develop curated product recommendations, digital look books, merchandise presentations, and coordinate samples and mockups.
  • Logistics & Fulfillment: Coordinate domestic and international shipping, warehousing, kitting, and distribution, including complex multi-location projects.
  • Operational Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve execution, resolve challenges proactively, and support the continued growth of merchandise operations.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in promotional products, branded merchandise, corporate gifting, or a related industry.
  • Strong knowledge of promotional products sourcing, supplier networks, decoration techniques, and production processes.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple merchandise projects from concept through delivery. • Experience coordinating with vendors, fulfillment partners, and internal stakeholders. • Familiarity with domestic and international shipping and logistics.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to provide leadership, direction, and training to team members. Previous people-management experience is preferred but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Experience with industry sourcing platforms such as SAGE or ESP is a plus.

What You’ll Love:

  • Comprehensive Medical Plans plans - we’ve got you covered!
  • Take-What-You-Need Time Off
  • LSA (Lifestyle Spending Account) with Compt
  • 401K Plan
  • FSA Plan
  • Free General Medical & Mental Health care via Healthjoy
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Birthday Time Off
  • Generous parental leave benefits for both birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Access to Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs)
  • Financial wellness benefits through Morgan Stanley
  • Remote work environment

What We Believe:

  • One Team - Everyone belongs here, and whether it’s your first day or you’re the CEO, your voice and ideas matter to us. By embracing the “One Team* core value, we can harness the power of collaboration to drive innovation, overcome challenges, and achieve outstanding results.
  • Fuel Potential - Providing individuals with the necessary tools, resources, and support to enable their success and uplift their potential. We empower our team and lift them to higher levels of achievement, both personal and professional.
  • Real Connections - It’s a cluttered, digital world out there, but our connections are real. Personal connections matter, and we want to build real connections with our peers and customers.
  • Unboxed Thinking - We encourage our team to think creatively and approach challenges from fresh perspectives. We believe that by encouraging and supporting diverse ideas, we can uncover innovative/groundbreaking solutions and deliver an exceptional product and experience.
  • Customer Centric - We understand that our success depends on our customers’ success, and we are dedicated to giving every customer that wow moment at every touchpoint. At the end of the day, our customers’ satisfaction and happiness are our ultimate measures of success.

Compensation & Equal Opportunity

The anticipated U.S. base salary range for this position is $70,000–$90,000 annually, depending on experience, qualifications, and location.

Sendoso is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

By submitting your application, you agree that Sendoso may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes.

raw.title: Account Executive, Install Base
raw.excerpt: The Account Executive, Install is part of Cleo’s first-class Sales Team and is responsible for growing revenue within Cleo’s existing customer base.
raw.description:
The Account Executive, Install is part of Cleo’s first-class Sales Team and is responsible for growing revenue within Cleo’s existing customer base. You will become a product knowledge expert across the Cleo Integration Cloud and focus on expanding the value customers get from Cleo by identifying new use cases, adding trading partners, volumes, and modules, and renewing and growing recurring revenue across a book of installed customers.

You will use modern AI tools as part of your everyday workflow to find whitespace in your accounts, spot expansion and renewal signals, personalize outreach at scale, and keep your pipeline accurate. Our goal is to help you take the next step in your sales career and give you the tools to do it successfully. We are looking for candidates who are eager to drive their business and set goals that align with company growth. Cleo is a growing ecosystem and we want the best and brightest on our team.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Manage and grow a book of installed customers, serving as the commercial point of contact for expansion and renewal opportunities
  • Identify and close upsell, cross-sell, and add-on opportunities, such as new modules, additional trading partners, increased volumes, and new business units or use cases
  • Execute a successful sales process from opportunity identification to appointment to close, with a high level of activity across a large number of accounts
  • Own the renewal cycle for assigned accounts, forecasting renewals early, addressing risk, and negotiating terms that protect and grow recurring revenue
  • Analyze customer usage, contract, and product-footprint data to identify whitespace and prioritize accounts with the highest expansion potential
  • Partner with Account Managers, Customer Success, Support, and Professional Services to drive adoption, resolve issues, and make sure customers realize value from Cleo
  • Work with SDRs and Solution Consultants to build programs that meet each client’s needs and budget
  • Educate and advise clients on industry trends, EDI and B2B integration best practices, and the value of Cleo’s ecosystem to build strong, trustworthy relationships
  • Obtain feedback from clients and adjust messaging to improve downstream execution; share customer insights with Product and Marketing
  • Negotiate with clients, solve problems, and make sure deadlines are met
  • Check and report on customers’ Cleo program progress and value realized
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, account, and forecast data in the CRM and deliver reliable renewal and expansion forecasts

AI Fluency Competencies

At Cleo, AI is part of how our sales team works. In this role you are expected to use AI responsibly and effectively to improve the quality and speed of your work, while keeping your judgment and customer relationships at the center. Fluency in this role means:

  • Whitespace and account analysis. Use AI to analyze usage, contract, and footprint data across your installed base and surface the accounts and use cases with the greatest expansion potential.
  • Signal-driven prioritization. Interpret AI-driven intent, usage, and customer-health signals to decide where to focus expansion, renewal, and risk-mitigation efforts
  • Personalization at scale. Use AI to tailor outreach, proposals, and renewal communications to each customer’s industry, trading partner network, and priorities, then edit them so they sound authentic and are correct.
  • Prompting and iteration. Write clear prompts, give AI useful context, and refine outputs until they are accurate, specific, and ready to use.
  • Conversation intelligence. Use AI-generated call summaries, themes, and action items to capture next steps, improve your own approach, and share insights with Account Management and Customer Success.
  • Forecasting and CRM hygiene. Use AI assistance to keep records current, flag at-risk renewals and stalled deals, and pressure-test your forecast.
  • Sound judgment and verification. Verify AI output before sharing it with a customer, know where AI helps and where human insight is needed, and keep your own judgment in every customer interaction.
  • Responsible use. Follow Cleo’s AI, data security, and confidentiality policies. Never enter customer confidential or sensitive data into unapproved tools.
  • Continuous learning. Stay curious about new AI capabilities, share what works with your peers, and help the team raise its collective AI skills.

Prerequisites

  • Have received a Bachelor’s degree
  • 3-5 years prior experience in an Account Executive, Account Management, SDR/BDR, or Inside sales role, preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Experience managing renewals and driving expansion within an existing customer base is a plus
  • Communicate confidently in person, over the phone, and online
  • Comfortable using AI tools to research, plan, and communicate, with sound judgment about when and how to use them
  • Strong organization and time management across a large portfolio of accounts
  • Focus on the positive and strive for continual improvement
  • Be ambitious and motivated to achieve results
  • Collaborate and operate well in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Be effective at building strong, long-term relationships
  • Adhere to a strong work ethic and sense of commitment
  • Enjoy learning about supply chain, B2B integration, and the IT industry
  • Ability to travel 30%

A few things we offer

  • Compensation Range: $80,000 - $100,000 annual base salary + Commission Potential
  • Great Healthcare + Dental + Vision
  • Flexible PTO
  • Culture of support, encouraging Life-Work balance
  • 401k match
  • FSA and HSA options
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Remote work environment
  • Accelerated title and salary growth potential
  • A fun and energetic work environment that makes you excited to go to work every day

These tools are designed to support fair and consistent evaluations. If you have questions about this process or would like to request an alternative assessment method, please contact us at .
