raw.excerpt: About ToptalToptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand.
raw.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As a Client Partner at Toptal, you will be responsible for growing and deepening relationships with our enterprise clients by understanding their business challenges, identifying new opportunities, and bringing together the right solutions to help them succeed. You will own the commercial growth, strategic development, and long-term health of an assigned portfolio of clients, turning established relationships into broader, more valuable partnerships.

This is a highly consultative, commercially driven role for professionals who are as curious about solving business problems as they are motivated to grow revenue. You will immerse yourself in your clients’ businesses, understand the pressures and opportunities shaping their industries, and proactively identify where Toptal can make a meaningful difference. Rather than waiting for clients to tell you what they need, you will bring ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and work with our experts to shape solutions that address both immediate priorities and longer-term strategic objectives.

We are looking for individuals who combine the commercial drive of a business developer, the problem-solving mindset of a consultant, and the relationship skills of a trusted advisor. You should be energized by uncovering opportunities within complex organizations, expanding into new business units, building executive relationships, and converting ideas into meaningful commercial engagements. At Toptal, we believe our potential is defined by the problems we can solve and the outcomes we can deliver for our clients. With capabilities spanning technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent, we have the opportunity to take on increasingly complex and meaningful business challenges. Realizing that potential requires people who think beyond the immediate ask, challenge conventional approaches, and bring the initiative and judgment to turn ideas into results.

We have high expectations of ourselves and the people we work alongside. We value individuals who combine intellectual curiosity with commercial ambition, move with urgency, and take personal ownership of outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape client strategies, challenge assumptions, and bring forward new ideas, but you will also be expected to execute with discipline, collaborate effectively, and deliver measurable results. We are building a business that can compete at the highest levels, and we expect our Client Partners to help lead that ambition.

Your focus is on growing and retaining existing enterprise clients. Enterprise Sales Executives acquire new clients and secure the initial commercial engagement. From that point forward, you will own the ongoing commercial relationship, including identifying and closing expansion opportunities, renewals, extensions, and additional agreements. You will also be accountable for client satisfaction, retention, and the continued growth and diversification of your portfolio.

You will be expected to grow and manage a substantial portfolio, with an annualized gross revenue expectation of $10M+ as your portfolio matures. Success will be measured by sustained revenue growth, retention, client satisfaction, account diversification, and your ability to establish Toptal as a valued partner across increasingly important areas of your clients’ businesses. Toptal’s Consumer Products and Services (CP&S) portfolio serves leading consumer brands and retailers across three segments: Consumer Packaged Goods, Retail and eCommerce, and Hospitality and Consumer Services. Retail and eCommerce is one of our priority growth segments, spanning eCommerce, Traditional Retail, Mass Merchandisers, Grocery and Convenience, and Food Service. Our clients face margin pressure, shifting consumer behavior and the need to turn AI into measurable results. Toptal helps them move faster by combining Professional and Managed Services, backed by top talent and AI-first capabilities.

This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement. You will be expected to spend meaningful time in the field, building executive relationships, uncovering opportunities, and advancing commercial growth. Travel is an integral part of this role, not an occasional requirement. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will own the commercial strategy and growth of assigned enterprise client relationships, serving as a strategic partner who understands each client’s business, identifies emerging needs, and proactively develops opportunities to deliver greater value. You will work across client organizations to uncover challenges, shape solutions, and expand Toptal’s role in helping clients achieve their objectives.

This is not a passive account management role. You will be expected to continuously create demand within your accounts, build new relationships, and bring forward ideas that lead to new commercial opportunities. You will have strong partners across Toptal, but you will be personally accountable for driving growth and advancing the commercial relationship.

Understand your clients’ businesses. Develop a deep understanding of client strategies, operating models, industry dynamics, competitive pressures, and emerging priorities. Ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and identify business problems and opportunities where Toptal can deliver meaningful value.

Proactively shape solutions. Bring thoughtful ideas and recommendations to clients, working with Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams to develop differentiated, commercially viable solutions that address their challenges and create measurable business outcomes.

Own portfolio growth and commercial performance. Take direct accountability for revenue growth, retention, expansion, diversification, and the overall commercial health of your assigned client portfolio. Set ambitious growth objectives and execute with the discipline and urgency required to achieve them.

Hunt for opportunities within existing clients. Identify unmet needs, new initiatives, and emerging challenges across business units and functions. Create demand, develop opportunities, and convert those opportunities into new engagements and revenue rather than relying on existing business to sustain performance.

Expand and diversify client relationships. Build relationships across business units, geographies, functions, and executive stakeholders, reducing dependence on individual buyers, engagements, or service offerings.

Lead ongoing commercial engagements. Own renewals, extensions, ancillary agreements, and all subsequent commercial opportunities following the initial new-client signing, including opportunity development, solution positioning, pricing, negotiation, contracting, and close. Build trusted executive partnerships. Establish credibility with senior business and technology leaders through informed perspectives, sound judgment, and a genuine understanding of their priorities. Become a partner clients turn to when navigating important business decisions.

Develop and execute strategic account plans. Build actionable growth strategies informed by client priorities, competitive positioning, whitespace opportunities, buying centers, and long-term revenue potential. Translate those strategies into specific actions, measurable objectives, and commercial results.

Connect client challenges to Toptal’s capabilities. Identify opportunities to bring together technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent in ways that address client needs and broaden the value of our relationships.

Own commercial client health and retention. Maintain a clear understanding of client satisfaction, relationship strength, delivery performance, and emerging risks. Partner proactively with Client Management and Delivery teams to address concerns, protect revenue, and strengthen long-term relationships. Take ownership of the commercial relationship without assuming responsibility for day-to-day delivery execution.

Collaborate across client teams. Work closely with other Client Partners, Industry GMs, Sales Leaders, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Client Management, and Delivery teams to share insights, coordinate account strategies, and develop solutions across complex client organizations. Where multiple Client Partners support an account, operate within clearly defined commercial ownership and a coordinated account strategy.

Lead complex expansion pursuits. Bring together the right expertise to develop compelling proposals, navigate enterprise buying processes, negotiate commercial terms, and close new business within existing accounts.

Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence. Own expansion pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, account planning, and visibility into commercial opportunities and risks. Make informed decisions, maintain momentum, and take accountability for the quality of your execution. Set a high standard for performance and execution. Operate with urgency, preparation, and personal accountability. Bring thoughtful perspectives to client conversations, follow through on commitments, and continuously look for ways to improve client outcomes and commercial performance. Take ownership of challenges, work across teams to solve them, and hold yourself accountable for delivering measurable results.

Represent the voice of the client. Bring client feedback, emerging needs, and market insights into Toptal to help inform our solutions, capabilities, and overall client experience.

We are looking for Client Partners who are genuinely interested in how businesses work, why challenges exist, and how they can be solved. The strongest performers will consistently turn that curiosity into new ideas, stronger relationships, and meaningful commercial growth.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal and develop a strong understanding of our business model, value proposition, capabilities, and expectations for performance.
  • Familiarize yourself with our commercial operating model, account ownership principles, and client engagement processes.
  • Meet the Industry, Practice, Pursuits, Client Management, and Delivery leaders who will support your success.
  • Understand our approach to account planning, opportunity management, forecasting, and commercial execution.
  • Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and renewal processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop a strong understanding of your assigned client portfolio, including business priorities, active engagements, executive relationships, current revenue, and growth potential.
  • Begin engaging client stakeholders to understand their strategic objectives, operating challenges, and emerging priorities.
  • Work with your Industry GM or Sales Leader to develop account strategies and identify priority opportunities for growth.
  • Assess account health, renewal exposure, concentration risks, and opportunities to expand into new business units or service offerings.

raw.excerpt: About the Company In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow.
raw.description:
About the Company

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held. Investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

This in-house project development attorney will be a key player in shaping and executing the procurement and contracting strategy for our Mingomba mine build and other projects around the world. Their work will directly support a global AI-driven clean-tech company in its mission to invent breakthrough technology, discover billions of dollars of minerals, and stop climate change.

Responsibilities

The Senior Project Development Counsel will:

  • Be an integral part of an in-house legal team in a technology, mineral exploration and mine development company growing rapidly around the world
  • Provide leverage and support to the CLO and DGC so that they are more effective at advancing the company’s priorities
  • Build important parts of the Company’s legal function with a particular responsibility overseeing the legal work for the development and construction of major capital projects for the Company and owning the full range of global supply chain matters related to such projects
  • Lead the drafting and negotiation of the entire suite of contracts for the Company’s Mingomba project in Zambia and other capital projects, from EPC/EPCM and major equipment supply to offtake, O&M, and the surrounding infrastructure agreements (power, water, rail, and port), using FIDIC-based and bespoke forms, developing owner-protective positions, and managing English-law and LCIA/ICC provisions.
  • Negotiate with counterparties around the world, including global equipment suppliers and contractors, and state-owned utilities, railways, and ports
  • Work with engineering, HSE, project management, community engagement and supply chain stakeholders to bring technical annexures, scope, specifications, site information, and project requirements into the contract documents so that the legal terms match the technical deliverables
  • Work with the Company’s project finance team and lenders’ counsel on the bankability of EPC and procurement terms, including direct agreements and lender step-in rights
  • Keep a pulse on the rapidly-changing context for the Company’s business and engage constantly with people throughout the Company to be able to make good business judgments that enable the Company to accomplish its business objectives
  • Have many opportunities to be involved in other areas as the Company and its legal functions grow, including project finance, import-export, broader compliance, and corporate matters
  • Work on whatever needs to be done

Qualifications

  • 15-20+ years post-qualification, with substantial recent owner-side experience on large capital projects (mining, oil and gas, LNG, power, or heavy infrastructure)
  • Law degree and active admission to practice in England; admission to practice in a U.S. state or another common-law jurisdiction may be considered
  • Strong desire and ability to provide leverage, support, and partnership to the CLO and DGC
  • Strong drafting and negotiation experience across most of the following: EPC / EPCM / lump-sum turnkey (FIDIC Silver/Yellow and bespoke forms), major equipment procurement and supply, O&M agreements, offtake agreements, and infrastructure agreements (PPAs, water supply, rail and port access, concessions)
  • Experience working with international counterparties and operations (and agreements in global jurisdictions), including state-owned enterprises
  • Interest in working in a company that requires high levels of collaboration and communication among teammates working remotely across many time zones and continents (including ET, London, Perth, and Zambia)
  • Strong ability to learn new tools and an optimistic attitude toward work, people, and solving difficult problems of first instance
  • Interest in working in a science-based company where most colleagues are scientists and science is the focus of many company meetings and documents
  • A high degree of independence and ability to drive processes forward with little supervision
  • Ability and desire to travel periodically, including to Zambia and elsewhere as the Mingomba project and other projects require

It is helpful but not required to have:

  • Experience in mining or mineral exploration or adjacent energy sector like oil and gas
  • Prior work in Zambia, DRC, or the wider Copperbelt; familiarity with the Lobito Atlantic Railway or Dar es Salaam/Walvis Bay logistics corridors
  • Project finance lender-side interface experience (direct agreements, lender step-in, bankability of EPC terms)
  • Mandarin language skills
  • French language skills

This position is full-time.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $250,000-$290,000, plus equity and benefits.

Location: Fully remote. London strongly preferred; U.S. East Coast also possible. Must be authorized to work in the jurisdiction of residence. The manager for this role is located in the U.S. (East Coast).

Travel: Travel to Zambia as the project requires, and interest in engaging with suppliers globally.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

raw.description:
Localpayment is a fintech company specializing in local and cross-border payment solutions for emerging markets. Our platform enables global companies to accept payments in local currencies through native methods in each country, facilitating their international expansion.
In 2024, Localpayment entered into a strategic partnership with Aleph Group, a global technology and digital media company. This collaboration enhances our capabilities and reach, combining robust payment infrastructure with a broader digital ecosystem.
We are looking for a Treasury Corporate Lead to own Localpayment's corporate treasury: corporate accounts, treasury policies, corporate cash and investments, and the relationship with existing banks and providers, acting as backup for the Head of Treasury on corporate matters.
Reports to: Head of Treasury. Location: Remote. Scope: Global (parent company and local entities).
How do we work?
You’ll join a collaborative team that values autonomy, initiative, and quality to build robust and scalable solutions that power global payments.

Responsibilities

• Manage corporate accounts and the administrative account matrix for the parent company and local entities.
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with existing banks and providers: account openings, KYC/due diligence, fees and limits.
  • Design and maintain Treasury policies: investments, FX risk, counterparties, signatories and approval workflows.
  • Manage corporate cash and investments: daily position, liquidity forecasting and placement of excess cash.
  • Execute corporate FX and investment transactions with bank dealing desks and OTC providers.
  • Prepare presentations and reports for leadership (C-level and Board): cash position, exposure, banks and projects.
  • Ensure controls, documentation and audit-ready evidence across corporate treasury processes.
  • Drive AI-based automation of corporate treasury processes, including cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, reconciliations, reporting and bank communications.
  • Lead AI adoption in the Treasury Corporate team: set standards for prompts, agents and automations, and ensure critical judgment of AI outputs and data risks.

Requirements

• Experience: 5+ years in treasury at a PSP, cross-border payments fintech, acquirer, remittance company, BaaS provider or bank (cash management, corporate banking or FX desk).
  • Banking relationships: proven track record opening accounts and negotiating with banks and providers across several Latin American countries.
  • Policies & control: drafting treasury policies; knowledge of approval workflows, SWIFT and online banking.
  • Languages: Spanish and advanced English.
  • Python and SQL to automate cash positions, reconciliations, quotes and reporting.
  • AI proficiency: daily hands-on use of generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or similar) to automate and analyze corporate treasury work such as cash positioning, FX and liquidity forecasting, reconciliations, reporting and bank communications; building prompts, agents or automations; and critical judgment of AI outputs and data risks, using company-approved tools.
  • Advanced Excel (models, pivot tables, Power Query) and hands-on use of online banking platforms and banking APIs.
  • Stablecoins (USDT/USDC): working with OTC providers and exchanges, fiat/crypto conversion and on-chain liquidity management.
  • Nice to have: Multi-entity structures in Latin America and local FX regulations.
  • Nice to have: Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or Engineering; CFA/FRM or postgraduate studies in finance.
The hiring process will assess practical, hands-on use of AI tools applied to treasury work.

Benefits

• Be part of a high-impact company growing across global markets.
  • Work on meaningful challenges in the fintech space.
  • Join a fast-paced, remote-first environment backed by Aleph Group.
  • Competitive compensation and opportunities for growth.

raw.description:
We Are

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

You Are:
As a Delivery Lead – Financial Services (FS), you are responsible for leading delivery of projects and programs of work on a large, complex accounts operating in a multi-geography delivery model.

The Work:

People Management: You lead a team/ group of product experts that solve complex customer technical issues by practicing leadership principles, driving accountability and attracting/ retaining great people.

Response and Resolution: You manage the customer relationship with regards to Technical Support and acting as an escalation point for Support Engineers to remove roadblocks and help prioritize technical issues at a global level.

Readiness: You ensure your team has the technical skills required to provide a great customer experience and you collaborate with engineering /product teams to fill document gaps regarding new and existing technology.

Product/Process Improvement: You communicate aggregated customer feedback and set operational frameworks and standards to drive product and process improvements.

Business Integration: You identify opportunities to collaborate effectively across other teams and organizations to enable a great customer experience.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s What You Need:

  • Minimum of 8 years operational excellence, delivery management, account management, sales, or vendor management experience
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience supporting/working with FS Industry and clients
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 12/25/2026.

Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off.

raw.description:
The Junior Accountant supports the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the company, helping ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded, reconciliations are completed, and financial records are maintained in a timely manner.

This role is responsible for a wide range of accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, payroll, general accounting and month-end activities. The successful candidate is organized, detail-oriented, curious and eager to develop their accounting knowledge while contributing to an efficient and well-functioning finance team.

This is a full-time remote position, and candidates must be already located in Canada with legal working eligibility. Preference will be given to those based in the Greater Vancouver or Vancouver Island regions.

What You'll Do

  • Accounts payable management - including processing bills, weekly payment runs, communication with vendors
  • Accounts receivable management - including invoicing customers, monitoring collections, and communication with customers and internal account managers
  • Cash management - including daily updates and management
  • Processing expense reports, following up on reports awaiting approvals, credit card transactions, and reconciliations
  • Maintaining and reconciling working papers and schedules
  • Preparing journal entries, including import files
  • Internal monthly reporting duties
  • Preparing and filing regulatory filings such as GST, PST, and WCB
  • Preparing and processing payroll
  • Preparation of year-end working papers and support audit requests
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to improve accounting processes and efficiencies
  • Provide support on adhoc projects

What You Bring

  • A driver and a self­-starter who is able to work independently with a great attention to detail.
  • Strong ownership of work, and follow-through
  • Genuinely cares about making a difference and impact on the team
  • 2+ years of experience in an industry position working in a similar role and capacity
  • A quick learner that is keen to expand their role
  • Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Finance/Accounting or related discipline preferred
  • Previous experience with accounting software required, experience with Xero and Expensify would be an asset
  • Canadian payroll experience would be great
  • Working knowledge of full cycle accounting
  • Strong Google Sheets skills required for this role (including lookups, pivot tables, etc.)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Willingness to learn, improve and adapt as the company will continuously re­-evaluate and add new processes to support its rapid growth
  • Strong team player with a desire to be part of a collaborative team environment
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Good communication and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

About the Role

We are hiring the “best of the best” sales professionals who are passionate about their craft and want to continue to excel within our elite sales organization. Our Business Development Representatives will be the “tip of the spear” in the sales process within an assigned territory of business for prospective accounts. The ideal SDR candidate should have the perfect mix of experience, sales intuition, career ambition, team oriented mindset, quota driven mentality, empathetic / humble, positive, confident and can handle rejection.

The candidate will need to have good organization and written / verbal communication skills, Needs to be comfortable with making phone calls and professional to have high level conversations with C level stakeholders in medium to large organizations.

The candidate needs to be able to adapt to a fast paced environment, be familiar with our tools, our processes and be able to ramp up quickly.

What you will do

  • Contact potential clients through outbound cold calls and emails
  • Identify client needs and suggest appropriate products/services
  • Proactively seek new business opportunities in the market
  • Qualify leads from marketing campaigns as sales opportunities
  • Exercise leadership, demonstrate effective sales planning, and work in a positive and motivating way with internal counterparts and external customers.
  • Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly and yearly targets
  • Effectively partner and work across sales teams
  • Act as the subject matter expert on Abnormal AI product offering.

Must Haves

  • 6 months - 1 plus years proven work experience as a Business Development Rep
  • Fluency in German
  • Representative, Sales Account Executive or similar role (less experience is ok for the right candidate)
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed sales team
  • Capability of understanding customer pain points, requirements and correlating potential business to value
  • Strong, professional communication skills -- written, verbal, presentation
  • Aptitude to manage numerous requests and time demands concurrently, while achieving production goals from assigned territory or set of accounts
  • Hands-on experience with multiple sales techniques (including cold calls)
  • We actively encourage our SDRs to embrace and utilise AI to its fullest potential, whether to create sharper personalisation or stronger relevance in prospect outreach. We'd love to hear how you currently leverage AI tools in your prospecting and day-to-day workflow
  • Drive, Grit, Team Oriented: strong desire to compete and win
  • BA/BS degree or relevant experience

Nice to Have

  • Outreach
  • Salesforce
  • Orum
  • Lusha
  • ActivelyAI
  • Glean
  • Claude

A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary:

Sponsorships and charitable donations are strategic investments in the communities Mercer Advisors serves. Done well, they build local brand awareness, create goodwill, and open doors to new client relationships through organizations deeply rooted in each market. The Event Operations Manager (Sponsorships) is a key contributor to the operational success of these investments, working alongside the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition and broader sponsorship team to ensure opportunities are thoughtfully evaluated, consistently executed, and measured against defined business objectives.

This role plays a key role in supporting the sponsorship and charitable giving process from intake and evaluation through negotiation, formal approval, payment, activation, and measurement, while also supporting the operations of key event programs and third-party partnerships.

Working closely with the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition and broader sponsorship team, this role will partner with market leaders, advisors, Marketing, Vendor Management, Compliance, Finance, and Accounts Payable to help ensure sponsorships are thoughtfully evaluated, properly approved, consistently executed, and tied to measurable business outcomes.

This is an individual contributor role that blends hands-on operational support, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic judgment. The Event Operations Manager (Sponsorships) will be responsible for:

Sponsorship & Charitable Giving Operations:

  • Intake & evaluation
  • Partner with the sponsorship team to support the intake and coordination of sponsorship and charitable giving requests, helping ensure requests move through the appropriate process and stakeholders remain informed along the way.
  • Participate in the internal review of opportunities against the firm’s criteria, including employee or client involvement, community impact, ROI potential, attendee or participant data capture, and alignment with market goals and budgets.
  • Work alongside market leaders to gather necessary information, facilitate discussions, and support documentation of move-forward decisions before the organization is engaged.
  • Negotiation & documentation
    • Serve as the single point of contact with third-party organizations and negotiate terms, benefits, and activation rights on behalf of Mercer Advisors.
    • Identify branding and collateral needs, including logo placement, branded merchandise, and content.
    • Collect and maintain required documentation, including W-9s and invoices, for every sponsorship and donation.
  • Formal approval & payment
    • Assist in guiding each request through formal review and sign-off by the local leadership, Marketing, Vendor Management, Compliance, and Finance.
    • Build the 10- to 15-business-day approval cycle and three- to four-week payment window into planning so commitments to organizations are met on time.
  • Program administration
    • Assist the Sponsorship team in maintaining a central sponsorship tracker covering status, spend by market, contract terms, deliverables, and renewal dates.
    • Monitor sponsorship and donation spend against market and national budgets.

Sponsorship Strategy & Portfolio Management:

  • Support the development and maintenance of a consistent evaluation framework and scorecard to help the sponsorship team compare opportunities based on audience alignment, relationship value, activation potential, and expected return.
  • Participate in regular sponsorship portfolio reviews, providing data, insights, and recommendations to help the broader sponsorship team determine whether investments should be renewed, optimized, or discontinued.
  • Partner with the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition and sponsorship team to develop activation strategies that extend beyond logo placement, including speaking opportunities, hosted events, advisor participation, contact capture, and structured follow-up.
  • Help identify and evaluate new sponsorship and nonprofit partnership opportunities within priority markets and audiences, including opportunities that support business development and community marketing objectives.
  • Support the sponsorship team in providing guidance to market leaders and advisors on opportunities where sponsorship investments may have the greatest potential impact.

Activation & Event Operations:

  • Collateral & activation
    • Coordinate the creation and delivery of branded items, logos, and content to partner organizations on schedule.
    • Make sure attendee and participant information is captured where possible and handed off to local teams for follow-up.
  • Event support
    • Assist Event Manager in managing logistics for sponsorship-related events, including vendors, timelines, budgets, onsite coordination, and post-event reconciliation.
    • Support the Event Marketing programs, including timelines, communications, onsite roles, and follow-up materials.

Measurement & Reporting:

  • Define success metrics for each sponsorship before commitment.
  • Support the Sponsorship Project Manager in creating Salesforce campaigns for approved sponsorships and charitable donations, and partner with local teams to help ensure outcomes are accurately tracked and recorded.
  • Report on sponsorship-sourced activity, including contacts, leads, pipeline, new clients, and spend by market.
  • Translate results into clear recommendations that inform future sponsorship investments.

Process, Tools & Enablement:

  • Work alongside the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition to maintain and update Sponsorship and Charitable Donations Guidelines, approval workflows, and supporting templates as needed.
  • Partner with the broader sponsorship team to develop playbooks, checklists, intake forms, and supporting tools that create consistency and clarity across markets.
  • Collaborate with the Director and Sponsorship Manager to educate local teams on the sponsorship process, providing ongoing guidance and support as questions arise.
  • Identify bottlenecks and improve cycle time while keeping the process compliant with firm policies.

Qualifications:

  • Five or more years of experience in event operations, sponsorship management, marketing operations, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience managing sponsorship or partnership programs end to end, including negotiation, vendor onboarding, and payment.
  • Strong project and process management skills, with the ability to manage many concurrent requests and deadlines.
  • Experience working with Compliance, Finance, and vendor management teams, ideally in a highly regulated industry.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM system, including campaign setup and reporting.
  • Analytical mindset, with experience using data to evaluate return on investment and recommend where to invest.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and comfort operating as both a strategic thinker and hands-on executor.
  • Ability to manage programs across multiple markets from a remote position.
  • Experience in financial services, wealth management, or professional services preferred.
  • Experience with nonprofit, philanthropic, or institutional audiences is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ticketing and event registration tools (Halo, Cvent, or similar) is a plus.
  • Must be able to travel 25-30%

What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means every sponsorship and charitable giving request moves through a clear, consistent, and predictable process, with stakeholders having visibility into status, decisions, and next steps.

It means working closely with the broader sponsorship team to help ensure decisions are thoughtful, data-informed, and aligned with business goals, with defined success metrics, Salesforce campaigns, and follow-up plans established for each investment.

Over time, the Event Operations Manager (Sponsorships) becomes a trusted and valued contributor to the sponsorship team, helping keep the program organized, compliant, and efficient while partnering with others to continuously improve the business value and overall effectiveness of Mercer Advisors’ sponsorship investments.

Actual base pay within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the applicant’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills and licenses/certifications. This position is also eligible to earn incentive compensation through one of Mercer Advisors’ incentive compensation programs.

Base Pay Range
$76,500—$90,000 USD

Benefits:

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees. Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

  • Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance
  • Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Supplemental Life Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
  • Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.
  • Kaiser Medical plans available in California
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions if enrolled in either HDHP medical plan.
  • Two comprehensive Dental Plans
  • Vision Insurance Plan
  • Dependent Care Savings Account for child and dependent care.
  • 14 Company Paid Holidays including a full week off at Thanksgiving.
  • Generous paid time off program for vacation and sick days
  • Employee Assistance Plan
  • Family Medical Leave
  • Paid Parental Leave (8 weeks)
  • Maternity benefits utilizing company paid STD, any supplemental STD, plus Parental Leave (8 weeks) to provide time for recovery, baby bonding, and enjoying your family time.
  • Adoption Assistance Reimbursement Program
  • Company Paid Concierge Services for you and your loved ones for the spectrum of caring needs for your aging parents, young children, life’s challenges and more.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with both Traditional and Roth plans with per pay period match as well as an after-tax option
  • Pet Insurance
  • Personalized financial planning and guidance from Mercer Advisors professionals, offered at preferred employee pricing

raw.description:
Position Overview

Power your Future with Qualus as an Engineer II in our Distribution Department. As a Distribution Engineer II, you will provide technical leadership for electric utility distribution projects, including system expansion, resiliency, and infrastructure improvement initiatives. You will develop and review engineering designs using WMS, Pole Foreman, Design Manager/Electric Office, and AutoCAD, while ensuring compliance with utility standards and regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will perform QA/QC reviews, mentor junior engineers and designers, and collaborate with clients and project teams to deliver safe, reliable, and cost-effective solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and engineering expertise for overhead and underground electrical distribution system projects.

  • Apply client standards, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements to the design and execution of distribution projects.
  • Support project execution by managing assignments, monitoring performance, resolving technical issues, and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Develop and oversee engineering design packages using client-specific software and design tools, including Distribution Design Studio, Pole Foreman, Design Manager, WMS, and AutoCAD.
  • Perform QA/QC reviews of engineering and design deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, quality, consistency, and compliance with project requirements.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers through training, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams, clients, contractors, and regulatory agencies to support successful project delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, design standards, team performance, and technical capabilities.
  • Maintain productivity and adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving work environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or related discipline) from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • 3-5 years of experience in electric utility distribution engineering and design.
  • Working experience with Design Manager or Electric Office
  • Experience designing and supporting overhead and underground distribution systems.
  • Knowledge of utility distribution standards, NESC requirements, and utility construction practices.
  • Proficiency with utility design and work management software, including Pole Foreman, Design Manager/Electric Office, WMS, AutoCAD, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and coordinating engineering design packages and construction work orders.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent organizational, document management, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform technical reviews and ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance of engineering deliverables.

Preferred Skills

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure.
  • Experience with complex system expansion projects, load growth initiatives, and utility infrastructure upgrades.
  • Experience supporting government conversion projects, municipal utility programs, or utility acquisition integrations.
  • Experience with resiliency, system hardening, storm mitigation, reliability improvement, and grid modernization programs.
  • Experience supporting PIP (Pole Inspection Program), pole replacement, asset management, and vegetation management initiatives.
  • Advanced proficiency with Pole Foreman, Design Manager/Electric Office, WMS, AutoCAD, GIS, and related utility software platforms.
  • Experience performing formal QA/QC reviews of engineering designs, work packages, staking sheets, and construction deliverables.
  • Familiarity with distributed energy resources (DER), renewable energy interconnections, electric vehicle infrastructure, and distribution automation projects.
  • Experience working directly with investor-owned utilities (IOUs), cooperatives, and municipal electric systems.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.

Home Based - Mexico

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.


As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.


As a CRA II at ICON, you will perform site qualification, initiation, monitoring and closeout activities as assigned.

What You Will Do:

You will contribute to clinical trial monitoring activities, taking responsibility for your deliverables and working collaboratively.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Perform site qualification, initiation, monitoring and closeout activities as assigned.
  • Verify protocol, GCP and regulatory compliance and participant protection.
  • Review source data, essential documents and site processes for accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and follow up findings, risks and corrective actions.
  • Maintain clear communication with investigators, site staff and study teams.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Relevant life sciences, healthcare or clinical research qualification, or equivalent relevant clinical research experience.

raw.excerpt: Evio OverviewEvio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.
raw.description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reform—rapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation.  

Evio has advanced analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing “flywheel” where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an “Only Evio can do that,” mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy– The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity – We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights – one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure – We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless – Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency – Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence – We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

About the role

Evio is seeking an Assistant General Counsel to serve as the lead legal advisor to its digital health product teams. You will report to the General Counsel and work closely with product teams throughout the product lifecycle, helping shape product design, advise on new features and business models, and support launch, customer implementation, and ongoing operations: offering your legal perspective along the way.

The role combines product counseling, commercial contracting, and healthcare regulatory advice, with particular emphasis on HIPAA and other applicable U.S. privacy laws. You will help teams understand legal requirements, assess risk, and develop workable approaches that advance Evio’s business objectives.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will initially serve as an individual contributor with substantial ownership of digital health legal matters and opportunities for expanded responsibility as Evio grows. You will also support contracting and regulatory matters across Evio’s other business lines as needed.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with product teams throughout the product lifecycle. Work closely with product, technology, clinical, analytics, and commercial teammates from initial concept through development, launch, and ongoing support. Participate early in decisions and translate legal requirements into practical guidance on product design and operations.
  • Advise on product evolution. Evaluate new features, data uses, technology integrations, customer use cases, and business models. Help teams identify legal risks, assess alternatives, problem-solve, and make informed decisions.
  • Lead commercial negotiations. Draft and negotiate customer subscription and services agreements, statements of work, technology and vendor agreements, data sharing and licensing arrangements, and business associate agreements.
  • Provide healthcare regulatory and privacy advice. Advise on HIPAA and other applicable U.S. privacy laws. Partner with the compliance team to ensure that digital health products, data practices, and contractual commitments comply with legal requirements and company policies.
  • Address data and intellectual property rights. Advise on the collection, use, and disclosure of healthcare data, including claims data, and negotiate rights involving analytics, derived insights, and intellectual property.
  • Support customer implementation and ongoing operations. Resolve legal questions arising from product deployment, customer requirements, provider communications, and relationships with technology and service partners.
  • Build efficient legal processes. Develop templates negotiation guidance, and repeatable approaches to recurring legal issues.
  • Provide broader legal support. Partner with the General Counsel with other commercial transactions and regulatory matters, using outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Approximately four trips per year, two nights each.

Your skills and experience

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • Approximately 7+ years of relevant legal experience at a law firm, in-house, or both.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex commercial negotiations and draft clear agreements that balance business objectives while appropriately addressing risk.
  • Experience working directly with product and business teams on product development, implementation, and ongoing support.
  • Substantial experience advising on healthcare regulatory matters, particularly HIPAA and other applicable U.S. privacy laws.
  • Ability to apply legal requirements to healthcare data, technology products, and evolving business models.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to give clear, actionable advice when legal requirements or business circumstances are uncertain.
  • Strong communication and relationship skills, including the ability to explain complex issues to teammates with different backgrounds.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and take ownership of matters from initial assessment through resolution.

Preferred industry experience

  • Experience advising a health plan, PBM, specialty pharmacy, healthcare technology company, or another participant in the pharmaceutical value chain, whether in-house or through law firm work.
  • Experience supporting healthcare analytics, digital health products, or transactions involving healthcare data.
  • Experience advising start-up companies (either in-house or as outside counsel) a plus.
  • Experience in employment law, mergers and acquisitions, or antitrust is helpful but not required.

Evio Benefits

  • Great Health InsuranceThe company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match
    Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off
    We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave
    Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents).
  • Continuing Education & Licensing Fees
    Generous allowance to cover your CLE courses and state licensing fees.

Fraud Notice

We’ve recently learned of fraudulent job postings and individuals falsely claiming to represent Evio. Protecting our candidates is incredibly important to us, and we want to share a few reminders:
  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.
If you believe you’ve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance — we’re grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

California privacy notice Consistent with California law, we use this information for recruiting, hiring, and related business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy and improving our hiring processes.

raw.excerpt: Wrike is the most powerful work management platform.
raw.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

  • Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
  • Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
  • Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
  • Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

  • Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
  • Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
  • Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
  • Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

What You Will Help Shape:

  • A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
  • GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
  • A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

  • Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.
  • Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
  • Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
  • Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

Your Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
  • Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
  • Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
  • Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
  • Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

  • You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
  • You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
  • The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

What’s Next?

  1. Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  2. Conversation with the AI Product Director
  3. Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives
  4. Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Benefits & Perks:

  • 28 calendar days of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Health Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Life Insurance Plan
  • Utility Allowance (30 EUR/month, subject to taxation)
  • Fitness Plan (800 EUR/year)
  • Full-remote & On-demand access to Co-working space

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode


Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.
