raw.description:
Virtual Assistant: Marketing and Operations

About Frontier:

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US based startups and high growth companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support a US-based commercial real estate brokerage team with marketing, research, listing management, and day-to-day administrative tasks.

This role is a great fit for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, enjoys organizing information, and can use AI tools to work more efficiently while maintaining a high standard of accuracy. You’ll help prepare marketing materials, manage online listings, research properties and market information, organize documents, and support the team with a variety of operational tasks.

You don’t need to come from a real estate background to be successful in this role. We’re open to candidates with experience in virtual assistance, marketing coordination, administrative support, research, data management, or similar roles. What matters most is your ability to learn new tools quickly, use AI thoughtfully, take ownership of tasks, and produce reliable, high-quality work.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing & Content Support

  • Create and update marketing materials, presentations, brochures, flyers, and promotional content using existing templates and digital tools.

  • Use AI tools to assist with drafting property descriptions, marketing copy, email campaigns, research summaries, and other content.

  • Review and edit AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and a professional tone before sharing or publishing.

  • Coordinate property images, maps, aerial imagery, and other visual assets for marketing materials.

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, property announcements, and promotional activities.

  • Help coordinate the preparation and updating of property signage.

2. AI & Digital Tools

  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant platforms to streamline research, drafting, data organization, and repetitive administrative work.

  • Develop effective prompts and workflows to generate useful, accurate outputs for day-to-day tasks.

  • Verify AI-generated information against reliable sources rather than relying on unverified outputs.

  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and support team productivity.

  • Learn and adapt to new software, platforms, and workflows as business needs evolve.

3. Research & Data Management

  • Conduct online research to gather property details, market information, comparable listings, and other relevant data.

  • Maintain and update internal databases, spreadsheets, contact lists, and property records.

  • Collect, organize, and verify information from multiple sources.

  • Ensure data is accurate, complete, and consistently formatted.

  • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, or errors and follow up as needed.

4. Listing & Administrative Support

  • Create and update online listings using approved information, templates, and workflows.

  • Maintain accurate property details, descriptions, pricing, images, and supporting documents across relevant platforms.

  • Prepare and organize documents using established templates.

  • Assist with sending documents through DocuSign and tracking signatures or outstanding paperwork.

  • Support the preparation of listing agreements and other brokerage documents using approved templates and instructions.

  • Keep marketing assets, property records, and administrative documents organized and easy to access.

  • Track pending tasks, follow up on outstanding items, and provide general support to the brokerage team.

Requirements

  • Experience in virtual assistance, administrative support, marketing coordination, research, data management, or a similar role.

  • Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, writing, content creation, and administrative workflows.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to verify information before using or sharing it.

  • Good written English and the ability to produce clear, professional content.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, online databases, document management tools, and web-based platforms.

  • Resourceful and quick to learn new software and processes.

  • Able to work independently in a remote environment and communicate proactively with a US-based team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with commercial real estate, property management, or real estate marketing.

  • Familiarity with platforms such as Buildout, CoStar, LoopNet, or Crexi.

  • Experience with Canva or similar tools for creating marketing materials.

  • Familiarity with DocuSign, email marketing platforms, and CRM systems.

  • Experience using AI tools beyond basic prompting, including building repeatable workflows or using AI to improve productivity.

  • Experience coordinating property imagery, maps, aerial photos, or signage.

What We're Looking For

  • AI-savvy: Comfortable using AI to improve the speed and quality of everyday work, while checking outputs carefully.

  • Detail-oriented: Takes the time to verify facts, review documents, and catch inconsistencies.

  • Proactive: Spots what needs to be done and follows through without constant supervision.

  • Adaptable: Learns new platforms and workflows quickly, even without prior industry experience.

  • Organized: Keeps information, files, and tasks structured and easy to track.

  • Resourceful: Knows how to research unfamiliar topics, find reliable information, and solve problems independently.

The ideal candidate combines strong administrative and marketing skills with practical AI experience and a willingness to learn. Prior real estate experience is welcome, but we're equally interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong digital skills, sound judgment, and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work.

raw.title: Senior Systems Engineer
raw.excerpt: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work.
raw.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Bungie is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer with a focus on End User Experience (EUX) and Endpoint Engineering to join our Studio IT team. This role will help design, build, and improve the technology experience used by Bungie employees every day, with a focus on secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint platforms and services.

Are you passionate about making technology easier and more dependable for the people using it? Do you enjoy solving complex endpoint problems, automating repetitive work, and improving how devices and applications are deployed and managed? Can you balance security, usability, and operational needs without creating unnecessary friction for our users? Then come help Bungie IT Engineering support the teams creating our world-class games.

As a Senior Systems Engineer at Bungie, you will architect, implement, and support endpoint platforms, device management, application delivery, and supporting infrastructure across Bungie’s environment. You’ll work with a team of experienced IT engineers and partner closely with Studio IT Support, Information Security, infrastructure teams, application owners, and development teams to continuously improve the technology experience for our users.

This role is expected to take technical ownership of EUX platforms and services, identify recurring pain points, and build solutions that reduce friction for both users and support teams. You will help establish standards, automate common workflows, and ensure endpoint services can scale with the changing needs of game development.

Successful candidates will have strong experience engineering and supporting enterprise endpoint environments, be comfortable owning complex technical problems, and be able to turn user and business needs into practical technical solutions. They will also be an effective mentor, collaborator, project owner, and communicator.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, implement, and maintain endpoint management platforms and services supporting Bungie employees and development teams
  • Own and improve the lifecycle of Bungie’s endpoints from provisioning and configuration through ongoing management and retirement
  • Engineer solutions for Windows and macOS endpoint management, configuration, compliance, and application delivery
  • Design and automate device provisioning and deployment workflows that reduce manual effort and improve the onboarding experience
  • Develop automation and tooling to improve endpoint reliability, consistency, and supportability at scale
  • Identify recurring user and support pain points and engineer solutions that address their underlying causes
  • Improve software packaging, deployment, patching, configuration, and lifecycle management across managed endpoints
  • Partner with Information Security to implement and meet endpoint security requirements while balancing security, usability, and development needs
  • Partner closely with Studio IT Support to understand recurring issues, improve escalation paths, and reduce support demand through engineering
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex endpoint, operating system, application, and device-management issues
  • Evaluate endpoint health, performance, and operational data to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Lead technical projects from requirements and design through implementation, validation, documentation, and operational handoff
  • Evaluate new technologies and determine where they can improve the employee and developer technology experience
  • Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance and training to Studio IT Support and other technical teams
  • Maintain clear and useful documentation of systems, standards, architecture, runbooks, and processes

Required Skills

  • Strong experience engineering and operating endpoint management solutions in a large enterprise environment
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune, Ivanti and other modern endpoint management technologies
  • Strong knowledge of Windows endpoint architecture, configuration, deployment, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management
  • Experience managing macOS endpoints using enterprise device-management technologies
  • Experience with automated device provisioning technologies such as Windows Autopilot, Apple Automated Device Enrollment, or comparable solutions
  • Experience with enterprise software packaging, deployment, patching, and application lifecycle management
  • Experience designing and enforcing endpoint configuration and compliance policies
  • Experience automating administrative and endpoint workflows using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or comparable technologies
  • Experience troubleshooting complex endpoint issues across operating systems, applications, identity, networking, and security layers
  • Understanding of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID as they relate to endpoint authentication, device identity, policy, and access
  • Understanding of endpoint security technologies and concepts including EDR, disk encryption, local privilege management, certificates, and device compliance
  • Experience independently leading complex technical projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with support organizations and turn recurring operational issues into engineering improvements
  • Ability to evaluate technical decisions from both an engineering and end-user perspective
  • Ability to mentor other engineers and help establish technical standards and best practices
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Jamf Pro or other enterprise Apple management platforms
  • Experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and migrations from traditional to modern endpoint management
  • Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern Windows provisioning
  • Experience managing developer workstations or other high-performance/specialized endpoint environments
  • Experience supporting endpoints within game development, software development, media production, or another highly technical creative environment
  • Experience with endpoint analytics, digital employee experience (DEX), or observability platforms
  • Experience with application virtualization, VDI, or remote workstation technologies
  • Experience with privileged access and endpoint privilege management
  • Experience with PKI, certificate deployment, and certificate lifecycle management
  • Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity, security, ITSM, and asset-management systems
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, or CI/CD practices
  • Experience designing technology solutions for distributed, hybrid, or globally located teams

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
$155,900—$233,900 USD

raw.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Product Support Engineer to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Support in the Product Support department. At Zscaler, our Customer Success Organization is a global, customer-focused team dedicated to delivering high-impact experiences and identifying innovative solutions. We leverage valuable data and research to provide expert, hands-on support starting from the implementation phase and beyond, ensuring customers achieve their goals and leverage our technology to its fullest potential. Together, we create a customer-centric culture that fosters success, adoption, and continuous growth.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)


  • Provide first line phone/email consultation to independently debug complex security/network problems
  • Partner with Engineering and assist customers with testing or troubleshooting
  • Document detailed entries for incident resolutions in the technical support database to ensure solutions are actionable for customers and the internal team
  • Help develop ongoing training programs for the department and mentor other engineers on advanced troubleshooting, debugging, and case management skills
  • Understand product direction and customer use cases to provide input on product and code changes through all points of the product cycle

Who You Are (Success Profile)


  • You are a problem-solver who is energized by finding solutions to complex technical challenges and delivering high-impact outcomes.
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for enterprise customer needs and anchoring every action in solving real-world issues.
  • You act like an owner with a strong bias for action, taking full accountability for case resolution and team skill development.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who works effectively with engineering partners and mentors peers to elevate team performance.
  • You are resilient and adaptable, maintaining composure and clear focus when managing high-pressure customer escalations.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)


  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • U.S. citizenship required for this position due to the nature of the customers assigned to this role
  • 3+ years of experience troubleshooting SSL, SAML, HTTP, and TCP/IP, with extensive experience analyzing packet captures and HAR traces to resolve connectivity, application, and network performance issues
  • Detailed working knowledge of web-based security and network infrastructure, Security Proxies, such as NGFW, IPS, SSL/IPSec VPNs, DLP, SD-WAN, GRE tunnels, IP SLA monitoring, and Firewalls
  • Experience handling escalations with enterprise customers and stakeholders
What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Background in Internet and Security technologies such as SWG, Sandboxing, PAC files, API, SCIM, and ESXi
  • Vendor certification such as CCNP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

Join Tebra’s high-performing Small Business Sales team as an Account Executive where you will drive growth for small healthcare practices across the U.S. This is more than just full-cycle sales — you’ll act as a trusted advisor, helping providers modernize their operations and improve patient outcomes through our SaaS platform.

We’re looking for ambitious, experienced sales professionals ready to hit the ground running, exceed quota and grow into larger segments of our business. This is a fast-paced role with high visibility and opportunity for advancement.

Your Area of Focus

  • Own full sales cycle from discovery to close with small healthcare practices.
  • Lead consultative discovery conversations to uncover operational pain points and align Tebra’s solutions to real business outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations that showcase the value of our all-in-one platform and drive urgency to buy.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Development, Marketing, and Onboarding to optimize the buyer journey and improve conversion rates.
  • Provide market feedback to Sales and Product to help refine messaging, positioning, and product features.
  • Continually work to build subject matter expertise in the complex, regulated healthcare industry to lead informed, value-driven sales conversations.
  • Operate with autonomy and accountability, take ownership of your pipeline, prioritize effectively, and drive deals forward with minimal oversight in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
  • Consistently exceed monthly quota through pipeline generation, efficient sales execution, and closing excellence.
  • Adapt quickly to change and contribute to a fast-evolving go-to-market strategy.

Your Professional Qualifications

  • Ideally 3+ years of full-cycle sales experience at a software company; strong SDR experience with a proven track record will also be considered.
  • Proven track record of exceeding quota in a high-velocity sales environment.
  • Passion for learning and developing subject matter expertise in a complex, evolving industry.
  • Confidence to run a consultative sales process and guide buyers through technical and operational questions.
  • Strong discovery, objection handling, and closing skills.
  • Tech-savvy with CRM (Salesforce), sales engagement tools (Outreach, SalesLoft), and basic video demo skills.
  • Self-starter mindset with strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Team player attitude — you thrive in collaborative, goal-driven cultures.
  • Prior experience in Healthcare IT, medical practice sales, or B2B SaaS is a strong advantage.

We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions.

Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this:

Zone 1: National Average

Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions

Zone 3: High-Cost Regions

Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions

Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen.

Zone 1 (National Average)
$55,000—$95,000 USD

About Tebra

Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at .

Our Values

Start with the Customer

We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.

Keep It Simple

Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.

Stay Entrepreneurial

We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.

Better Together

We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.

Celebrate Success

Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.

Perks & Benefits

United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

Costa Rica: To assist with all of life’s needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

Compliance & Privacy Disclosures

NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here:

If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.

As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes BrightHire, an interview intelligence platform, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded.

raw.title: Senior QA Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Us:YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B.
raw.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View) APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

Who Thrives Here?

We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:

  • Choose growth over comfort
  • Lead through challenges
  • Are energized by high expectations

It’s not for everyone, and that’s intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

This is a fully remote opportunity based in India. Standard work hours are from 8 am to 5 pm IST.

As our Senior SDET, You will be responsible for :

  • Test Planning and Execution. Develop comprehensive test plans covering manual, automated, and performance testing based on an understanding of product requirements and business processes.
  • Automated Testing, Performance and Stress Testing. Be able to create and maintain efficient automated testing frameworks, writing test scripts and implementing automated testing processes.
  • Defect Management and Communication Collaboration. Accurately record and track defects found during testing. Maintain close communication with cross-functional team members, collaborate to solve problems during testing, and promote the smooth progress of projects.

You are likely to succeed If you:

  • Have at least 7 years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, with experience working in fast - paced and complex project environments preferred.
  • Have 5 years of experience in automated testing and test case design, and be familiar with test plan development.
  • Have defined and evolved test strategies and driving quality for big and complex releases.
  • Are proficient in at least one programming language, such as C, C++, Java, Go, Python, JavaScript, C#, etc.
  • Have rich experience in automated testing and be familiar with various automated testing frameworks and tools, such as Selenium, Robot framework, etc.
  • Are proficient in API testing (such as Postman, REST Assured) and performance testing (such as JMeter, Gatling).
  • Understand database operations (such as SQL) and have the ability to operate in a Linux environment.
  • Are familiar with Agile development methods and be able to work efficiently in an Agile team.
  • Have strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and be able to quickly locate and solve complex problems during software testing.
  • Have good organizational, collaborative, and time-management skills, and be able to work effectively in a multi-tasking and cross-team environment.
  • Have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and be able to communicate clearly and effectively with people from different departments and levels.
  • Have the ability to work independently, complete tasks with limited guidance, and be proactive in learning and adapting to new work requirements.
  • Have an innovative mindset and a passion for learning new technologies, and be able to continuously explore and apply new testing methods and technologies to improve the efficiency and quality of testing work.

Bonus Points If You:

  • Have designed and developed QA tools and services other than standard API/UI automation frameworks.
  • Are familiar with professional QA methodologies and tools.
  • Have a good understanding of QA-related Python.
  • Know how to use stress testing tools, have experience for api and backend features performance tests.
  • Possess knowledge of SQL, Docker, Linux basics, and Pytest.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, parental leave, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

raw.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Senior Program Manager to help the Revenue Operations team scale efficiently. This role drives cross-functional programs, streamlines processes, and delivers data-driven solutions that accelerate predictable SaaS revenue growth. You'll be the person who turns strategic priorities into structured plans, keeps cross-functional teams aligned, and makes sure risks and blockers get surfaced and resolved before they slow the business down.

The mission of the Senior Program Manager is to enable the Revenue Operations team to scale efficiently by driving cross-functional programs, streamlining processes, and delivering data-driven solutions that accelerate predictable SaaS revenue growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive Strategic RevOps Initiatives
    • Translate strategic priorities into structured program plans
    • Define milestones, owners, and deliverables
    • Track progress and outcomes against plan
    • Manage dependencies and escalate blockers as needed
  • Establish Program Governance & Cadences
    • Establish operating rhythms for cross-functional programs
    • Run status and steering meetings
    • Maintain decision and action logs
    • Standardize reporting across programs
  • Manage Cross-Functional Alignment
    • Coordinate across RevOps and Field (Sales, CS, Marketing) teams
    • Clarify roles and responsibilities across program stakeholders
    • Align teams on priorities and timelines
    • Facilitate decisions and communicate updates to stakeholders and leadership
  • Manage Risks, Issues & Dependencies
    • Identify risks early and maintain risk logs
    • Develop mitigation plans
    • Resolve cross-functional dependencies
    • Escalate decisions requiring leadership input

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in program management, project management, or operations, ideally supporting a Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM function
  • Strong track record running cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Experience establishing program governance — operating rhythms, status reporting, decision logs — from scratch
  • Comfortable managing risk logs, mitigation plans, and escalation processes
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills; able to align stakeholders across Sales, CS, Marketing, and RevOps
  • Data-driven mindset; comfortable defining and tracking success metrics for programs
  • Experience with Project Management tools (Jira, Asana, Monday)
  • PMP, Agile/Scrum certification, or equivalent experience a plus
  • GTM tool implementation a plus
  • Project Management tool experience a plus
  • Experience in B2B SaaS preferred

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $136,500 - $187,660**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $122,800 - $168,850**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $116,000 - $159,500**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at .

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts.Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to .

raw.title: Counselor Administrative Referral
raw.excerpt: At Horace Mann, we recognize the importance of providing thoughtful, timely support when employees and organizations are navigating challenging workplace situations.
raw.description:
At Horace Mann, we recognize the importance of providing thoughtful, timely support when employees and organizations are navigating challenging workplace situations. As a Counselor, Administrative Referral within an Employee Assistance Program, you will support members referred through the Administrative Referral Program by providing telephonic assessment, coaching, training, resource coordination and case management.

You will manage cases from initial referral through completion and partner with Human Resources professionals, supervisors and service providers to coordinate appropriate support and resources.

Please note that applications are currently being accepted, with interviews expected to begin after October 1, 2026.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage Administrative Referral cases from initial intake through completion, including documentation and follow-up.
  • Conduct telephonic triage and assessments related to behavioral health, substance use, relationship and work-life concerns.
  • Provide members with immediate support, coaching and training based on identified needs.
  • Coordinate referrals to network providers and complete session authorizations.
  • Connect members with appropriate resources for financial, legal, personal assistance and work-life needs.
  • Consult with Human Resources professionals and supervisory personnel from client organizations regarding employee concerns and applicable HR practices and policies.
  • Make sound clinical determinations in accordance with company risk policies and the best interests of the member and organization.
  • Maintain timely, accurate and professional documentation within the case management system.
  • Conduct research to identify appropriate services, providers and resources.
  • Support colleagues with case management, case completion and follow-up activities.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry practices, professional ethical standards and applicable licensure requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

  • Master’s degree in social work, psychology, counseling or another behavioral health-related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional Human Resources experience.
  • At least five years of experience in Employee Assistance Program counseling, clinical behavioral health or a professional Human Resources role.
  • Strong assessment, triage, immediate-support, research and case management capabilities.
  • Knowledge of general Human Resources standards and practices.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health conditions and appropriate levels-of-care recommendations.
  • Understanding of Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) requirements and the appropriate handling of Protected Health Information (PHI).
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office and other Windows-based programs and applications.
  • Strong communication, consultation, organization, judgment and documentation skills.

Preferred Credentials

  • Professional in Human Resources (PHR or SPHR) certification.
  • Society for Human Resource Management Certified Professional or Senior Certified Professional (SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP) certification.
  • An active, current and unrestricted professional license in the state of employment may be required based on the assigned geographic area and responsibilities.

Pay Range: $66,500 - $92,000

Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

#TD-1

#APP

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs. We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them. This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. Our tailored offerings include special rates and benefits for educators.

raw.title: Senior Partner Growth Manager
raw.excerpt: About EngineEngine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel.
raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

Engine's Partner Growth team partners with a growing ecosystem of associations, fintech platforms, and distribution partners to bring Engine's free-to-use travel product to their members and customers. As Senior Partner Growth Manager, you will own the full lifecycle of Engine's most important channel relationships, from onboarding and enablement through deep performance optimization, driving revenue share growth across a portfolio that spans industries and partner types: associations, fintech and corporate spending platforms, marketplaces, and other distribution partners.

This is not a reactive account management role. You will function as a channel expert inside Engine's Partner Growth org, building the playbooks, relationships, and commercial frameworks that allow Engine to scale distribution through partners without sacrificing traveler experience or commercial performance. You'll sit at the intersection of partner acquisition and strategic account management, and you'll be expected to lead both internally and externally.

Why This Role Exists

Engine's channel partner network is entering a new phase of maturity. As the partner ecosystem grows and our largest relationships deepen, we need a dedicated owner who can enable partners to effectively position and distribute Engine to their audiences, and who understands the commercial levers that drive revenue share performance at scale. This hire is a critical seat on the channel team and is expected to immediately pick up a book of active relationships and drive them forward with minimal ramp time.

What You'll Own

Channel Partner Growth & Performance

  • Own end-to-end partner growth for a portfolio of channel partners spanning a range of industries, partner models, and scales
  • Drive GBV growth within existing channel partnerships through proactive commercial reviews, optimization initiatives, and joint go-to-market planning
  • Monitor partner health across production metrics, rate quality, and engagement, flagging risks and surfacing opportunities before they become problems
  • Ensure every partner in your portfolio has a regular cadence of meaningful touchpoints (no partner goes 60+ days without one), catching adoption or engagement gaps before they become churn risks
  • Lead QBRs and executive business reviews for strategic partners and structured health check-ins for the broader portfolio, translating data into forward-looking strategy rather than backward-looking reporting
  • Manage the commercial and contractual dimensions of partner relationships, including pricing discussions, tier reviews, and renewal negotiations
  • Serve as the first line of escalation for partner issues, coordinating internally with supply, product, and engineering to drive resolution
  • Own partner tier progression: actively move partners from Bronze toward Gold/Platinum status by unlocking the right milestones
  • Build multi-threaded relationships inside each partner across commercial, product, marketing, and operational contacts, so Engine's position doesn't depend on a single champion
  • Develop deep institutional knowledge of each partner's business model, product roadmap, and internal champions

Channel Ecosystem Development

  • Engage at contract signature to understand each partner's goals, stakeholders, and definition of success, then own the transition from the Partner Acquisition team to ongoing partner growth
  • Build and maintain channel-specific playbooks, onboarding frameworks, and partner enablement materials
  • Be the voice of the live partner base in internal product and roadmap discussions, translating partner needs into structured feature requests
  • Partner with the VP of Partner Growth to define the channel partner strategy and inform partner prioritization decisions
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing partner footprints: new use cases, geographies, user segments, or product lines
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to align channel activity to co-sell motions and joint go-to-market initiatives
  • Contribute to the buildout of scalable channel infrastructure: tier frameworks, health scoring, comp model inputs, and reporting tooling

Who You Are

You're the kind of person who...

  • Has operated in a channel, distribution, or platform partnerships role and understands what it takes to make indirect revenue models work
  • Thrives in the post-sale: you enjoy turning a signed partnership into a performing one and don't need the thrill of the new-logo chase to stay motivated. Proactive, not reactive.
  • Builds trust with external partners quickly. You're commercially fluent, technically credible, and curious about how their business works
  • Owns outcomes, not activities. You track GBV, conversion rates, and partner health, and you know what levers to pull when numbers move in the wrong direction
